It was a commercial success, grossing around $130 million worldwide against a budget of about $30 million.

overview: When a celebrated TV show host returns to his hometown in the South, his family is there to remind him that going home is no vacation!
tagline: Roscoe Jenkins aims for the heartstrings and funny bones, a raucous helping of family soul food.
title: Welcome Home Roscoe Jenkins
plot:
Welcome Home Roscoe Jenkins is a comedy film that explores the complexities of family dynamics and identity. The story revolves around Roscoe Jenkins, a successful businessman who must navigate his way through a series of challenges when he's forced to confront his past and reevaluate his priorities.

At its core, the movie delves into themes of self-discovery and acceptance. Roscoe's journey is a metaphor for the struggles many people face in finding their place in the world and embracing their true selves. As he navigates between his high-society life and his humble roots, Roscoe must confront the expectations placed upon him by others and learn to be true to himself.

The film also touches on the theme of family and the importance of relationships. Roscoe's interactions with his eccentric family members, particularly his wife and children, serve as a catalyst for his growth and self-discovery. Through their love and support, Roscoe comes to realize that family is not just about blood ties but also about the people who accept and understand you for who you are.

Furthermore, Welcome Home Roscoe Jenkins explores the idea of identity and how it can be shaped by societal expectations. Roscoe's struggles with his own identity serve as a commentary on the pressures placed upon individuals to conform to certain standards or norms. The film suggests that true happiness and fulfillment come from embracing one's individuality and living authentically.

Overall, Welcome Home Roscoe Jenkins is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of themes that are both universally relatable and deeply personal.

overview: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.
title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
plot:
Master Z: Ip Man Legacy is a 2018 martial arts film directed by Yuen Woo-ping and written by Edson Oda, Jonathan Hales, and David Lye. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2011 film Master Z: Ip Man's protégé.

The main themes of Master Z: Ip Man Legacy include:

1. **Legacy and Heritage**: The film explores the theme of legacy and heritage, as Ip Man's protégé, Cheung Tin-chi (played by Max Zhang), struggles to find his place in the world while honoring his mentor's teachings.
2. **Identity and Belonging**: Cheung Tin-chi's journey is also one of self-discovery, as he navigates his identity and finds his belonging within the Wing Chun community.
3. **Mentorship and Passing on Knowledge**: The movie highlights the importance of mentorship and passing on knowledge from one generation to the next. Ip Man's character serves as a wise and experienced guide for Cheung Tin-chi, teaching him the ways of Wing Chun.
4. **Power Dynamics and Corruption**: The film touches on the theme of power dynamics and corruption within the martial arts community. A rival organization, led by a ruthless leader (played by Zhang Jin), seeks to exploit the Wing Chun tradition for their own gain.
5. **Respect and Loyalty**: Throughout the movie, Cheung Tin-chi grapples with his loyalty to Ip Man's teachings and his desire to forge his own path. The film emphasizes the importance of respect and loyalty within a community.

The movie features stunning martial arts sequences, impressive fight choreography, and a gripping storyline that explores the complexities of identity, legacy, and power dynamics.

overview: Bruceuilis, a policeman from the countryside, is assigned to rescue Celestina, a goat considered heritage of his small city, and travels to São Paulo. There, he meets police clerk Trindade, who decides to venture out into the field, even though it is not his specialty.
title: Get the Goat
plot:
Get the Goat (Portuguese: Cabras da Peste) is a 2021 Brazilian buddy-cop action comedy directed by Vitor Brandt, who wrote it with Denis Nielsen, and produced by Halder Gomes's company Glaz Entretenimento for Netflix. Edmilson Filho, a comedian and former martial-arts champion, stars as the rural policeman Bruceuilis Nonato, opposite Matheus Nachtergaele as the São Paulo officer Renato Trindade, with Letícia Lima as Captain Priscila, the singer Falcão as the congressman Zeca Brito, Leandro Ramos, Evelyn Castro, Juliano Cazarré, Valéria Vitoriano, Eyrio Okura as Ping Li and Victor Allen.

Bruceuilis, named after Bruce Willis, is a fearless, hyper-motivated cop in a sleepy small town where crime rarely goes beyond the theft of an electric fan, yet he treats every call as a matter of life and death, to the constant annoyance of his superiors. Trindade, by contrast, belongs to a special unit in São Paulo but is slight, timid and terrified of getting hurt, and he prefers office work to the street. Both men end up demoted, Trindade after being blamed for a colleague's death.

Fate unites them through a goat. Bruceuilis is entrusted with Celestina, a goat regarded as the heritage of his town and the mascot of an upcoming festival, but she escapes and is taken by a drug dealer who uses her as a courier. Sent to São Paulo to recover her after yet another fiasco, Bruceuilis teams up with Trindade and persuades him to leave his desk for a case that could transform both their careers: stopping the trafficker Ping Li, who is negotiating a huge narcotics deal with a mysterious kingpin known only as Luva Branca (White Glove). Bickering and badly matched, the pair clash with dangerous criminals and with the officers officially in charge of the investigation, and their inexperience turns every step into slapstick as they try to prove themselves heroes.

Netflix released the film on 18 March 2021. Its fights mix boxing, kung fu and karate, with choreography by Gomes and Filho, and its 1980s-style score includes "Calor do Cão," a forró parody of "The Heat Is On" by Gaby Amarantos and Júnior Groovador. Reviewers called it a bright, silly and good-natured comedy that touches on drug trafficking, corrupt politicians and the spread of guns with a light touch; The Upcoming judged it no first-class comedy but an enjoyable diversion.

overview: An undercover cop has his loyalties tested when the boss of the corporate gang he's spent years infiltrating dies.
tagline: Three Men. Three Ways. To A Different World.
title: New World
plot:
New World (Korean: Sinsegye) is a 2013 South Korean crime thriller written and directed by Park Hoon-jung. Lee Jung-jae stars as an undercover policeman who has risen high inside a criminal empire, with Choi Min-sik as the police chief who controls him, Hwang Jung-min as his gangster friend and Park Sung-woong as a rival boss, alongside Song Ji-hyo. A commercial success, it drew about 4.7 million admissions in South Korea and grossed some 31 million dollars.

For eight years Lee Ja-sung has been working undercover inside Goldmoon, the country's biggest criminal organisation disguised as a corporation, living in constant fear of exposure. His superior, Chief Kang, repeatedly promises him a posting abroad and repeatedly breaks his word, and when Ja-sung threatens to quit, Kang reminds him that revealing his identity would mean a painful death. When Goldmoon's chairman is killed in what looks like an accident, two men vie to replace him: Jung Chung, Ja-sung's close friend and boss, backed by the Chinese-Korean Northmoon faction, and the ruthless Lee Joong-gu, backed by the Jaebum faction.

Kang pits the two against each other so that the weak vice-chairman Jang Su-ki can take over and the police can control the group through him. He blackmails Jung into supplying evidence against Joong-gu in return for immunity, then tells the arrested Joong-gu that Jung betrayed him. Joong-gu's men ambush and fatally wound Jung, and also break into Ja-sung's home; his wife survives, but loses their unborn child.

Terrified, Ja-sung begs to be pulled out, but Kang refuses and erases his police records to keep him in place. At the hospital, the dying Jung, who knew all along that Ja-sung was a policeman but kept silent out of friendship, urges him to decide where his loyalty lies. Choosing to survive on his own terms, Ja-sung takes over Jung's faction and wins over Su-ki's men, who kill Su-ki instead of him. On his orders, Kang, the police director and Joong-gu are murdered, burying his secret forever, and he becomes Goldmoon's chairman.

A flashback to six years earlier shows Ja-sung and Jung as young thugs, already inseparable, and Ja-sung smiling for the first time. Critics praised its patient, elegant storytelling, The New York Times calling it more thoughtful than most of its genre.

overview: When Russia's first nuclear submarine malfunctions on its maiden voyage, the crew must race to save the ship and prevent a nuclear disaster.
tagline: Fate has found its hero.
title: K-19: The Widowmaker
plot:
K-19: The Widowmaker is a 2002 American thriller film directed by Kathryn Bigelow, starring Harrison Ford and Liam Neeson.

The main themes of K-19: The Widowmaker revolve around the following:

1. **Tragedy and Human Error**: The movie highlights the catastrophic consequences of human error and the devastating effects of a nuclear accident on the crew and their families. The film's central plot revolves around the near-disaster at the K-19 submarine, which was nearly crippled by a faulty reactor.

2. **Heroism and Sacrifice**: The story showcases the bravery and selflessness of the crew members who risked their lives to prevent a disaster. The characters' actions demonstrate the importance of teamwork, loyalty, and putting the greater good above personal interests.

3. **Cold War Politics and Tensions**: Set against the backdrop of the Cold War era, the film explores the tensions between the United States and the Soviet Union. The K-19's mission to inspect a Soviet submarine serves as a metaphor for the fragile state of international relations during this period.

4. **Personal Struggle and Redemption**: The protagonist, Captain Marko Ramius (Liam Neeson), is a complex character who grapples with his own demons and personal losses. His journey towards redemption serves as a powerful counterpoint to the film's more dramatic events.

5. **The Psychological Toll of Trauma**: The movie delves into the psychological effects of trauma on individuals, particularly those in high-stress professions like military personnel. The characters' experiences serve as a reminder of the long-term consequences of exposure to extreme situations.

Overall, K-19: The Widowmaker is a gripping thriller that explores themes of human error, heroism, and redemption against the backdrop of the Cold War era.

overview: After overhearing a shocking secret, precocious orphan Lyra Belacqua trades her carefree existence roaming the halls of Jordan College for an otherworldly adventure in the far North, unaware that it's part of her destiny.
tagline: There are worlds beyond our own - the compass will show the way.
title: The Golden Compass
plot:
The Golden Compass is a fantasy adventure film directed by Chris Weitz, based on the novel of the same name by Philip Pullman. The movie was released in 2007 and produced by New Line Cinema.

In a parallel universe, humans and talking animals coexist, with humans divided into castes. The story follows Lyra Belacqua (played by Nicole Kidman), a young orphan girl who lives in a world where people's souls take the form of animal companions called daemons. Lyra's daemon is a monkey named Pantalaimon.

The movie begins in a world where humans are forced to wear special uniforms and live in a society controlled by the Magisterium, a powerful organization that seeks to control all aspects of life. The story takes place in a future England, where the Magisterium has outlawed talking animals and anyone who can see them is persecuted.

Lyra's world is turned upside down when she discovers that her friend Roger (played by Dakota Blue Richards) has been kidnapped by the Gobblers, a mysterious organization that is rumored to be experimenting on children. Lyra sets out on a journey to find Roger, accompanied by her daemon Pantalaimon and a group of allies, including Lord Asriel (played by Daniel Craig), a charismatic and enigmatic figure who claims to be her uncle.

As they embark on their perilous journey, Lyra and her companions encounter various obstacles, including the armored bears of the Gyptians, a nomadic people who live in the frozen tundra. They also meet Lee Scoresby (played by Sam Elliott), a Gyptian aeronaut who becomes an ally to Lyra.

Throughout their journey, Lyra learns about the secrets of the Gobblers and the true nature of the Magisterium's control over society. She discovers that the Gobblers are searching for children with special abilities, known as Dust, which is a magical substance that allows humans to breathe in the air of other worlds.

As they near their destination, Lyra and her companions face numerous challenges, including fierce battles with armored bears and treacherous landscapes. Along the way, Lyra also learns about her own destiny and the secrets of her past.

The movie culminates in a dramatic showdown between Lyra and the Gobblers' leader, Mrs. Coulter (played by Jennifer Connelly), who is revealed to be a powerful and ruthless adversary. In the end, Lyra and her companions succeed in defeating the Gobblers and freeing Roger from their clutches.

However, the movie ends on a cliffhanger, with Lyra learning that she has been given a choice: to return to her own world or to enter a parallel universe where she can explore the secrets of Dust. The ending sets the stage for the next installment in the series, which was not produced due to the negative reception of the film.

Overall, The Golden Compass is a thrilling adventure film that explores themes of power, control, and self-discovery. With its richly imagined world and memorable characters, it has become a beloved classic among fans of fantasy literature and cinema.

overview: Get ready for Barbie: A Fairy Secret, an amazing adventure with Barbie where she discovers there are fairies living secretly all around us! When Ken is suddenly whisked away by a group of fairies, Barbie's two fashion stylist friends reveal they are actually fairies and that Ken has been taken to a magical secret fairy world not far away! Barbie and her rival Raquelle take off with the fairy friends on an action-packed journey to bring him back. Along the way they must stick together and learn that the real magic lies not just in the fairy world itself, but in the power of friendship.
title: Barbie: A Fairy Secret
plot:
Barbie: A Fairy Secret is a 2011 animated fantasy film directed by William Lau, written by Elise Allen and produced by Rainmaker Entertainment, the nineteenth entry in the Barbie film series. Diana Kaarina returns as the voice of Barbie, with Adrian Petriw as Ken, and the story shares its world with Barbie: A Fashion Fairytale (2010). It was released on DVD on March 15, 2011, and premiered on Nickelodeon the following month.

Barbie is attending the premiere of her latest film with her actor boyfriend Ken when her co-star and rival Raquelle steps on her gown and tears it. Her stylists Carrie and Taylor, who are secretly fairies, repair it with magic. A photographer named Crystal takes a picture of Ken and returns to Gloss Angeles, a hidden realm of fairies, where she shows it to Princess Graciella after slipping a love potion into her tea. The princess instantly falls for Ken, and the next day, during a quarrel between Barbie and Raquelle, Graciella and her attendants swoop in and carry him off through a portal.

Carrie and Taylor are forced to admit to the astonished Barbie and Raquelle that fairies exist, and explain that if a human marries a fairy, he must remain in the fairy world forever. In Gloss Angeles, Ken faces the fury of Graciella's boyfriend Zane, who challenges him to a series of duels. Barbie, Raquelle and the stylists travel by a magical Fairy Flyway to Paris, where the renowned fashion critic Lilianna Roxelle, the oldest and wisest fairy on Earth, reveals that the princess is under a love spell and gives Barbie an antidote. She also reveals that Carrie and Taylor were banished from the fairy realm.

In Gloss Angeles, the group buy fake wings and disguise themselves as cooks to reach the princess, but Crystal unmasks them and they are imprisoned. Trapped together, Barbie and Raquelle finally talk, and Raquelle admits she was hostile only because she never had the chance to be Barbie's friend. Their reconciliation breaks their prison and gives them real wings. They interrupt the wedding and Barbie sprinkles the antidote over Graciella.

Freed from the spell, the princess realises Crystal's deception and explains that she banished Carrie and Taylor because she felt abandoned by her old friends, and the three reconcile. Graciella marries Zane, punishes Crystal and sends the humans home, erasing their memories. Barbie wakes believing it was all a dream, but she and Raquelle are now friends, and Carrie and Taylor fly back to Gloss Angeles.

overview: The Fixies are little creatures that, unseen by humans, help them maintain their appliances – and generally make sure things don’t fall apart… Until an unexpected occurrence of gargantuan proportions threatens to reveal the Fixies’ existence!
title: The Fixies: Top Secret
plot:
The Fixies: Top Secret (Fiksiki: Bolshoy sekret) is a 2017 Russian animated family comedy produced by the Aeroplane studio with Blitz Film and based on the popular television series The Fixies, about tiny people who secretly live inside household appliances and repair them. Directed by Vasiko Bedoshvili, Andrey Kolpin and Ivan Pshonkin from a screenplay by Georgy Vasilyev and Evgeny Antropov, it features the voices of Aleksandr Pushnoy, Dmitri Nazarov, Larisa Brokhman, Prokhor Chekhovskoy and Varvara Obidor.

The boy DimDimych, a friend of the Fixies, watches his father, a television host, present a show arguing that little people really exist. At the laboratory of the eccentric inventor Professor Chudakov, his assistant Lizonka believes every word of the program, and when the mischievous young Fixie Fire plays tricks on her, she becomes determined to prove the creatures are real and get rid of them. Chudakov then unveils a new invention: energy bracelets that let the Fixies travel through electrical wires into people's homes to carry out "remote repairs", a service he hopes will fund a new laboratory.

Through the professor's carelessness, the bracelets end up with Fire, who is gradually warped by the electricity into a menace, racing through the wires, nearly killing his classmate Verta and finally losing his mind and wrecking DimDimych's family apartment. While the Fixies Simka and Nolik and the elder Fixie Dedus try to catch him, Lizonka summons DimDimych's father to film the little people. DimDimych rushes to the lab to warn his friends, followed by his classmate Katya, who suspects he is hiding a secret, and the humans end up locked in a storeroom when Fire starts a fire. Nolik finds the key, cuts the power to trap Fire inside a socket and saves the day, while the Fixies avoid discovery by turning into tiny screws. Back home, DimDimych and Katya distract the adults by announcing they want to get married while Fire erases the incriminating video, and the cured Fire rejoins his friends as broken equipment around the city begins mysteriously repairing itself.

The film premiered on 27 October 2017 at the Oktyabr cinema in Moscow, opening the Big Cartoon Festival, and was released the following day. Critics called it a worthy feature debut for the studio and praised its colorful graphics, characters and ironic humor, though one regretted that it lacked the educational content of the series. A sequel, The Fixies vs. the Crabots, followed in 2019.

original_title: The Strange Thing About the Johnsons
overview: A dark domestic melodrama about the ties that bind and the ties that really bind.
title: The Strange Thing About the Johnsons
plot:
The Strange Thing About the Johnsons is a 2011 American short psychological horror film written and directed by Ari Aster as his thesis project at the AFI Conservatory. It stars Billy Mayo as Sidney Johnson, an acclaimed poet, Brandon Greenhouse as his son Isaiah and Angela Bullock as his wife Joan, with Danièle Watts as Isaiah's wife Marianne. The film depicts a suburban family in which the father is the victim of long-term sexual abuse by his own son, inverting the more familiar narrative of parental abuse.

In 1995, Sidney accidentally walks in on his twelve-year-old son and reassures him that what he was doing is natural, unaware of the disturbing nature of the boy's fixation on him. Years later, on Isaiah's wedding day, Joan discovers her son abusing her distraught husband. Shaken, she tries to carry on as though nothing has happened, while the family continues to maintain a respectable facade.

Sidney secretly writes a memoir titled Cocoon Man, describing the abuse he has suffered at the hands of his son, and leaves a copy for Joan. When Isaiah discovers it, he threatens his father and forbids him from distributing it. The abuse escalates, and Joan, unable or unwilling to intervene, ignores the signs. When Sidney tries to escape the house with a copy of his memoir, a confrontation with Isaiah ends in tragedy. After Sidney's death, Joan finally confronts her son about what he has done, leading to a violent and devastating conclusion between mother and son.

The film is known for its extremely disturbing subject matter, presented with the restrained, carefully composed style and atmosphere of dread that would later characterize Aster's features, and it explores family denial, silence and complicity.

The short premiered at the Slamdance Film Festival on January 22, 2011, and screened at other festivals before leaking online in November 2011, when it went viral. Reactions were polarized, ranging from acclaim to disgust, and the film also drew controversy over its depiction of an African-American family by a white filmmaker, which Aster addressed in interviews.

overview: A boy growing up in Dublin during the 1980s escapes his strained family life by starting a band to impress the mysterious girl he likes.
tagline: Boy meets girl. Girl unimpressed. Boy starts band.
title: Sing Street
plot:
Sing Street is a 2016 musical comedy-drama film that tells the story of a young boy named Conor who forms a band to impress a girl he likes and to escape his difficult home life. The movie explores themes of identity, creativity, and self-discovery.

At its core, Sing Street is a coming-of-age story about a teenager struggling to find his place in the world. Conor's journey is marked by a desire to break free from the constraints of his mundane suburban life and to express himself through music. As he navigates the complexities of adolescence, Conor must confront his own insecurities and learn to believe in himself.

The film also delves into the theme of creativity as a means of empowerment. Conor's band becomes an outlet for him to channel his emotions and to assert his individuality. Through music, he is able to express himself in ways that feel authentic and meaningful to him.

Furthermore, Sing Street touches on the idea of first love and the vulnerability that comes with it. Conor's relationships with the girls in his life, particularly Raphina, are fraught with uncertainty and anxiety. The film captures the intensity and excitement of young love, as well as the pain and heartache that can accompany it.

Ultimately, Sing Street is a movie about finding one's own voice and embracing the imperfections that make us unique. Through Conor's story, the film shows that it's okay to be different and that creativity, self-expression, and vulnerability are essential components of a fulfilling life.

overview: Dirty tricks stand to soil an ambitious young press spokesman's idealism in a cutthroat presidential campaign where 'victory' is relative.
tagline: Ambition seduces. Power corrupts.
title: The Ides of March
plot:
The Ides of March is a 2011 American political drama directed by George Clooney from a screenplay by Clooney, Grant Heslov and Beau Willimon, adapted from Willimon's 2008 play Farragut North. It stars Ryan Gosling as press secretary Stephen Meyers and Clooney as Governor Mike Morris, with Philip Seymour Hoffman as campaign manager Paul Zara, Paul Giamatti as rival campaign manager Tom Duffy, Marisa Tomei as New York Times reporter Ida Horowicz, Jeffrey Wright as Senator Franklin Thompson and Evan Rachel Wood as the intern Molly Stearns.

Stephen Meyers is a gifted young political operative serving as junior campaign manager for Mike Morris, the charismatic Democratic governor of Pennsylvania, who is competing in the presidential primaries. Unlike his cynical boss Paul Zara, Stephen genuinely believes in Morris and his ideals. Days before the crucial Ohio primary, the campaign is pursuing the endorsement of North Carolina senator Franklin Thompson, whose delegates could secure the nomination.

Stephen agrees to a secret meeting with Tom Duffy, the campaign manager of Morris's rival Ted Pullman, who tries to recruit him and reveals that Pullman has won over Thompson by promising him a cabinet post. Stephen urges Morris to make a similar deal, but the governor refuses on principle. Meanwhile, Stephen begins an affair with Molly Stearns, a campaign intern and the daughter of the chairman of the Democratic National Committee, and stumbles upon a secret that could destroy Morris's candidacy. When news of his meeting with Duffy leaks, Stephen finds himself betrayed by people he trusted, and he must decide how far he is willing to go, and how much of his idealism he is willing to sacrifice, to save his career.

The film examines the compromises and moral corruption at the heart of electoral politics, tracing the transformation of an idealist into a ruthless player.

The Ides of March opened the 68th Venice International Film Festival and was released in theaters on October 7, 2011, grossing about 76 million dollars worldwide. It received positive reviews, with 84 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised it as supremely well-acted drama, and a Metacritic score of 67. Clooney, Heslov and Willimon were nominated for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay.

overview: An aimless teenager on the outer edges of Brooklyn struggles to escape his bleak home life and navigate questions of self-identity, as he balances his time between his delinquent friends, a potential new girlfriend, and older men he meets online.
title: Beach Rats
plot:
Beach Rats is a 2017 coming-of-age drama film that explores the complexities of adolescence, identity, and the struggles of growing up. The movie delves into the life of Frankie, a charismatic but troubled teenager who navigates his relationships with friends, family, and himself.

At its core, Beach Rats is a poignant portrayal of the fragility and uncertainty of youth. Frankie's journey is marked by self-discovery, as he grapples with his own desires, insecurities, and sense of belonging. The film masterfully captures the turmoil and confusion that often accompany adolescence, where individuals are still figuring out their place in the world.

One of the primary themes of Beach Rats is the struggle for identity, particularly among young men who feel pressure to conform to societal expectations or forge their own paths. Frankie's relationships with his friends and romantic interests serve as a catalyst for exploring these themes, highlighting the tensions between vulnerability and protection, intimacy and isolation.

The film also touches on the theme of masculinity, which is expertly woven throughout Frankie's narrative. His struggles with traditional masculine norms and expectations are juxtaposed with his own desires and vulnerabilities, creating a nuanced exploration of what it means to be a man.

Furthermore, Beach Rats explores the complexities of family dynamics and the ways in which they can both support and suffocate individuals. Frankie's relationships with his parents and siblings serve as a microcosm for the broader themes of identity, belonging, and self-discovery.

Ultimately, Beach Rats is a powerful and poignant portrayal of adolescence, one that captures the messy, often painful, and ultimately transformative nature of growing up.

overview: A supernatural love story that centers on two parents whose life together falls apart after their son dies. The man, now a successful lawyer, and the woman, now married and an author, get a chance at reconciliation ten years later.
tagline: Love never dies
title: The Keeping Hours
plot:
The Keeping Hours is a 2017 American supernatural drama directed by Karen Moncrieff and written by Rebecca Sonnenshine. It stars Lee Pace as Mark Bennett and Carrie Coon as Elizabeth Welles, a divorced couple, with Sander Thomas as their son Jacob, Ray Baker, Amy Smart and Ana Ortiz. The film tells the story of grieving parents who are given an unexpected chance to reconnect through the ghost of their dead child.

Mark and Elizabeth were once a happy couple who, after years together and the birth of their son Jacob, finally married in a joyful ceremony at their home. Some time later, Jacob was killed in a car accident while Mark was driving, and Elizabeth believes she failed to fasten the boy's seat belt properly. Consumed by guilt and blaming each other, the couple divorced. Some years later, Mark is a busy attorney at a large law firm, while Elizabeth has remarried, written a book and moved on to a new life with her stepdaughters.

When the tenants of the couple's former home abandon it, Mark goes to inspect the house and encounters flickering lights, strange noises and toys in the attic, before coming face to face with Jacob's ghost. After the shock wears off, Mark accepts that his son has returned. When Jacob asks for his mother, Mark brings Elizabeth to the house; at first she believes he is playing a cruel trick on her, but she too sees the boy. Although neither parent can touch him, they begin spending their days with Jacob, reading him stories, playing games and making up for lost time, and as they do so the former spouses grow close again. Jacob reveals the truth about the accident, helping his parents let go of their guilt, while signs emerge that his presence may be connected to a fate still awaiting one of them.

The film is a quiet, emotional ghost story about grief, forgiveness and second chances rather than a conventional horror film.

The Keeping Hours was released by Universal Pictures on video on demand on July 24, 2018, followed by a DVD release on August 7, 2018.

original_title: ワンピース フィルム ゼット
overview: Zephyr, now known as Z, rides the seas with only one goal: Destroy all pirates and their dreams at becoming King of Pirates. When Luffy and his crew encounter him at sea, not only are they utterly defeated by the man with an arm made of Seastone, Nami, Robin, and Chopper are turned 10 years younger due to Z's minion Ain. Luffy is so determined to win against him that he does not even notice Z's master plan that could sacrifice thousands of lives.
tagline: The most wanted pirate in history... is about to save the world!
title: One Piece Film: Z
plot:
One Piece Film: Z is a 2012 Japanese animated adventure film directed by Konosuke Uda and produced by Toei Animation. The film is based on the popular manga and anime series "One Piece" created by Eiichiro Oda.

The story takes place after the events of the Dressrosa Arc in the One Piece manga and anime series. The film follows Monkey D. Luffy, the main protagonist, who has just defeated Donquixote Doflamingo, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. However, during the battle, Luffy's body is severely damaged, and he is left with a mysterious power known as "Zou" that allows him to transform into a powerful, giant monkey-like creature.

As Luffy struggles to control his newfound powers, he sets out on a journey to find the legendary "Will of D." (WOD), a group of individuals who possess a unique genetic mark that grants them incredible abilities. Luffy believes that finding the WOD will help him understand and control his Zou power.

Along the way, Luffy meets a young girl named Nami, who is on a quest to find her long-lost brother, Ace, who was killed by Doflamingo. Together, they embark on a perilous journey across the seas, facing various enemies and obstacles along the way.

As they near their destination, Luffy and Nami discover that the WOD are being hunted by the World Government, which seeks to exploit their powers for its own gain. The duo must use all their skills and cunning to evade capture and reach the WOD before it's too late.

Throughout the film, Luffy's character development is on full display as he grapples with his newfound powers and the weight of his responsibilities as a pirate. His relationships with Nami and other characters are also explored in depth, adding an emotional layer to the story.

The film features stunning animation, epic battles, and heart-pumping action sequences that showcase the One Piece universe's signature blend of humor, drama, and adventure. The movie's climax is particularly memorable, as Luffy faces off against a powerful foe who pushes him to his limits.

Ultimately, Luffy discovers that he has become one of the WOD, and with this newfound understanding, he gains the power to control his Zou abilities. The film concludes on a hopeful note, setting the stage for future adventures in the One Piece universe.

Overall, One Piece Film: Z is an exciting and action-packed addition to the One Piece franchise, offering fans a thrilling ride filled with memorable characters, epic battles, and heartwarming moments of character development.

overview: Based on the Korean legend, unknown creatures will return and devastate the planet. Reporter Ethan Kendrick is called in to investigate the matter.
tagline: They've made our world their battleground.
title: Dragon Wars: D-War
plot:
D-War, released in North America as Dragon Wars: D-War, is a 2007 fantasy monster film written and directed by the South Korean filmmaker Shim Hyung-rae. Inspired by Korean legends of the Imugi, giant serpents that may become dragons, it stars Jason Behr, Amanda Brooks, Robert Forster, Craig Robinson, Aimee Garcia and Elizabeth Peña. A South Korean and American co-production made by a largely Korean crew in the United States, it was at the time the most expensive South Korean film ever made.

As a boy in Los Angeles, Ethan Kendrick is told by a mysterious antiques dealer, Jack, that he is the reincarnation of Haram, a young warrior who five hundred years ago was charged with protecting the Yuh Yi Joo, a girl born with the power to transform a chosen Imugi into a celestial dragon. In that earlier life, Haram and the girl chose to die together rather than let her be taken by Buraki, an evil Imugi seeking the power for itself. Jack gives Ethan Haram's medallion and tells him that the reborn Yuh Yi Joo, Sarah Daniels, will appear in Los Angeles.

Fifteen years later, Ethan is a television journalist when a series of strange events signals Buraki's return. He tracks down Sarah, now a young woman troubled by a mysterious mark on her shoulder, and saves her from an attack, explaining her destiny. As the two flee, they gradually recover memories of their past lives. Buraki, a gigantic serpent, rampages through the city, while its Atrox Army of armoured warriors, raptor-like beasts, winged dragons called Bulcos and huge rocket-bearing reptiles battles the police and the US Army, overwhelming the human forces.

Ethan and Sarah are captured by the Bulcos and carried to a fortress in a dark desert landscape. As Buraki moves to devour Sarah, Ethan's medallion unleashes a force that destroys the Atrox Army. The good Imugi, destined to receive Sarah's power, emerges to fight Buraki and appears to be beaten, but Sarah offers herself to it instead, and it transforms into a celestial dragon that destroys Buraki in flames. Sarah's spirit promises Ethan that they will meet again before the dragon carries her into the heavens, and Jack reappears to tell Ethan they have witnessed a great honour.

A major hit in South Korea, the film grossed over 44 million dollars there, though critics were harsh, giving it 28% approval on Rotten Tomatoes while acknowledging its special effects.

overview: A wildly inventive deconstruction of the romantic comedy built around the question: What would you do if you could travel to your loved ones’ past, heal their traumas, fix their problems, and change them into the perfect partner?
title: Meet Cute
plot:
Meet Cute is a 2022 American romantic dark comedy directed by Alex Lehmann. Kaley Cuoco and Pete Davidson star as a woman who uses a time machine to relive a perfect first date over and over and the man she keeps meeting. Filmed in New York City in August 2021, it was released digitally on Peacock on September 21, 2022.

In Manhattan, Sheila discovers that a tanning bed in the back of a nail salon run by a woman named June is actually a time machine that sends her back one day. One evening she meets Gary, a gentle, slightly awkward man, in a bar. Their date is a delight: they share the same taste in drinks, trade stories about their childhoods and find an easy rapport. During the evening, Sheila casually tells Gary that she has been reliving this same night repeatedly, and the two part on warm terms.

Over the course of months of resets, Sheila reveals more. She first used the machine on the day she had planned to take her own life by jumping from the Manhattan Bridge, and her first date with Gary made her feel happy for the first time in years, so she keeps returning to it. She also mentions a kind cable repairman who was nice to her as a child, without knowing why the memory stays with her. When she tells Gary she loves him, it unsettles him.

After hundreds of identical evenings, Sheila grows restless and decides to improve Gary by traveling further back into his past. Posing as a neighbor, "Uncle Charlie," she gets the young Gary interested in sports and removes several negative influences from his life, turning him into a confident, successful businessman. When she admits what she has done, Gary is horrified, and although Sheila restores his original past, he begins experiencing déjà vu and pieces together the truth. Using what he has learned, Gary travels back in time himself in an attempt to help the young Sheila, and he turns out to have been the cable repairman who showed her kindness when she was a girl.

Realizing that endlessly reliving the same day no longer brings her joy, Sheila returns to the bridge. Alerted by June, Gary catches up with her and convinces her that the future is worth seeing, telling her that they meet again tomorrow. Sheila follows him off the bridge, and as the sun rises, the two begin a genuinely new day together.

Reviews were mixed; Rotten Tomatoes reported 59% approval, and Metacritic gave it 50 out of 100.

overview: Two police officers struggle to survive when they become trapped beneath the rubble of the World Trade Center on September 11, 2001.
tagline: The world saw evil that day. Two men saw something else.
title: World Trade Center
plot:
World Trade Center is a 2006 American biographical drama film directed by Oliver Stone, based on the true story of two Port Authority police officers who were trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center on September 11, 2001.

The film begins with the introduction of two Port Authority police officers, WTC Police Officers John McLoughlin (played by Nicolas Cage) and Will Jimeno (played by Michael Peña), who are part of a team that patrols the underground tunnels beneath the World Trade Center. The story takes us back to 1993, when McLoughlin is still a rookie cop, and he meets his future partner, Jimeno.

The film then cuts to September 11, 2001, as the two officers are on duty in the underground tunnels. As the first plane hits the North Tower, they quickly realize that something catastrophic has occurred. The situation escalates rapidly, and the two officers find themselves trapped beneath the rubble of the World Trade Center.

The plot development is intense and suspenseful as McLoughlin and Jimeno struggle to survive against all odds. They use their training and ingenuity to navigate through the treacherous terrain, avoiding falling debris and toxic gases. As they search for a way out, they come across other survivors who are also trapped in the rubble.

As the hours tick by, McLoughlin and Jimeno face numerous challenges, including a collapsed elevator shaft that separates them, and a massive concrete slab that threatens to crush them. Despite these obstacles, they remain determined to find each other and escape alive.

The film's climax features an intense and emotional rescue effort, as McLoughlin is finally pulled out of the rubble by his colleagues. However, Jimeno remains trapped beneath the debris, and McLoughlin must make a desperate decision to save his partner. In a heart-wrenching moment, McLoughlin chooses to stay with Jimeno, refusing to leave him behind.

The ending is both poignant and uplifting, as McLoughlin's bravery and selflessness are celebrated by his colleagues and the public. The film concludes with a tribute to the real-life heroes who were trapped in the World Trade Center on that fateful day, including John McLoughlin and Will Jimeno.

Throughout the film, Oliver Stone masterfully weaves together the true story of McLoughlin and Jimeno's bravery and sacrifice, creating a powerful and emotional cinematic experience. The performances by Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña are outstanding, bringing depth and nuance to their characters. Overall, World Trade Center is a gripping and inspiring drama that honors the memory of those who lost their lives on September 11, 2001.

original_title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
overview: Once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corporation, Raccoon City is now a dying Midwestern town. The company’s exodus left the city a wasteland…with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, the townspeople are forever…changed…and a small group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.
tagline: Witness the beginning of evil.
title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
plot:
Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City is a 2021 horror film directed by Johannes Roberts, based on the popular video game series of the same name. The movie takes place in 1998 and follows two main characters: Chris Redfield (Keanu Reeves) and Jill Valentine (Milla Jovovich).

The story begins with a mysterious virus outbreak in Raccoon City, which is home to the Umbrella Corporation, a powerful biotechnology company. As the virus spreads rapidly, the city descends into chaos, and the authorities are powerless to stop it.

Chris Redfield, a member of an elite law enforcement agency known as S.T.A.R.S., is sent to Raccoon City to investigate the outbreak. He soon discovers that the virus is not just a simple biological agent but a highly contagious and deadly pathogen created by Umbrella's sinister experiments.

Meanwhile, Jill Valentine, also a member of S.T.A.R.S., arrives in Raccoon City with her partner, Rebecca Chambers (Avan Jogia). As they try to contain the outbreak, they are ambushed by hordes of undead creatures, including zombies and more terrifying monsters known as "T-virus" infected humans.

As Chris and Jill navigate the treacherous streets of Raccoon City, they uncover a sinister plot by Umbrella to cover up their involvement in the outbreak. The company's true intentions are revealed, and the two protagonists must fight for survival against not only the undead but also the corporation's ruthless agents.

Throughout the movie, Roberts pays homage to the original Resident Evil games while introducing new characters and storylines. The film features plenty of action, suspense, and horror elements, making it a thrilling ride for fans of the franchise.

However, some fans may notice that the movie deviates from the original storyline in certain ways, particularly with regards to Jill's character development and the ending. Nevertheless, Welcome to Raccoon City remains an entertaining adaptation that stays true to the spirit of the Resident Evil series.

Overall, Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City is a fun, action-packed horror film that will appeal to fans of the franchise and newcomers alike.

overview: All grown up in post-apocalyptic 2018, John Connor must lead the resistance of humans against the increasingly dominating militaristic robots. But when Marcus Wright appears, his existence confuses the mission as Connor tries to determine whether Wright has come from the future or the past -- and whether he's friend or foe.
tagline: The End Begins.
title: Terminator Salvation
plot:
Terminator Salvation is a 2009 science fiction action film directed by McG and written by David S. Goyer. The movie takes place in a post-apocalyptic future where humanity is on the brink of extinction.

The story begins with John Connor (Christian Bale), the future leader of the human resistance, living in hiding with his mother Sarah (Sam Neill) in a desolate wasteland. However, their sanctuary is disrupted by a group of machines that have infiltrated the area, seeking to eliminate John and anyone else who could potentially lead humanity's fight for survival.

As the machines close in, John and Sarah are forced to flee, leaving behind their home and the only life they've known. They embark on a perilous journey across the United States, pursued by a relentless Terminator (Sam Worthington), a cyborg assassin sent back in time to kill John before he can become the leader of the human resistance.

Along the way, John meets Kate Brewster (Antonia Zeller), a young woman who becomes his ally and potential love interest. As they navigate the treacherous landscape, they are aided by Marcus Wright (Samuel L. Jackson), a mysterious man with a troubled past who may hold the key to humanity's survival.

As the stakes grow higher, John discovers that he is not just a target for the machines but also a crucial component in their plan to destroy humanity. He learns that his mother has been working on a top-secret project to develop a new technology that could potentially defeat the machines once and for all.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when John's group encounters a rogue Terminator (Bryan Cranston) who is working against the machines, providing them with crucial information about their plans. This unexpected ally proves to be a game-changer in the battle between humans and machines.

As the story unfolds, John and his companions face numerous challenges and obstacles as they fight to survive in a world that seems determined to destroy them. The movie culminates in an epic showdown between John and the Terminator, with the fate of humanity hanging precariously in the balance.

Ultimately, John emerges victorious, but not without scars. He comes to terms with his destiny as the leader of the human resistance and vows to continue fighting against the machines. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the darkest of times, there is always a glimmer of hope for humanity's survival.

Overall, Terminator Salvation is an action-packed thrill ride that explores themes of sacrifice, redemption, and the human condition. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the movie remains a fan favorite among sci-fi enthusiasts and action junkies alike.

overview: Serial Killer Michael Myers is not finished with Laurie Strode, and their rivalry finally comes to an end. But is this the last we see of Myers? Freddie Harris and Nora Winston are reality programmers at DangerTainment, and are planning to send a group of 6 thrill-seeking teenagers into the childhood home of Myers. Cameras are placed all over the house and no one can get out of the house... and then Michael arrives home!
tagline: Evil finds its way home
title: Halloween: Resurrection
plot:
Halloween: Resurrection is a 2002 American slasher film directed by Rick Rosenthal, who had also directed Halloween II (1981), from a screenplay by Larry Brand and Sean Hood. The eighth installment of the Halloween franchise and the sequel to Halloween H20: 20 Years Later (1998), it stars Busta Rhymes, Bianca Kajlich, Thomas Ian Nicholas, Ryan Merriman, Sean Patrick Thomas, Tyra Banks and Katee Sackhoff, with Jamie Lee Curtis returning briefly as Laurie Strode and Brad Loree as Michael Myers. It was the last entry in the H20 continuity before the series was remade in 2007 and rebooted again in 2018.

Three years after the massacre at Hillcrest Academy, a guilt-stricken Laurie Strode is confined to a psychiatric sanitarium. It is revealed that the man she decapitated at the end of the previous film was not her brother but a paramedic whom Michael had disguised in his mask and crushed so that he could not speak. Expecting Michael to come for her, Laurie sets a trap on the sanitarium roof. Michael kills two guards and pursues her upstairs, where the trap catches him, but Laurie, terrified of killing the wrong man again, tries to remove his mask to check his identity. Michael seizes the chance, stabs her and throws her from the roof to her death.

A year later, a group of college students, among them Sara Moyer, Bill, Donna, Jen, Jim and Rudy, win a place on Dangertainment, an internet reality show run by the entrepreneur Freddie Harris and his producer Nora. The students are to spend Halloween night in Michael Myers's abandoned childhood home in Haddonfield, wearing head-mounted cameras, to uncover what drove him to kill. While cameras are being installed, a crew member is murdered by Michael, who has returned home. On Halloween the students enter the house and split up to search for clues, while Sara stays in touch by text with Myles "Deckard" Barton, an online friend watching the live broadcast at a party. The hoax planned by the producers quickly turns into a real slaughter, as Michael begins killing the participants one by one on camera, and the audience watching online gradually realizes that the murders are real.

Halloween: Resurrection was panned by critics, who criticized its premise, its treatment of Laurie Strode and its reality-television gimmick, and it is often ranked among the weakest films in the franchise. It nevertheless grossed about $37 million worldwide against a modest budget, turning a profit.

original_title: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie
overview: Two mischievous kids hypnotize their mean elementary school principal and turn him into their comic book creation, the kind-hearted and elastic-banded Captain Underpants.
title: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie
plot:
Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie is a 2017 animated adventure comedy film directed by David Sardis, based on the popular children's book series by Dav Pilkey. The movie follows the story of two fourth-grade pranksters, George Beard (voiced by Asher Angel) and Harold Hutchins (voiced by Jordan Reed), who accidentally hypnotize their mean principal, Mr. Krupp (voiced by Nick Offerman).

The film begins with George and Harold trying to outdo each other in a series of pranks, which ultimately lead them to hypnotize Mr. Krupp during a school assembly. The hypnotized principal is transformed into Captain Underpants, a superhero alter ego created by the boys' imaginations.

As Captain Underpants, the boys must stop an evil scientist, Professor Poopypants (voiced by Kristen Schaal), who has taken over the city's water supply and turned its citizens into giant chickens. The professor plans to use the mind-controlling water to take over the world.

George and Harold soon discover that they are the only ones who can control Captain Underpants' actions, as he is unable to speak or move on his own. They embark on a series of adventures to stop Professor Poopypants and save the city from her evil plans.

Throughout their journey, George and Harold learn valuable lessons about teamwork, friendship, and responsibility. Meanwhile, they also have to deal with the challenges of being superheroes, including navigating Captain Underpants' unpredictable behavior and dealing with the consequences of his actions.

As the story unfolds, George and Harold face off against Professor Poopypants in an epic battle to save the city. Along the way, they are aided by a group of allies, including a talking toilet named Mr. Garbage (voiced by Ed Helms) and a mysterious woman who claims to be Captain Underpants' love interest.

In the end, George and Harold successfully defeat Professor Poopypants and shatter her mind-control device, freeing the city from her grasp. However, they soon realize that their adventure has come to an end, and they must return to their normal lives as fourth-grade students.

The movie concludes with a heartwarming moment of friendship between George and Harold, as they reflect on their incredible adventure and the lessons they learned along the way. The film ends on a high note, setting the stage for future adventures in the Captain Underpants series.

Overall, Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie is a hilarious and action-packed animated adventure that brings the beloved book series to life. With its colorful characters, witty humor, and exciting plot twists, this movie is sure to delight both kids and adults alike.

original_title: The Prince & Me: A Royal Honeymoon
overview: At last! The newly crowned King of Denmark, Edward, and his wife and Queen, Dr. Paige Morgan, find time to fly to Belavia for their secret honeymoon. What better way to spend the Christmas holidays than at a fabulous ski resort? But as they take a tour of Belavia's natural beauty, Eddie and Paige discover that the evil Prime Minister Polonius has given orders to bulldoze the precious forests - to drill for oil. Then, the couple bump into Paige's ex-boyfriend, Scott. Eddie immediately becomes jealous - furthermore he suspects Scott cannot be trusted. Paige and Eddie must do everything they can to save the forest, even if it means putting aside their honeymoon.
title: The Prince & Me: A Royal Honeymoon
plot:
The Prince & Me: A Royal Honeymoon is a romantic comedy film that explores the challenges and joys of royal life, love, and identity. At its core, the movie delves into the theme of self-discovery, as Princess Charlotte's journey from being a sheltered princess to becoming a confident individual is put to the test.

The film also touches on the idea of cultural differences and the importance of understanding and respecting each other's backgrounds. The contrast between Charlotte's traditional Danish upbringing and her American fiancé Prince Edward's more modern approach to royal life serves as a catalyst for growth and learning.

Furthermore, the movie examines the complexities of love and relationships, particularly in the context of royal duties and expectations. As Charlotte navigates her feelings for Prince Edward, she must also confront the pressures of royal protocol and the scrutiny that comes with being part of the royal family.

Ultimately, The Prince & Me: A Royal Honeymoon is a heartwarming tale about embracing one's true self, finding love, and learning to balance individuality with responsibility.

overview: Two seemingly unconnected souls from different corners of the United States make a telepathic bond that allows them to see, hear and feel the other's experiences, creating a bond that apparently can't be broken.
tagline: Two strangers. One extraordinary connection.
title: In Your Eyes
plot:
In Your Eyes is a 2014 American independent paranormal romance directed by Brin Hill and written by Joss Whedon, the second feature produced by Whedon's company Bellwether Pictures. It stars Zoe Kazan as Rebecca Porter and Michael Stahl-David as Dylan Kershaw, with Nikki Reed, Steve Harris, Mark Feuerstein as Rebecca's husband Phillip and Jennifer Grey. The film follows two strangers living on opposite sides of the United States who share an inexplicable psychic connection.

As children, Rebecca, in New Hampshire, and Dylan, in New Mexico, experience a strange moment of connection: when Rebecca crashes her sled and is knocked unconscious, Dylan is thrown from his school desk at the same instant. Twenty years later, Rebecca is married to Phillip, a successful and controlling doctor, while Dylan has recently been released from prison and is trying to stay out of trouble. One night Dylan is hit with a pool cue in a bar fight, and Rebecca, far away at a dinner party, is suddenly flung to the floor, to her husband's embarrassment.

The two soon discover that they can hear each other when they speak aloud, see what the other sees and feel what the other feels. Convinced that they are not imagining it, they begin talking every day, showing each other their surroundings, sharing memories and dreams, and introducing themselves by looking into mirrors. The bond becomes a source of comfort and intimacy for two lonely people, and they gradually fall in love. But their connection attracts unwelcome attention: Rebecca's strange behavior alarms her husband, who eventually has her forcibly institutionalized, while Dylan's parole and his old associates threaten his fresh start, and the two must find a way to be together despite the distance separating them.

The film combines romance with a light supernatural premise, focusing on the intimacy of a relationship built entirely on conversation and shared perception.

In Your Eyes premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on April 20, 2014, and immediately afterward was self-distributed online rather than receiving a theatrical release. It received mixed to positive reviews, with 61 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes; ScreenDaily praised its balance of humour, tenderness and danger.

overview: An ex-soldier, a teen and a cop collide in New Orleans as they hunt for the source behind a dangerous new pill that grants users temporary superpowers.
tagline: What would you risk for five minutes of pure power?
title: Project Power
plot:
Project Power is a 2020 American science fiction action film directed by Henry Joost and Ariel Schulman and written by Mattson Tomlin. It stars Jamie Foxx as Art, a former soldier, Joseph Gordon-Levitt as New Orleans police officer Frank Shaver and Dominique Fishback as Robin Reilly, a teenage dealer, with Colson Baker, Rodrigo Santoro, Amy Landecker and Allen Maldonado. The story centers on a pill that gives its user a unique superpower for five minutes.

In near-future New Orleans, a mysterious supplier begins distributing a pill called Power for free to local drug dealers. Each user gains a random superpower for five minutes, based on abilities found in the animal kingdom, but the effects are unpredictable and sometimes fatal. Robin, a bright teenager who deals the drug to pay for her mother's medical care, is friends with Frank Shaver, a police officer who secretly uses Power himself, which makes him bulletproof, to keep up with the criminals. Frank's superiors tell him that powerful figures want the investigation into the drug shut down and give him the photograph of a suspect: Art.

Art, in fact, is not the source of the drug but a former U.S. Army major who was one of its first test subjects. He is searching for his daughter Tracy, who was born with powers as a result of his treatment and was kidnapped by Teleios, the shadowy defense contractor behind Power, which is using New Orleans as a testing ground for its product. Art forces Robin to help him find the distributor, and the two form an unlikely bond. With Frank on their trail and Teleios preparing to sell the drug to a potential buyer, the three must join forces to expose the conspiracy and rescue Tracy.

The film uses its premise to comment on pharmaceutical exploitation and on the treatment of poor communities as test subjects, and it was praised for Fishback's breakout performance.

Project Power was released on Netflix on August 14, 2020. It received mixed to positive reviews, with 61 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus highlighted a star-making turn from Fishback, and a Metacritic score of 51.

original_title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
overview: One year after their incredible adventures in the Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, Peter, Edmund, Lucy and Susan Pevensie return to Narnia to aid a young prince whose life has been threatened by the evil King Miraz. Now, with the help of a colorful cast of new characters, including Trufflehunter the badger and Nikabrik the dwarf, the Pevensie clan embarks on an incredible quest to ensure that Narnia is returned to its rightful heir.
tagline: Everything you know is about to change forever.
title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
plot:
The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian is a 2008 high fantasy film directed by Andrew Adamson and written by Adamson, Christopher Markus and Stephen McFeely. Based on Prince Caspian (1951), the second published novel in C. S. Lewis's series, it is the second installment in The Chronicles of Narnia film series. Ben Barnes stars as Caspian, with Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, William Moseley and Anna Popplewell reprising their roles as the Pevensie children, Sergio Castellitto as King Miraz, Peter Dinklage as Trumpkin, and Liam Neeson voicing Aslan.

Nearly 1,300 Narnian years after the Pevensie siblings ruled as kings and queens and returned to their own world, Narnia has been conquered by the Telmarines. Caspian, a young Telmarine prince, is woken one night by his tutor, Doctor Cornelius, who warns him that his uncle, Lord Miraz, has just had a son and now intends to kill Caspian to secure the throne for his own heir. Cornelius gives him an ancient magical horn that once belonged to Queen Susan and tells him to use it only in great need. Fleeing into the woods, Caspian is rescued by surviving Narnians, the dwarfs Trumpkin and Nikabrik and the talking badger Trufflehunter; Trumpkin is captured by soldiers. Caspian blows the horn.

In wartime England, a year after their first adventure, the four Pevensies are waiting on a London Underground platform when they are suddenly pulled back into Narnia. They find their castle, Cair Paravel, in ruins and rescue Trumpkin from execution, learning how much time has passed. Lucy glimpses Aslan pointing the way, but her older siblings do not believe her. The Pevensies join Caspian and the Narnians, who have taken refuge at Aslan's How, and tensions arise between Peter and Caspian over leadership. A disastrous night raid on Miraz's castle leaves many Narnians dead, and Nikabrik's plot to summon the White Witch is narrowly thwarted. As Miraz's army advances, Peter challenges him to single combat to buy time, while Lucy sets out to find Aslan and bring help.

The film received generally positive reviews, though many considered it darker and less charming than the first film. It grossed about $419 million worldwide, a significant decline from its predecessor, which prompted Disney to withdraw from the series before the third film was made with 20th Century Fox.

overview: In Moscow, five young people lead the charge against an alien race which has attacked Earth via our power supply.
tagline: Survive The Holidays
title: The Darkest Hour
plot:
The Darkest Hour is a 2011 American war drama film directed by Chris Crowe and starring Christian Bale, Emma Stone, and Sam Claflin.

The main themes of The Darkest Hour revolve around the personal struggle of Winston Churchill, the former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, as he navigates the early stages of World War II. Some of the key themes include:

1. Leadership: The film explores Churchill's leadership style, his ability to inspire and motivate others, and his willingness to take risks in order to lead Britain to victory.
2. Personal sacrifice: As Churchill faces opposition from within his own party and struggles with personal demons, he must make difficult choices that put the needs of the country above his own desires.
3. Morality and duty: The film raises questions about morality and duty, particularly in the face of war and conflict. Churchill's actions are often guided by a sense of duty to his country, even when they go against his personal beliefs.
4. Emotional toll of war: The Darkest Hour portrays the emotional toll that war takes on individuals, including Churchill, who struggles with depression, anxiety, and feelings of isolation.

The film begins with Churchill's appointment as Prime Minister in May 1940, following Neville Chamberlain's resignation. As he navigates the early stages of World War II, Churchill faces opposition from within his own party, particularly from King George VI and Lord Halifax. He must also contend with the personal struggles that have plagued him throughout his life, including depression and a troubled marriage.

As the film progresses, Churchill becomes increasingly isolated and withdrawn, struggling to connect with those around him. However, he also finds solace in his relationships with his wife Clementine and his close friend Lord Halifax. Through these relationships, Churchill is able to find strength and inspiration, which ultimately helps him to rally the British people and lead them through one of the darkest periods in their history.

The film ends on a hopeful note, as Churchill delivers his famous "We shall fight on the beaches" speech, rallying the British people to stand against Nazi Germany. The final scenes show Churchill's personal struggles beginning to subside, replaced by a sense of purpose and determination that will carry him through the rest of the war.

Overall, The Darkest Hour is a powerful exploration of leadership, morality, and personal sacrifice in the face of war and conflict.

overview: A paranoia-fueled action thriller about an unsuccessful writer whose life is transformed by a top-secret "smart drug" that allows him to use 100% of his brain and become a perfect version of himself. His enhanced abilities soon attract shadowy forces that threaten his new life in this darkly comic and provocative film.
tagline: What if a pill could make you rich and powerful?
title: Limitless
plot:
Limitless is a 2011 science fiction thriller film directed by Neil Burger and written by Luke Evans and Eric Warren Singer. The movie stars Bradley Cooper, Robert De Niro, and Abbie Cornish.

The story follows Eddie Morra (played by Bradley Cooper), a struggling writer who works as a janitor at a publishing company in New York City. One day, while cleaning up after a party, Eddie stumbles upon a mysterious pill that he finds on the floor. The pill is labeled "NZT-48" and is produced by the pharmaceutical company PerkinReidy.

Eddie takes the pill, which gives him an extraordinary boost of intelligence, memory, and cognitive abilities. He becomes incredibly intelligent, able to learn new information at an incredible rate, and his memory expands exponentially. Eddie's newfound abilities allow him to excel in his job as a writer, and he quickly becomes a successful author.

However, Eddie soon realizes that the pill has a dark side effect: it slowly kills him over time. As the days pass, Eddie's body begins to deteriorate, and he must find a way to reverse the effects of the NZT-48 before it's too late.

Eddie's newfound abilities also attract the attention of the pharmaceutical company PerkinReidy, which wants to exploit his brain for their own gain. The company's CEO, Carl Van Loon (played by Robert De Niro), will stop at nothing to get Eddie to work for them and help develop a new line of NZT-based products.

As Eddie navigates this treacherous world, he meets Sarah (played by Abbie Cornish), a beautiful and intelligent woman who becomes his love interest. Together, they try to uncover the truth about the NZT-48 pill and its effects on Eddie's body.

Throughout the movie, Eddie's character undergoes significant development as he struggles with the consequences of his newfound abilities. He must confront the darker aspects of his own personality and the moral implications of using a powerful substance like NZT-48 to enhance his cognitive abilities.

The movie builds towards a thrilling climax as Eddie and Sarah try to outsmart Van Loon and his henchmen, who will stop at nothing to get their hands on Eddie's brain. In the end, Eddie must make a choice between saving himself or using his abilities to help others.

Overall, Limitless is a gripping sci-fi thriller that explores themes of identity, morality, and the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to human cognition. The movie features impressive performances from its cast, particularly Bradley Cooper, who brings depth and nuance to Eddie's character.

overview: A black ops assassin is forced to fight for her own survival after a job goes dangerously wrong.
tagline: Kill. Or be killed.
title: Ava
plot: Ava (2020), directed by Tate Taylor and starring Jessica Chastain, is a character-driven action thriller that explores themes of trust, betrayal, personal redemption, and the cost of violence. Unlike traditional high-octane spy thrillers, Ava offers a more introspective look into the life of an assassin who is both highly skilled and deeply haunted.The film follows Ava Faulkner (Chastain), a deadly black-ops assassin who works for a covert organization led by Simon (Colin Farrell), with field guidance from her long-time mentor Duke (John Malkovich). Ava is intelligent, efficient, and methodical — her missions involve eliminating high-value targets with precision. However, she has a troubling habit: before executing her targets, she asks them what they did wrong, revealing a conscience that’s beginning to clash with her profession.When a job in Saudi Arabia goes sideways due to faulty intel, Ava begins to suspect that something is wrong within the organization. Duke, who cares for her like a daughter, warns Simon that the mission failure was not Ava’s fault. But Simon, ruthless and concerned with the organization’s integrity, decides that Ava is a liability. He orders a hit on her to cover up any potential fallout.Parallel to the espionage plot, the film delves into Ava’s personal struggles. After eight years of estrangement, she returns home to Boston to reconnect with her family — her mother Bobbi (Geena Davis) and sister Judy (Jess Weixler), who is now engaged to Ava’s ex-fiancé, Michael (Common). These reunions are fraught with tension and unresolved emotional trauma. Ava is a recovering alcoholic, and her past mistakes have deeply scarred her relationships.As Ava’s enemies close in, she is forced into a deadly confrontation not just with Simon’s operatives, but with her own inner demons. The film builds toward a brutal final showdown between Ava and Simon in a Paris hotel room, where raw physicality and strategic cunning collide. Despite being wounded and outnumbered, Ava survives, though the ending remains open — hinting that the cycle of violence is far from over.At its core, Ava is a study of duality. Ava embodies both predator and protector; she’s capable of extreme violence but is also searching for meaning, connection, and a path to redemption. The film portrays how trauma — both self-inflicted and external — shapes identity. Ava’s struggle with guilt, her attempts to mend familial bonds, and her desire to find moral clarity in a morally ambiguous profession elevate the narrative beyond typical genre fare.Thematically, the film questions the ethics of covert operations, the disposable nature of operatives, and the psychological toll of living a life built on deception. Through Duke, Ava briefly reflects on the mentor-protégé dynamic, showing how deep loyalty can be corrupted by institutional betrayal.Though the film received mixed reviews, Jessica Chastain’s performance anchors the story, portraying Ava with a compelling mix of vulnerability, strength, and haunted determination.

overview: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.
tagline: Prepare for the Second Coming.
title: Deadpool 2
plot:
Deadpool 2 is a 2018 superhero film directed by David Leitch and written by Rhett Reese and Paul Wernick. The movie is the sequel to the 2016 film Deadpool, starring Ryan Reynolds as the titular character.

The film begins with Wade Wilson (Deadpool), who has been living in hiding after his last adventure. He is approached by Cable (Josh Brolin), a time-traveling mutant from the future, who claims that he needs Wade's help to prevent a catastrophic event that will destroy humanity. Cable explains that he was sent back in time to kill a young mutant named Russell Collins (Julian Dennison), also known as Firefist, who is destined to become a powerful villain.

Wade agrees to help Cable and joins him on a mission to stop Firefist from being killed by the villainous Ajax (Ed Skrein). Along the way, they are joined by Domino (Zazie Beetz), a mutant with the ability to control luck. The team also includes Negasonic Teenage Warhead (Brianna Hildebrand) and Russell's mother, Vanessa (Gina Carano).

As they journey through time, Wade begins to develop feelings for Vanessa, who is being pursued by Ajax. Meanwhile, Cable's true intentions are revealed: he wants to kill Firefist because he believes that the young mutant will become a threat to humanity.

The team eventually reaches the present day, where they must stop Ajax from carrying out his plan. However, things don't go as planned, and Wade is forced to confront his own demons in order to save Vanessa and prevent the catastrophic event.

In the end, Wade is able to defeat Ajax and save Vanessa, but not before she sacrifices herself to protect him. Cable's true intentions are also revealed: he wants to kill Firefist because he believes that the young mutant will become a threat to humanity. However, it is later revealed that Cable's actions were motivated by a desire to prevent a disaster that would have killed millions of people.

The film ends with Wade reflecting on his experiences and realizing that he has found a new family among the X-Force team. He also begins to develop feelings for Vanessa, who appears in a post-credits scene as a ghostly apparition.

Overall, Deadpool 2 is a action-packed and humorous film that explores themes of time travel, sacrifice, and redemption. The movie features plenty of witty banter and over-the-top action sequences, making it a must-see for fans of the superhero genre.

overview: Two exes finally reconnect when a snowstorm leaves them stranded in a superstore (without cell service or Wi-Fi) just before Christmas.
title: Aisle Be Home for Christmas
plot: Two exes finally reconnect when a snowstorm leaves them stranded in a superstore (without cell service or Wi-Fi) just before Christmas.

overview: When Vetter's wife is killed in a botched hit organized by Diablo, he seeks revenge against those responsible. But in the process, Vetter and Hicks have to fight their way up the chain to get to Diablo but it's easier said than done when all Vetter can focus on is revenge.
tagline: Love changes a man. Revenge tears him apart.
title: A Man Apart
plot:
A Man Apart is a 2003 action film directed by F. Gary Gray and starring Vin Diesel. The movie follows Sean Vetter (Vin Diesel), an undercover cop who infiltrates a Mexican cartel to take down its leader, Carlos Salamanca (Joaquim de Almeida).

The main themes of A Man Apart include:

1. Loyalty vs. Duty: Sean Vetter is torn between his loyalty to his family and his duty as an undercover cop. This internal conflict drives the plot and character development throughout the movie.
2. Identity Crisis: As an undercover agent, Sean struggles with his dual identity, which leads to a crisis of self-discovery. He must navigate his true loyalties and confront his own demons.
3. Family Ties: The film highlights the importance of family in Sean's life, particularly his relationship with his daughter, Lena (Lena Headey). This bond serves as a motivation for Sean's actions throughout the movie.
4. Corruption and Power: The Mexican cartel represents a corrupting influence that threatens to destroy Sean's life and the lives of those around him. The film explores the dangers of unchecked power and corruption.

The plot development revolves around Sean's infiltration of the cartel, which leads to a series of intense confrontations with Carlos Salamanca and his henchmen. As the story unfolds, Sean must confront his own vulnerabilities and make difficult choices that test his loyalty and identity.

The ending is action-packed, with Sean facing off against Carlos in a final showdown. Ultimately, Sean emerges victorious but not without scars, both physical and emotional. The movie concludes on a bittersweet note, as Sean reflects on the sacrifices he made to protect his family and the lessons he learned about loyalty, duty, and identity.

Overall, A Man Apart is an action-packed thriller that explores themes of loyalty, identity, and family ties in the face of corruption and power.

overview: A counter-terrorism expert takes a job protecting a young heiress. After an attempted kidnapping puts both of their lives in danger, they must flee.
tagline: Trained to protect. Born to survive.
title: Close
plot:
Close is a 2019 British action thriller directed by Vicky Jewson and starring Noomi Rapace as a professional bodyguard, a role modelled on Jacquie Davis, one of the world's leading female close protection officers, whose clients have included J. K. Rowling and Nicole Kidman. Sophie Nélisse plays the heiress she is hired to protect and Indira Varma her stepmother, with Eoin Macken and Akin Gazi. Netflix released it on 18 January 2019.

On an assignment in South Sudan, the close protection officer Sam Carlson saves the two journalists in her care when their convoy is ambushed. Meanwhile Zoe Tanner, the rebellious daughter of the recently deceased tycoon Eric Tanner, learns that her father has left her his controlling shares in Hassine Mining, to the fury of her stepmother Rima Hassine, whose family founded the firm and who now runs it. With Rima close to concluding a huge phosphate mining deal, she insists that Zoe stay with her at the family's fortified estate in Morocco and hires Sam to guard her, after Zoe's previous bodyguard was dismissed for sleeping with her.

On their first night at the remote kasbah, the security system is overridden, sealing everyone inside, and armed men kill most of the guards, including the head of security, Alik. Sam gets Zoe out, and the pair are picked up by police officers, but Zoe, who speaks Arabic, hears them talking about a private address and payment. Sam fights them off, Zoe shoots one, and the two flee into Casablanca. As news of the attack sends Hassine shares tumbling, a rival company, Sikong, closes in on the deal.
