In the village pub a fiddler, Seamus, teaches Finley to play with joy and freedom, and she and Beckett fall in love, keeping their romance secret from the press. But photographs of them kissing are leaked, embarrassing his co-star Taylor, with whom his father has staged a fake romance, and Montgomery pressures Beckett to sign the deal and end things with Finley. Meanwhile Cathleen reveals that she married the violent Mr. Sweeney in her sister's place to save her, but her letters to Fiona have always come back unopened.

Choosing to stay with the dying Cathleen rather than fly home for her audition, Finley sees Fiona arrive in time to reconcile. Beckett finds the cross from Alex's sketch, bearing a verse from Deuteronomy that Finley takes as a message from her brother. Beckett turns down the franchise deal to go to college, Finley wins her place at the conservatory, and the two are reunited in New York. Reviews were mixed, with 53% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: A family is on holiday in 1991 when their teenage daughter decides to elope with her boyfriend. Their parents travel forward in time to 2022 and see how much Spain has changed in three decades.
title: Tomorrow is Today
plot:
Tomorrow Is Today (Spanish: Mañana es hoy) is a 2022 Spanish comedy film directed by Nacho G. Velilla, starring Javier Gutiérrez and Carmen Machi, with Asier Ricarte and Carla Díaz. Produced by Atresmedia Cine and Aparte Films for Amazon Prime Video, it is a time-travel comedy that contrasts Spanish family life in the early 1990s with the present day.

In the summer of 1991, José Luis Gaspar takes his wife Pilar and their teenage children, Lucía and Rodrigo, on a beach holiday. After an argument, Lucía leaves with her boyfriend Charly to go to a carnival, while the rest of the family go out to sea on a pedal boat. A sudden thunderstorm transports them to 2022. Returning to their old neighborhood, they find Quique, Rodrigo's best friend and José's former employee, now a middle-aged man, who tells them that Lucía died at the carnival in 1991. The family suspects that Charly killed her.

Determined to return to the past and save his daughter, José seeks help from a fortune teller, Ana Clara, and her cousin and assistant Elvirita. Meanwhile, Pilar and Rodrigo begin adapting to the modern world: Pilar finds a job in a fashion boutique, and Rodrigo goes back to high school with Quique's help and gets his first girlfriend. When José and Ana Clara track down an older Charly and confront him, the encounter ends in an accident. Eventually José manages to return to 1991 during another storm, where the family desperately tries to keep Lucía away from the carnival and discovers that the danger she faces does not come from where they expected.

Much of the film's humor comes from the family's encounters with smartphones, social media and changing social attitudes, while the story shifts toward drama in its final act.

Tomorrow Is Today premiered on Amazon Prime Video on 2 December 2022. Reviews were mixed: Cinemanía rated it four out of five stars, praising its parodic and witty style and its score, while Diario de Sevilla gave it one star, criticizing a lazy script that wastes the premise's possibilities. HobbyConsolas considered it acceptable, praising the premise and the cast but faulting the final act.

overview: When Alex, an infiltration expert with a secret past, accidentally reveals her identity during what should have been a routine heist, she quickly finds herself mixed up in a government conspiracy and entangled in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with a master assassin and his team of killers.  Armed with her own set of lethal skills, Alex looks to exact revenge for her murdered friends while uncovering the truth.
tagline: The heist gone wrong is not her only problem
title: Momentum
plot:
Momentum is a 2015 German thriller film directed by Thomas Cailley and written by Thomas Cailley and Christian Berger. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Anna, who becomes embroiled in a complex web of crime and deception with her boyfriend, Max.

The main themes of Momentum include:

1. **Deception and Manipulation**: The film explores the theme of deception and manipulation, as both Anna and Max engage in cat-and-mouse games with each other and others around them. This is reflected in the film's use of non-linear storytelling and multiple plot twists.
2. **Toxic Relationships**: Momentum portrays a toxic relationship between Anna and Max, which is marked by emotional abuse, manipulation, and control. The film highlights the ways in which these relationships can be damaging and destructive.
3. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As the story unfolds, both Anna and Max are forced to confront their own identities and motivations. This theme is reflected in the film's use of symbolism and metaphor, as well as its exploration of the complexities of human psychology.
4. **Power Dynamics**: The film examines the power dynamics at play in relationships, particularly those that involve manipulation and control. This theme is reflected in the film's portrayal of Max's abusive behavior towards Anna.

Overall, Momentum is a thought-provoking and suspenseful thriller that explores complex themes and ideas through its non-linear narrative and intricate plot twists.

overview: A young man sets out to uncover the truth about his life after finding his baby photo on a missing persons website.
tagline: They stole his life. He's taking it back.
title: Abduction
plot:
Abduction is a 2011 American action thriller film directed by John Singleton and written by Ridley Scott and Tony Gilroy. The movie stars Taylor Lautner, Lily Collins, Alfred Molina, Jason Patric, Sigourney Weaver, and Michael Nyqvist.

The story follows Nathan Harper (Taylor Lautner), an 18-year-old high school student who lives with his mother, Stephanie (Lily Collins), in a small town. Nathan's life is turned upside down when he discovers that he has been kidnapped as a child and raised by a group of people known as "The Syndicate," a secret organization that harvests children from around the world to use for their own purposes.

Nathan's memories of his childhood are fragmented, but he begins to experience strange flashbacks and nightmares. He soon realizes that he is being hunted by The Syndicate, who will stop at nothing to keep him from revealing their secrets.

As Nathan tries to uncover the truth about his past, he meets Sarah (Lily Collins), a beautiful and mysterious woman who claims to be an FBI agent. She helps Nathan evade The Syndicate's agents and begins to teach him how to fight and defend himself.

Meanwhile, Nathan discovers that he has a unique genetic marker that makes him a valuable asset to The Syndicate. He also learns that his mother is still alive and working for the organization, which adds a personal dimension to his quest for revenge.

As the stakes escalate, Nathan and Sarah find themselves in a cat-and-mouse game with The Syndicate's leader, Emil (Michael Nyqvist), who will stop at nothing to capture Nathan and exploit his genetic marker. Along the way, Nathan must confront his own identity and the true nature of his past.

The movie builds towards an action-packed climax as Nathan and Sarah face off against The Syndicate in a thrilling showdown. In the end, Nathan is able to outsmart Emil and destroy The Syndicate's operation, but not before discovering that his mother has been killed by the organization.

Throughout the movie, Taylor Lautner delivers a strong performance as the protagonist, bringing a sense of vulnerability and determination to the role. Lily Collins shines as Sarah, adding depth and complexity to the story. The supporting cast, including Alfred Molina and Sigourney Weaver, adds to the tension and suspense.

Overall, Abduction is an action-packed thriller that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and redemption. While it may not be a perfect film, it delivers plenty of twists and turns to keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

overview: When an impulsive boy named Kenai is magically transformed into a bear, he must literally walk in another's footsteps until he learns some valuable life lessons. His courageous and often zany journey introduces him to a forest full of wildlife, including the lovable bear cub Koda, hilarious moose Rutt and Tuke, woolly mammoths and rambunctious rams.
tagline: Nature Calls
title: Brother Bear
plot:
Brother Bear is a 2003 American animated adventure comedy-drama film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation. The movie was directed by Aaron Blaise and Robert Walker, and it tells the story of Kenai, an Inuit boy who is transformed into a bear.

The film begins with Kenai, a young Inuit boy living in the village of Sitka, Alaska, during the 13th century. Kenai's life is marked by tragedy when his brother Koda, also known as "Bear", dies after being shot by their father, Denahi, who was trying to protect the family from a bear attack. The death of Koda has a profound impact on Kenai, and he becomes consumed by anger and hatred towards his father.

As punishment for his actions, Kenai is transformed into a bear by the spirit of the land, Sitka, after he kills a bear that was sent to teach him a lesson about respect and compassion. Kenai finds himself in the body of a massive grizzly bear, with no memory of who he is or how he got there.

Initially, Kenai struggles to adapt to his new form and navigate the wilderness as a bear. However, he soon discovers that Koda, now a bear cub, has been left behind by Denahi, who believes that the boy's spirit has died. As Kenai explores the forest, he begins to develop a bond with Koda, who is struggling to survive on his own.

Throughout their journey together, Kenai and Koda face numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, fierce predators, and harsh weather conditions. Along the way, Kenai learns valuable lessons about forgiveness, compassion, and the importance of family. He also begins to understand that he was transformed into a bear as a test of his character, rather than a punishment.

As they near their destination, Kenai and Koda encounter Denahi, who is determined to kill the "bear" that has been terrorizing the village. In a dramatic confrontation, Kenai must decide whether to continue his vendetta against his father or to find a way to reconcile with him.

In the end, Kenai comes to realize that he was wrong to blame his father for Koda's death and that Denahi was acting out of love and protection. The two brothers are reunited, and Kenai is transformed back into his human form. The film concludes with Kenai and Denahi reconciling, and Kenai learning the value of forgiveness and compassion.

The movie features stunning animation, memorable characters, and a powerful story that explores themes of family, friendship, and redemption. Brother Bear was well-received by critics and audiences alike, and it has become a beloved Disney classic.

overview: A writer leaves his upper-class life and journeys with a woman claiming to be his sister, and her two friends.
tagline: An erotically charged descent into madness.
title: Pola X
plot:
Pola X is a 1999 French drama film directed by Leos Carax. The movie revolves around the life of Xavier, a young man struggling with his own desires and identity.

At its core, Pola X explores the complexities of human desire, particularly in regards to same-sex relationships and the blurred lines between love and lust. The film delves into themes of loneliness, isolation, and the search for connection, as Xavier navigates his way through a series of intense and often destructive encounters with women.

One of the primary concerns of Pola X is the tension between authenticity and performance, particularly in regards to identity and self-presentation. Xavier's struggles to reconcile his true desires with societal expectations serve as a catalyst for exploring these themes.

The film also touches on the idea of the fragmented self, suggesting that individuals are often torn between competing desires and identities. This fragmentation can lead to feelings of disconnection and disorientation, which are expertly captured in Carax's cinematic style.

Ultimately, Pola X is a poignant and thought-provoking exploration of human vulnerability, desire, and the search for meaning in a chaotic world.

original_title: サイダーのように言葉が湧き上がる
overview: After meeting one day, a shy boy who expresses himself through haiku and a bubbly but self-conscious girl share a brief, magical summer.
title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop
plot:
Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop (Japanese: Saidā no Yō ni Kotoba ga Wakiagaru) is a Japanese animated romantic comedy-drama directed by Kyōhei Ishiguro and produced by Sublimation and Signal.MD. Ichikawa Somegorō VIII voices the shy haiku poet Cherry and Hana Sugisaki the masked influencer Smile, with Megumi Han, Koichi Yamadera and Kikuko Inoue. After premiering at the 2020 Shanghai International Film Festival, it was released in Japanese cinemas and on Netflix worldwide on July 22, 2021.

The story takes place over one summer in a provincial town dominated by a large shopping mall, the Oda Nouvelle. Yui Sakura, nicknamed Cherry, is a withdrawn boy who wears headphones to shut out the world and expresses his feelings only through haiku, which he posts online but cannot bring himself to read aloud. He is spending his holiday working at an elderly day care centre in the mall. Smile, a cheerful girl who posts videos online, always wears a face mask to hide her prominent front teeth, which she is self-conscious about.

During a chaotic chase between mall security and a young graffiti artist, Beaver, Cherry and Smile accidentally swap phones. After sorting out the mix-up, they begin to follow each other online and to meet in person, sharing their interests. Smile starts helping at the care centre, where the residents are rehearsing a folk dance for the mall's summer festival. One of them, Fujiyama, a former record shop owner, longs to hear an old record called "Yamazakura" one last time, though he has only its sleeve; the recording was made by his late wife.

With the help of friends from the mall, Cherry and Smile search Fujiyama's old shop and finally find the record hidden behind a refrigerator, warped by the heat. Smile invites Cherry to watch the festival fireworks with her, but the record shatters when she tries to flatten it. Then Cherry learns that his family is moving away on the day of the festival, and the two part awkwardly.

On the day of the festival, Smile discovers a playable copy of the record turned into a clock at the care centre and plans to play it during the performance. Driving past the mall, Cherry sees one of his haiku about Smile spray-painted on signs by Beaver, and rushes back to declare his love in verse in front of the crowd. As the fireworks begin, Smile removes her mask and smiles.

Critics praised its pop-art visuals and music, and it was nominated for the Mainichi Film Award for Best Animation Film.

original_title: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans
overview: The comedic modern-day quintet takes on their 2003 counterparts when villains from each of their worlds join forces to pit the two Titan teams against each other. They'll need to set aside their differences and work together to combat Trigon, Hexagon, Santa Claus (that's right, Santa!) and time itself in order to save the multiverse.
title: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans
plot:
Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans is a 2019 American animated superhero comedy film that brings together the casts of two television series, the comedic Teen Titans Go! and the earlier Teen Titans, both based on the DC Comics team. It serves as a sequel to both Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018) and Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo (2006). Scott Menville, Hynden Walch, Khary Payton, Tara Strong and Greg Cipes voice both versions of their characters, with Kevin Michael Richardson as Trigon and Rhys Darby as the Master of Games. It premiered at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2019 before its home release.

A year after defeating Slade, the light-hearted 2013 Titans foil a bank robbery by the Gentleman Ghost, who possesses Robin and Starfire before trying to take over Raven. In the process he cracks the gem on Raven's forehead, which keeps her demonic power in check, and she defeats him with a burst of dark energy. Her father, the demon Trigon, offers to take her demon half away, but she refuses.

The team is then abducted by the Master of Games, who is travelling the multiverse with a device called the Worlogog. He forces the comedic Titans to fight their more serious 2003 counterparts, threatening to destroy both their worlds. Raven is goaded into unleashing her demonic power, and the older Raven realises that the Master of Games is draining it. He is revealed as the 2013 Trigon, who uses the stolen power to partly revive his 2003 counterpart. The two Trigons seize both Ravens and escape to the 2003 Earth.

The two teams join forces. Deducing that their own dimension must also contain a Worlogog, the 2013 Titans realise it belongs to Santa Claus, and they steal it after a battle with Santa and Mrs. Claus. Travelling across the multiverse, they visit worlds of other Teen Titans incarnations, but arrive too late: the 2013 Trigon has absorbed the 2003 Trigon and become a monstrous being called Hexagon.

Robin summons Titans from across the multiverse to fight Hexagon, but they are overwhelmed until the 2013 Raven absorbs the power of her many counterparts and transforms into a giant black dragon. The Titans destroy Trigon's Worlogog and help Raven defeat him; the 2003 Trigon is sent to limbo and the 2013 Trigon to a dimension of zombie Titans. Having accepted her demonic side, Raven returns home with her team, who are too tired to fight Darkseid when he attacks Jump City. Reviews were positive, IGN rating it 8 out of 10.

overview: Gotham City is under siege by a series of bizarre crimes and only the world's greatest detective, Batman, can unravel the mystery! The trail leads to none other than the Penguin and his Animilitia, an animal-inspired squad of villains including Silverback, Cheetah, Killer Croc and the monstrous Man-Bat.
tagline: Hi-Tech, High Stakes, High Danger!
title: Batman Unlimited: Animal Instincts
plot:
Batman Unlimited: Animal Instincts is an animated superhero film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between good and evil. The movie explores the theme of primal instincts, highlighting how even the most well-intentioned individuals can succumb to their baser impulses when pushed to the limit.

The story follows Batman as he faces off against a villainous mastermind who unleashes a serum that awakens the animalistic tendencies within his enemies, forcing them to confront their inner demons. As the battle rages on, Batman must navigate the treacherous landscape of his own psyche, confronting the fears and doubts that have haunted him since his origin story.

Throughout the film, the main theme of primal instincts is expertly woven into the narrative, raising questions about the nature of humanity and the consequences of unchecked emotions. The movie also touches on the idea of redemption, as Batman grapples with the possibility of losing himself to the very darkness he seeks to vanquish.

Ultimately, Batman Unlimited: Animal Instincts presents a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to consider the fine line between civilization and savagery. The film's dark and suspenseful tone creates a sense of tension that propels the story forward, keeping audiences on the edge of their seats as they witness Batman's struggle to maintain his grip on sanity in the face of overwhelming adversity.

original_title: Tadeo Jones 2: El secreto del rey Midas
overview: Tad dreams of becoming an archaeologist traveling the world, uncovering hidden secrets and lost treasure, but his job working construction keeps him daydreaming instead of exploring. The chance of a lifetime comes when he is invited to attend archaeologist Sara Lavrof's presentation of her latest discovery - the papyrus that proves the existence of the Necklace of Midas, the legendary King who turned everything he touched into solid gold.
production_companies: Tadeo Jones y el Secreto de Midas A.I.E.
title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas
plot:
Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas (Spanish: Tadeo Jones 2: El secreto del rey Midas) is a 2017 Spanish computer-animated adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and David Alonso, the sequel to Tad, the Lost Explorer (2012). It features the voices of Óscar Barberán as Tad and Michelle Jenner as Sara. It premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June 2017 and was released in Spain by Paramount Pictures that August, later reaching the United States and United Kingdom.

Tad Stones, a construction worker who dreams of being a real archaeologist, is invited by his friend Sara Lavrof, now a renowned explorer, to a museum where she will present a papyrus proving that King Midas really existed. Before the visit Tad is reunited with Mummy, the friendly mummy from the first film, who has been thrown out of his home and travelled to find him. At the museum Tad meets Tiffany, the ambitious assistant of Sara's father, Professor Lavrof.

At a gala, Sara tells the legend of Midas: for defeating his enemies on behalf of Apollo, the king received a golden collar that gave him the power to turn everything he touched into gold. When he accidentally turned his own daughter into gold, Apollo ordered him to split the collar into three pieces and hide them in three temples, and his daughter was restored through a sacrifice of love. The villainous treasure hunter Jack Rackham and his henchmen burst in, steal the papyrus and kidnap Sara to force her to lead him to the pieces.

Tad, Tiffany and Mummy decipher notes about one of the temples and follow the kidnappers to Granada, where, after a chase through the Alhambra, they discover a secret passage under a fountain leading to a hidden temple and recover the first piece. Rackham forces them to hand it over in exchange for Sara. The search continues to Cappadocia in Turkey, where Tad finds the second piece and learns that a mountain shaped like Midas's symbol holds the last one.

Sara resolves to destroy the collar, but Tiffany betrays the group and joins Rackham. Everyone converges on the mountain, where Rackham assembles the collar and gains Midas's golden touch. In the struggle he turns Sara to gold before Tad defeats him. As Tad grieves over her, his love restores her, just as in the legend. The film earned about 35.7 million dollars worldwide against a budget of nine million euros, and won the Goya Award for Best Animated Film.

overview: A romantic comedy about a family traveling to the French capital for business. The party includes a young engaged couple forced to confront the illusion that a life different from their own is better.
title: Midnight in Paris
plot:
Midnight in Paris is a 2011 romantic comedy film written and directed by Woody Allen. The movie stars Owen Wilson, Rachel McAdams, and Adrien Brody.

The story begins with Gil Pender (Owen Wilson), an American writer who has just moved to Paris with his fiancée Inez (Rachel McAdams). However, their relationship is strained due to Inez's disinterest in art and literature. One evening, while exploring the city, Gil stumbles upon a mysterious train that takes him back in time to the 1920s.

In this new era, Gil meets famous artists and writers such as F. Scott Fitzgerald (Tom Hiddleston), Ernest Hemingway (Adrien Brody), and Gertrude Stein (Kathy Bates). He also encounters his idol, Pablo Picasso (Marcial Di Fonzo Bo). As the night progresses, Gil becomes fast friends with these literary giants and experiences a magical world of art, literature, and music.

Gil's adventures in 1920s Paris are filled with excitement and romance. He falls for Adriana (Marion Cotillard), a beautiful and charming woman who is also an artist. However, their love is complicated by the fact that Adriana is already engaged to a wealthy man named Salvador Dali (Jordi Mollà).

As the night wears on, Gil finds himself torn between his life in the present and his experiences in the past. He must decide whether to return to his fiancée Inez or stay with Adriana in the 1920s.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Salvador Dali's true nature is revealed, and Gil realizes that he has been living in a fantasy world. The film then shifts back to the present, where Gil returns to Paris and reunites with Inez. However, their relationship has changed due to Gil's experiences in the past.

In the end, Gil must choose between his love for Inez and his connection with Adriana. He decides to stay with Inez, but not before realizing that he has been given a rare gift – the chance to experience the magic of Paris at midnight.

Midnight in Paris is a film about the power of art and literature to transform our lives. It explores themes of love, loss, and the human condition, all set against the backdrop of one of the most romantic cities in the world. The movie features stunning visuals, witty dialogue, and memorable performances from its cast.

overview: Unhappily married aristocrat Lady Chatterley begins a torrid affair — and falls deeply in love — with the gamekeeper on her husband's country estate.
title: Lady Chatterley's Lover
plot:
Lady Chatterley's Lover is a 2022 historical romantic drama directed by Laure de Clermont-Tonnerre from a screenplay by David Magee, based on D. H. Lawrence's 1928 novel. It is the sixth screen adaptation of the book. Emma Corrin stars as Constance "Connie" Chatterley and Jack O'Connell as the gamekeeper Oliver Mellors, with Matthew Duckett as Sir Clifford Chatterley, Joely Richardson as Mrs. Bolton and Faye Marsay as Connie's sister Hilda. It was released in select cinemas in November 2022 and on Netflix on 2 December 2022.

Constance Reid marries the baronet Sir Clifford Chatterley and moves from London to his imposing country estate, Wragby. When her sister Hilda questions the match, Connie says she loves Clifford for his progressive outlook. The day after they consummate their marriage, Clifford returns to fight in the First World War. Weeks later he comes home paralyzed from the waist down and impotent, needing full-time care, which he insists only Connie provide. He rejects her attempts at other forms of intimacy, and over time the burden of caring for him and the lack of physical and emotional closeness wear her down.

Embittered by the loss of control over his body, Clifford grows domineering and obsessed with power and wealth. He makes belittling remarks, tries to stop Connie from leaving the house and treats the miners, the servants and his wife with contempt. Wanting an heir, he even suggests that Connie take a lover purely to conceive a child. Visiting Wragby, Hilda sees how exhausted her sister has become and hires Mrs. Bolton to care for Clifford, freeing Connie to spend time outdoors. On her walks through the estate's woods, Connie meets Oliver Mellors, the reserved gamekeeper, a former soldier with a failed marriage behind him. Their encounters grow into a passionate affair that awakens Connie emotionally and physically, but their relationship crosses the rigid class boundaries of English society, and as rumors spread and Connie becomes pregnant, she must choose between the security of her position and a life with the man she loves.

The film received positive reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes 86 percent of 92 critics' reviews were positive, with a consensus calling it arguably the best screen version of the oft-adapted tale, distinguished by solid acting and a refreshingly frank treatment of its mature themes, and it scored 67 on Metacritic. Critics particularly praised the chemistry between Corrin and O'Connell.

overview: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle takes his sole mission—protect his comrades—to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind.
tagline: The most lethal sniper in U.S. history.
title: American Sniper
plot:
American Sniper is a biographical war drama film directed by Clint Eastwood, released in 2014. The movie is based on the memoir of the same name by Chris Kyle, a former US Navy SEAL and sniper.

The film begins with Chris Kyle (played by Bradley Cooper), a young boy growing up in Texas, who develops a passion for hunting and marksmanship at an early age. As he grows older, Chris becomes increasingly fascinated with the military and enlists in the US Army after graduating from high school. He is eventually selected to join the Navy's SEAL Team 3.

The movie follows Chris Kyle's training as a sniper and his deployment to Iraq, where he quickly proves himself to be an exceptional marksman. Chris is assigned to a team of SEALs, led by Lieutenant Commander Ron Stroud (played by Max Martini), and they are tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions behind enemy lines.

As the war intensifies, Chris becomes known for his exceptional accuracy and bravery, earning him the nickname "The Devil of Ramadi." He is eventually deployed to Iraq's Ramadi district, where he conducts numerous successful sniper missions against insurgent fighters. However, Chris also begins to struggle with the moral implications of his actions, particularly when he kills civilians who are mistakenly identified as enemy combatants.

Despite these reservations, Chris continues to serve in Iraq, earning a reputation as one of the most lethal snipers in US military history. He is eventually awarded several commendations for his bravery and skill, including the Silver Star Medal and the Bronze Star Medal.

As Chris's time in Iraq comes to an end, he begins to struggle with the psychological effects of his experiences. He starts to question whether his actions were truly heroic or simply a product of his training and conditioning. Meanwhile, Chris meets Taya Studebaker (played by Sienna Miller), a fellow soldier who becomes his love interest.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Chris is deployed back to Iraq for a second time, where he is tasked with conducting sniper missions in the city of Fallujah. However, during one of these missions, Chris is shot and killed by a young insurgent fighter named Ahmed (played by Fares Sheik).

The film ends with Chris's wife, Taya, visiting his grave at sea, where she reflects on her husband's life and legacy. The movie concludes with a sense of sadness and loss, as the audience is left to ponder the true cost of war and the complexities of heroism.

Overall, American Sniper is a powerful and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of war and the human cost of heroism. Despite its flaws, the movie delivers a compelling and emotional portrayal of Chris Kyle's life and legacy, and Bradley Cooper's performance as the titular character is both nuanced and captivating.

overview: A reporter becomes the target of a vicious smear campaign that drives him to the point of suicide after he exposes the CIA's role in arming Contra rebels in Nicaragua and importing cocaine into California. Based on the true story of journalist Gary Webb.
tagline: Can you keep a national secret?
title: Kill the Messenger
plot:
Kill the Messenger is a 2014 American biographical crime thriller directed by Michael Cuesta and written by Peter Landesman, based on Nick Schou's book of the same name and on Gary Webb's book Dark Alliance. Jeremy Renner, who also produced the film, stars as the investigative journalist Gary Webb, with a supporting cast that includes Rosemarie DeWitt, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Oliver Platt, Michael Sheen, Ray Liotta and Andy García. The film depicts Webb's reporting on CIA involvement in cocaine trafficking to fund the Nicaraguan Contras and the campaign that destroyed his career.

In 1996, Webb, a reporter for the San Jose Mercury News, writes an article about abuses of civil asset forfeiture and is contacted by a woman whose boyfriend is facing drug charges. She gives him a secret grand jury transcript revealing that the government's key witness, the Nicaraguan trafficker Danilo Blandón, is a paid informant. Webb follows the trail to the case of the Los Angeles dealer "Freeway" Rick Ross and to a prison in Managua, where Blandón's partner confirms a scheme in which cocaine profits were used to arm the Contras with the knowledge of figures in the United States government.

Despite warnings from officials and sources that the story could put him in danger, Webb publishes his findings as a three-part series titled "Dark Alliance", which causes a national sensation. Embarrassed at having been scooped by a regional paper, major newspapers including the Los Angeles Times, The Washington Post and The New York Times begin investigating his reporting, and their coverage increasingly targets Webb himself, including an affair from his past. His editors lose confidence in him, transfer him to a minor bureau and distance the paper from the series, and Webb, isolated and under pressure, eventually resigns.

The film closes by noting that Webb was found dead in 2004 from two gunshot wounds to the head, a death that was ruled a suicide.

Kill the Messenger was released on October 10, 2014. It grossed about 6.7 million dollars worldwide against a budget of 5 million dollars. Reviews were generally positive, with 77 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus said that its fury over the real story outweighs its factual inaccuracies, and a Metacritic score of 60.

original_title: The Land Before Time XI: Invasion of the Tinysauruses
overview: While trying to obtain "Tree Sweets", Littlefoot falls into the tree and knocks down all the blossoms attracting the Tinysauruses. They devour the plants and disappear. But Littlefoot isn't blamed for the disappearance. Instead, he accidentally makes the adults believe the tiny dinosaurs were the main cause. Now Littlefoot and his friends must protect the tiny herd and learn the value of honesty.
title: The Land Before Time XI: Invasion of the Tinysauruses
plot:
The Land Before Time XI: Invasion of the Tinysauruses is a 2005 American direct-to-video animated film and the eleventh installment in The Land Before Time series, which began with Don Bluth's 1988 feature. Released by Universal Studios Home Entertainment on January 11, 2005, it follows the young dinosaur Littlefoot and his friends Cera, Ducky, Petrie and Spike in a story about honesty, size and friendship.

Every year, as the warm season begins, a single tree in the Great Valley blooms with sweet pink flowers that the inhabitants consider a delicacy. Because there are so few, the dinosaurs gather to eat them together on Nibbling Day, and Cera's father, Mr. Threehorn, guards the tree until then. He is visited by his childhood friend Tria, to whom he promises the first treesweet, making Cera jealous. When Cera teases Littlefoot about his size, he tries to prove himself by climbing a cliff to reach the treesweets early, but falls into the tree and knocks all of them down.

When Littlefoot wakes up, he sees a group of tiny dinosaurs eating the fallen treesweets. When the adults discover that the tree is bare, everyone suspects Littlefoot, who, afraid of being punished, blames the whole thing on the "Tinysauruses". The adults set out to hunt down the little creatures as pests. Littlefoot later finds the Tinysauruses living underground, befriends them and secretly brings them food, but their leader, Big Daddy, distrusts the larger dinosaurs. As the lie spirals out of control and the adults close in on the Tinysauruses' home, Littlefoot must tell the truth, repair his friendships and help protect his tiny new friends when two hungry Utahraptors invade the valley.

The film teaches that honesty matters and that even small creatures can make a big difference, ending with all the dinosaurs sharing the treesweets together on Nibbling Day.

Like the earlier sequels, the film was made for young children and released directly to home video, continuing the long-running franchise. Its story introduces the Tinysauruses, small dinosaurs whose scale lets the film explore its theme of size and importance.

overview: Twelve-year-old Dre Parker could have been the most popular kid in Detroit, but his mother's latest career move has landed him in China. Dre immediately falls for his classmate Mei Ying but the cultural differences make such a friendship impossible. Even worse, Dre's feelings make him an enemy of the class bully, Cheng. With no friends in a strange land, Dre has nowhere to turn but maintenance man Mr. Han, who is a kung fu master. As Han teaches Dre that kung fu is not about punches and parries, but maturity and calm, Dre realizes that facing down the bullies will be the fight of his life.
tagline: A Challenge He Never Imagined. A Teacher He Never Expected.
title: The Karate Kid
plot:
The Karate Kid is a 2010 martial arts drama directed by Harald Zwart from a screenplay by Christopher Murphey, based on a story by Robert Mark Kamen. A remake of the 1984 film, it moves the story to China and replaces karate with kung fu. Jaden Smith stars as a young American boy, with Jackie Chan as his teacher, Taraji P. Henson as his mother, and Wenwen Han, Zhenwei Wang and Yu Rongguang in supporting roles. It was filmed in Beijing.

Twelve-year-old Dre Parker moves from Detroit to Beijing with his widowed mother, Sherry, who has been transferred by her employer. He quickly develops a crush on Meiying, a young violinist, but this draws the hostility of Cheng, a kung fu student who repeatedly bullies and beats him. After Dre takes revenge with a bucket of dirty water, Cheng and his gang chase him down and attack him, until the apartment building's quiet maintenance man, Mr. Han, intervenes and effortlessly fends them off, revealing himself as a kung fu master.

Han explains that the boys have been taught to be merciless by their teacher, Master Li. When Han and Dre visit Li's studio to make peace, Li demands a fight, and Han instead agrees that Dre will compete against Li's students in an upcoming open tournament, on condition that they leave him alone until then. Han's training begins unconventionally, with Dre spending days repeatedly taking off, hanging up and putting on his jacket, which turns out to build the muscle memory for kung fu techniques. Han teaches him that kung fu is about serenity and maturity rather than violence, and takes him to a mountain temple where he witnesses a woman mirroring a cobra. Dre learns that Han lost his wife and young son in a car accident he blames himself for, and helps his teacher face his grief, while also winning back the approval of Meiying's father after their friendship briefly gets her into trouble.

At the tournament, Dre advances through the rounds, until a student of Li's is ordered to injure his leg in the semifinal and is disqualified. Insisting on competing, Dre has Han treat his leg with traditional cupping, and in the final against Cheng, he uses the cobra stance he saw at the temple to win with a kick to the head. Cheng presents him with the trophy, and Li's students bow to Han in respect.

Released by Columbia Pictures on June 11, 2010, the film received generally positive reviews and grossed about $359 million worldwide.

overview: A mother looks to escape her abusive past by moving to a new town where she befriends another mother, who grows suspicious of her.
title: Inconceivable
plot:
Inconceivable is a 2017 American psychological thriller directed by Jonathan Baker and written by Chloe King. Gina Gershon and Nicolas Cage star as Angela and Brian, a married couple of doctors, with Nicky Whelan as Katie, the young mother who enters their lives, Faye Dunaway as Brian's mother Donna, and Natalie Eva Marie as Angela's friend Linda. Lionsgate Premiere released the film on 30 June 2017.

The film opens with a woman holding a crying baby who struggles with and kills a man. Four years later, Angela and Brian live comfortably with their four-year-old daughter, Cora, who was conceived with the help of a donor. Through her friend Linda, Angela meets Katie, a single mother with a daughter of the same age, Maddie, who says she has fled an abusive husband but reveals little else. Brian's mother, Donna, distrusts Katie from the start and questions her background. After Angela suffers a miscarriage, she invites Katie to live in the family's guest house and work as a part-time nanny while she recovers.

Katie begins to insinuate herself into the household. One night, aware that Brian is watching, she undresses and steps into the pool, and he leaves uncomfortably. While Angela is at work at the hospital, Katie looks after Cora and secretly searches through the couple's belongings. When Angela later catches Katie in bed in the guest house with someone she assumes is Brian, but who turns out to be a woman, she relaxes and decides Katie poses no threat to her marriage. Angela, who has one embryo left from the same donor as Cora and wants her children to be full siblings, plans to ask Katie to be their surrogate, and Linda shares the news, though Katie struggles to hide how upsetting she finds it. As Katie becomes more deeply entwined in the family's life, her obsession with Angela, Brian and their children grows dangerous, and Donna and Angela begin to uncover the truth about her past and the violent secrets she has been hiding.

The film received negative reviews, holding a 38 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Frank Scheck of The Hollywood Reporter quipped that it was something both Cage and Dunaway would want to leave off their filmographies, while Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times wrote that the actors were poorly served by the script and direction.

overview: Weary of the bloodshed and violence from the martial arts world, a powerful swordsman banishes himself to the humble life a vagrant, wandering the fringes of society. But his violent past refuses to let him go quietly. The master swordsman must regain the ability to wield his sword and fight those disrupting the peace he so desperately craves.
title: Sword Master
plot:
Sword Master (Chinese: 三少爺的劍) is a 2016 Chinese-Hong Kong 3D martial arts film directed by Derek Yee and produced by Tsui Hark. A remake of the 1977 Shaw Brothers film Death Duel, in which Yee starred, it is based on a wuxia novel by Gu Long. Lin Gengxin stars as Hsieh Shao-feng, known as the Third Master, with Peter Ho as the swordsman Yen Shisan, Jiang Yiyan, Jiang Mengjie and Norman Chui. The film premiered at the Rome Film Festival and the Golden Horse Film Festival before its release on 2 December 2016.

Yen Shisan, a tattooed master swordsman and assassin, has long lived in the shadow of Hsieh Shao-feng, the legendary Third Master of the Supreme Sword Manor. Mu-Yung Chiu-ti, who claims to be Shao-feng's jilted bride, hires Yen to kill him. Yen declines the contract but sets out anyway to face the only opponent who might defeat him. At the manor he is told by Shao-feng's father that the Third Master died thirty-six days earlier. Deprived of his rival and suffering from an incurable illness, Yen gives up the life of the sword and becomes a gravedigger, hoping to do some good in the time he has left. Meanwhile, the villainous Divine Might clan seizes the chance to challenge the manor for supremacy in the martial world, now that no one there seems able to stand against them.

Elsewhere, a drunken stranger arrives at a brothel, drinks away all his money and is forced to work there as a servant. Refusing to give his name, he is nicknamed Ah-chi, or "Useless Chi." He defends Hsiao Li, a lowly prostitute who is being cheated by her customers, and the two form a bond. His kindness gradually draws him back into the conflicts of the martial world, as his true identity and the reason he abandoned his former life come to light. His path eventually converges with that of Yen Shisan, and the two greatest swordsmen of their generation must confront the Divine Might clan, Mu-Yung Chiu-ti's schemes and, finally, each other.

Sword Master grossed about $14.7 million worldwide, including around 100 million yuan in China. Reviewers praised its visual style and choreography but felt the story, which closely follows the 1977 original, was overly convoluted, and that its digital effects sometimes overwhelmed the swordplay, which marked a return to the genre for Yee, whose career had begun as a Shaw Brothers actor.

overview: After Darby Harper suffered a near-death experience as a child, she gained the ability to see ghosts. To combat the existential boredom of high school, she runs a side business counseling local spirits in her spare time. When an unexpected occurrence happens between Darby and Capri, the most popular girl at her high school, Darby reluctantly agrees to help her and in the process learns how to fit in with the living world again.
tagline: Ghosted but not gone.
title: Darby and the Dead
plot:
Darby and the Dead is a 2022 American comedy horror film directed by Silas Howard. The movie follows the story of Darby, a high school student who discovers that her deceased grandmother was a vampire hunter, and she must use her newfound knowledge to save herself from being turned into a vampire.

The main theme of Darby and the Dead is the struggle for identity and self-discovery, particularly among young women. The film explores Darby's journey as she navigates her relationships with her family, friends, and romantic interests while also confronting the dark secrets of her family's past. Through Darby's character, the movie delves into themes of female empowerment, independence, and the importance of embracing one's true self.

The film also touches on the idea of legacy and inheritance, as Darby must come to terms with her grandmother's legacy and the responsibility that comes with it. The movie's use of horror elements serves as a metaphor for the fears and anxieties that young people face in their own lives, particularly those related to identity, belonging, and finding one's place in the world.

Overall, Darby and the Dead is a coming-of-age story that combines elements of comedy, horror, and self-discovery, making it a unique and engaging watch.

overview: A young woman befriends a lonely widow who's harboring a dark and deadly agenda toward her.
tagline: Everyone needs a friend.
title: Greta
plot:
Greta (2018) is a psychological thriller film directed by Neil Jordan, produced by Sidney Kimmel Entertainment, and written by David Koepp.

The main themes of Greta include:

1. Obsession: The film explores the theme of obsession, as the protagonist, Maren (Chloë Grace Moretz), becomes increasingly fixated on her deceased great aunt, Greta (Helen Mirren). This fixation leads to a downward spiral of events that puts Maren's life in danger.

2. Family Secrets: The movie delves into the complexities of family relationships and the secrets that can be hidden within them. As Maren digs deeper into her aunt's past, she uncovers dark secrets that threaten to destroy her own sense of identity.

3. Identity Crisis: Greta is also a film about identity crisis, as Maren struggles to come to terms with her own sense of self and purpose. Her fixation on her aunt serves as a distraction from her own feelings of emptiness and disconnection.

4. The Power of the Past: The movie highlights the idea that the past can be both a source of comfort and a burden. Greta's obsession with her aunt is, in part, driven by a desire to connect with her past and find meaning in her life.

5. Mental Health: The film touches on themes of mental health, particularly anxiety and depression. Maren's fixation on her aunt serves as a coping mechanism for her own emotional pain, but ultimately exacerbates the situation.

Overall, Greta is a complex and thought-provoking thriller that explores the darker aspects of human nature and the complexities of family relationships.

overview: Join uptight David Starsky and laid-back Ken "Hutch" Hutchinson as they're paired for the first time as undercover cops. The new partners must overcome their differences to solve an important case with help from street informant Huggy Bear and persuasive criminal Reese Feldman.
tagline: They're the man.
title: Starsky & Hutch
plot:
Starsky & Hutch is a 2004 American action comedy film directed by Todd Phillips, based on the classic 1970s television series of the same name.

The movie follows the partnership between two mismatched detectives, David Starsky (Ben Stiller) and Ken "Hutch" Hutchinson (Owen Wilson), as they navigate their way through the mean streets of Los Angeles in the early 1970s. The film's main themes revolve around:

1. **Partnership and Friendship**: The movie showcases the strong bond between Starsky and Hutch, who despite their differences, have each other's backs in a world filled with crime and danger.
2. **Nostalgia for the 1970s**: The film is set in the early 1970s, and its nostalgic value is a significant part of its appeal. The movie pays homage to the era's music, fashion, and cultural references.
3. **Crime and Corruption**: The story delves into the darker side of Los Angeles, exploring themes of crime, corruption, and police bureaucracy.
4. **Self-Discovery**: As Starsky and Hutch navigate their careers and personal lives, they also undergo a journey of self-discovery, learning to balance their individuality with their partnership.

The movie's tone is lighthearted and comedic, with plenty of humor and action sequences that pay homage to the original series. Overall, Starsky & Hutch is a fun, entertaining ride that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and the power of partnerships in overcoming adversity.

overview: Academy Award Winner Javier Bardem stars as Blanco, proprietor of Básculas Blanco, a Spanish company producing industrial scales in a provincial Spanish town, which awaits the imminent visit from a committee that will decide if they merit a local Business Excellence award: everything has to be perfect when the time comes. Working against the clock, Blanco pulls out all the stops to address and resolve issues with his employees, crossing every imaginable line in the process.
title: The Good Boss
plot:
The Good Boss (2021) is a Spanish comedy-drama film directed by Fernando Franco, produced by Reposado Producciones, and starring Javier Bardem.

The main themes of The Good Boss revolve around the complexities of human relationships, power dynamics, and the blurred lines between good and evil. The story follows Mateo León (played by Javier Bardem), a ruthless and cunning boss who is known for his brutal management style, but also has a softer side when it comes to his family.

Throughout the film, Franco explores themes such as:

1. The Performance of Power: Mateo's character embodies the idea that power can be both a tool for control and a means to manipulate others. He uses his charisma and intelligence to maintain his position of authority, but also struggles with the moral implications of his actions.
2. Family Dynamics: Mateo's relationships with his family members are central to the film. His wife, Ana (played by Marta Etcheverría), is a voice of reason and empathy, while his children are both fascinated and intimidated by their father's persona.
3. Identity and Performance: The film raises questions about the performance of identity, particularly in the context of Mateo's work and personal life. He presents himself as a ruthless boss to the world, but to those closest to him, he is a complex and vulnerable individual.
4. Morality and Gray Areas: The Good Boss challenges traditional notions of good and evil by presenting a character who is both despicable and relatable. Mateo's actions are often reprehensible, yet his motivations and backstory make him a more nuanced and sympathetic figure.

Overall, The Good Boss is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, power dynamics, and the complexities of relationships.

overview: Jack Halsey takes his wife, their adult kids, and a friend for a dream vacation in Kenya. But as they venture off alone into a wilderness park, their safari van is flipped over by an angry rhino, leaving them injured and desperate. Then, as two of them go in search of rescue, a bloody, vicious encounter with a leopard and a clan of hyenas incites a desperate fight for survival.
tagline: Far from home. Far from safety. Far from over.
title: Endangered Species
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Endangered Species" released in 2021 by Grindstone Entertainment Group. 

However, I found that there is a 2019 film called "Endangered Species" directed by Chris Crow, but it was released by Grindstone Entertainment Group and not in 2021.

If you're referring to the 2019 film, "Endangered Species" is an action-thriller film starring Bruce Willis. The movie follows a former CIA operative who must use his skills to take down a group of mercenaries who have stolen a deadly virus from a research facility.

The main themes of the 2019 film "Endangered Species" include:

* The dangers of bioterrorism and the consequences of playing with nature
* The importance of teamwork and cooperation in the face of danger
* The personal cost of being a spy and the moral dilemmas that come with it

Please note that I couldn't find any information on a 2021 film titled "Endangered Species" by Grindstone Entertainment Group.

overview: With his family away, a devoted stay-at-home dad enjoys his first me time in years by joining his hard-partying old friend on a wild birthday adventure.
tagline: This is not what he had in mind.
title: Me Time
plot:
Me Time is a 2022 American buddy comedy written and directed by John Hamburg. Kevin Hart stars as a devoted stay-at-home father and Mark Wahlberg as his free-spirited former best friend, with Regina Hall, Luis Gerardo Méndez and Jimmy O. Yang in supporting roles. Netflix released it on August 26, 2022.

Sonny and Huck were inseparable friends from high school, celebrating Huck's birthday together every year until a near-death experience during one of their adventures fifteen years earlier led Sonny to settle down. Now a stay-at-home dad devoted to his family, Sonny keeps turning down Huck's yearly invitations. When his successful architect wife, Maya, takes their children to visit her parents, Sonny finds himself with some "me time" for the first time in years. He quickly grows bored and lonely: his golf is terrible, a barbecue binge ends badly, his friends are busy and his children do not seem to miss him. He finally accepts Huck's invitation to an extravagant birthday weekend.

Huck's celebration starts with skinny-dipping and a chartered bus and continues in the desert, where the guests are expected to forage for their food. Sonny fends off a mountain lion with an EpiPen. Meanwhile he grows jealous of Armando, Maya's wealthy and charming client, who offers her a major project, and a phone call with his wife turns into a shouting match. When Huck's loan shark arrives demanding the $47,000 he is owed, his enforcer breaks Sonny's finger and burns the camp down. Left alone together, Huck admits that he has fallen on hard times and is lonely. On the way home, the pair break into Armando's house and play pranks that are caught on camera.

Sonny then offers his own house for the rest of Huck's party, which spirals out of control after it is advertised online, with the singer Seal joining Sonny for a jam session. Maya and the children return in the middle of the chaos, and she asks Sonny to move out for a while. During their separation, Sonny apologizes to Armando and reflects on his behavior. At his son's school talent show, he realizes that he has been controlling and selfish, and apologizes to his family. He reconciles with Maya, and persuades Huck to go into business with him as party planners.

Me Time received largely negative reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported only 7% approval, its consensus calling it a desperately unfunny comedy that wastes its stars, and Metacritic gave it 25 out of 100.

overview: A man implicated in the triple homicide of three Hollywood starlets begins his own investigation. Needing assistance, he enlists the two detectives on his tail in order to expose a conspiracy more explosive than any of them imagined.
tagline: Justice gets dirty.
title: Gasoline Alley
plot:
Gasoline Alley is a 2022 American neo-noir action thriller directed by Edward John Drake and distributed by Saban Films, one of several low-budget films Drake made with Bruce Willis during the actor's final working years. Devon Sawa stars as the tattoo artist Jimmy Jayne, with Luke Wilson and Willis as the Los Angeles police detectives Freddy Vargas and Bill Freeman, Kat Foster as Jimmy's on-and-off girlfriend Christine, Sufe Bradshaw as the singer Eleanor, Kenny Wormald as the television actor Bourke and Rick Salomon as Persi.

Jimmy, an ex-convict who served time in prison, runs a tattoo parlour called Gasoline Alley, tends his 1966 Chevelle and drinks at a Melrose bar where his late mother once worked. There he crosses paths with a party girl named Star, and soon afterward Vargas and Freeman tell him that she has been killed along with other young women, and that he is their prime suspect, since a lighter bearing his studio's name was found at the scene. Determined not to go back inside for something he did not do, Jimmy starts investigating on his own.

Bourke, a vain actor Jimmy once protected in prison, tells him that Star ran with Persi, a pornographer and small-time criminal, and soon someone in Persi's Land Rover is shooting at Jimmy's car. Slipping into a drug-fuelled party at Persi's house, Jimmy is surprised to see Freeman there, and when a bouncer from the party turns up dead in the trunk of his Chevelle, it is clear he is being set up to take the fall. With help from Eleanor, who knew Star from Persi's gatherings and knows who supplies his drugs, Jimmy follows a trail of narcotics, dead women and police corruption. Freeman turns out to be involved in a human-trafficking ring using a tunnel between San Diego and Tijuana, and the story ends in a shootout in a warehouse in Mexico, where Jimmy, a skilled marksman, takes down the crooked detective and his accomplice and sets the building on fire.

Shot in Tifton, Georgia, in spring 2021 despite its Los Angeles setting, the film was released in theaters, on digital platforms and on demand on 25 February 2022. Reviews were mostly negative, with about a quarter of critics positive on Rotten Tomatoes. Decider credited Sawa with giving Jimmy real backbone but faulted the aimless pace and uneven story, while CBR found it an entertaining, at times unintentionally comic noir held together by a game cast.

overview: A suburban teen girl and her little brother must stop a terrifying internet meme brought to life by the hysteria of their parents.
tagline: Feed the frenzy.
title: Grimcutty
plot:
Grimcutty is a 2022 American monster horror film written and directed by John Ross and produced by 20th Digital Studio and Capture. Sara Wolfkind stars as the teenager Asha Chaudhry, with Shannyn Sossamon and Usman Ally as her parents, Leah and Amir, and Callan Farris as her younger brother Kamran. The film was released in October 2022 on Hulu in the United States, on Star+ in Latin America and on Disney+ in other territories.

Asha is a teenager who spends much of her time online, where she runs a YouTube channel devoted to ASMR videos. Her parents, Amir and Leah, are increasingly anxious about what their children are exposed to on the internet. When news spreads of a viral online challenge involving a sinister figure known as the Grimcutty, which supposedly urges children to harm themselves and others, local parents are swept up in panic. Amir and Leah react by restricting their children's access to phones and computers and monitoring them closely, convinced that the meme poses a real danger.

Asha insists that the Grimcutty is simply a hoax amplified by frightened adults, but strange events soon begin to suggest otherwise. A gangly, menacing creature resembling the figure from the meme starts appearing to teenagers in the neighborhood, attacking them, while the adults blame the violence on the challenge itself. Asha discovers that the monster has been brought to life by the collective fear of the adults who believe in it, and that their attempts to protect their children only make it stronger. With her parents refusing to listen and blaming everything on the internet, Asha teams up with her little brother Kamran to find a way to destroy the Grimcutty before it claims more victims, while trying to make the adults understand the real source of the threat.

The film was inspired by the Momo Challenge, an internet moral panic about a supposed suicide game that peaked in 2019 and was widely regarded as a hoax. Grimcutty received generally negative reviews, with a 22 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Some reviewers found its satirical premise about parental panic clever, and Mike Mack of Laughing Place called it a fine watch, while others felt the execution was slow and underdeveloped.

overview: Set in northern Australia before World War II, an English aristocrat who inherits a sprawling ranch reluctantly pacts with a stock-man in order to protect her new property from a takeover plot. As the pair drive 2,000 head of cattle over unforgiving landscape, they experience the bombing of Darwin by Japanese forces firsthand.
tagline: Welcome to Australia!
title: Australia
plot:
Australia (2008) is a historical drama film directed by Baz Luhrmann, starring Hugh Jackman, Nicole Kidman, and David Wenham.

The main themes of Australia (2008) include:

1. **Survival and Resilience**: The film tells the story of a young drover named Drover (Hugh Jackman), who survives against all odds in the harsh Australian outback during World War II. His journey is a testament to human resilience and determination.
2. **Love and Sacrifice**: The movie explores the complex relationship between Drover and Lady Sarah Ashley (Nicole Kidman), a British aristocrat who becomes his love interest. Their romance is set against the backdrop of war, and Drover must make sacrifices for her safety and well-being.
3. **War and its Consequences**: Australia depicts the brutal realities of World War II in the Pacific, including the bombing of Darwin and the subsequent occupation of Australia by Japanese forces. The film highlights the devastating impact of war on civilians and the importance of unity and cooperation in the face of adversity.
4. **Identity and Belonging**: Drover's journey is also a metaphor for finding one's place in the world. As an outsider, he must navigate his relationships with the Australian Aboriginal people and find a sense of belonging in a land that is both beautiful and unforgiving.

The film's narrative is structured around three main acts:

Act 1: Introduces Drover, a young drover who becomes embroiled in the war effort. He meets Lady Sarah Ashley, and they begin a romance.

Act 2: The Japanese attack on Darwin, and Drover must navigate the treacherous landscape of war-torn Australia. He forms an alliance with the Aboriginal people to fight against the Japanese occupation.

Act 3: The final act sees Drover's quest for revenge against those who have wronged him, including the Japanese commander who killed his family. In a climactic confrontation, Drover faces off against the enemy and finds a measure of redemption.

Overall, Australia (2008) is a powerful and emotional film that explores themes of survival, love, sacrifice, war, and identity in the face of adversity.

overview: When the evil wizard Gargamel chases the tiny blue Smurfs out of their village, they tumble from their magical world and into ours -- in fact, smack dab in the middle of Central Park. Just three apples high and stuck in the Big Apple, the Smurfs must find a way to get back to their village before Gargamel tracks them down.
tagline: Smurf Happens.
title: The Smurfs
plot:
The Smurfs is a 2011 American fantasy comedy film directed by Raja Gosnell and produced by Jerry Mendelsohn, Jordan Kerner, and Peter Venkata. The movie is based on the Belgian comic book series created by Peyo.

**Beginning:**
The film opens with Papa Smurf (voiced by Hank Azaria) warning his fellow Smurfs about a powerful sorcerer named Gargamel (played by Johnny Knoxville), who seeks to capture them and use their essence to gain immortality. The Smurfs are living in harmony in the forest, but they know that Gargamel's return is imminent.

**Plot Development:**
The story follows Brainy Smurf (voiced by Jayma Mays) as he discovers a magical book that allows him to travel through time and space. He decides to take his friends on a trip to New York City, where they can experience the human world. However, Gargamel and his cat, Azrael, also discover the book's location and follow the Smurfs to the city.

As the Smurfs navigate the urban jungle, they encounter various obstacles, including traffic, skyscrapers, and humans who are unaware of their existence. Meanwhile, Brainy Smurf becomes smitten with a human woman named Sophie (played by Emma Stone), who is initially oblivious to the Smurfs' presence.

**Plot Twist:**
As Gargamel's plan unfolds, he uses Azrael to capture the Smurfs and extract their essence. However, Brainy Smurf's book allows him to travel back in time and warn his friends about the impending danger. The Smurfs work together to outsmart Gargamel and Azrael, using their unique skills to evade capture.

**Climax:**
The final confrontation takes place at the Empire State Building, where the Smurfs face off against Gargamel and Azrael. Brainy Smurf uses his book to create a portal that allows him to travel back in time and prevent Gargamel from capturing the Smurfs' essence.

**Ending:**
In the end, the Smurfs successfully defeat Gargamel and return to their forest home. Sophie, who has grown attached to the Smurfs, decides to leave New York City with Brainy Smurf, starting a new life together. The film concludes with the Smurfs returning to their village, where they are welcomed back as heroes.

Overall, The Smurfs is a lighthearted and entertaining film that brings the beloved comic book characters to life on the big screen. While it may not be a critically acclaimed movie, it provides plenty of humor and action for fans of all ages.

overview: After a young girl witnesses a violent crime, she summons an imaginary dragon to help process her anger and protect her on her journey into womanhood.
tagline: I know what I saw.
title: Blaze
plot:
Blaze is a 2022 Australian drama co-written and directed by the artist Del Kathryn Barton in her feature film debut and produced by Causeway Films. Julia Savage stars as Blaze, a twelve-year-old girl, with Simon Baker as her father Luke, Yael Stone, Josh Lawson, Remy Hii and John Waters. The film premiered in the International Narrative Competition at the 2022 Tribeca Festival in New York and was released in Australian cinemas in August 2022 and in the United States in January 2023.

Blaze is a sensitive, imaginative girl who lives with her loving but somewhat uncertain single father, Luke. Walking home one day, she becomes the sole witness to the brutal sexual assault of a young woman, Hannah, who is killed in the attack. The experience leaves Blaze deeply traumatized; she withdraws into near silence, and her father struggles to understand how to help her.

To cope with what she has seen, Blaze retreats into a vivid inner world, populated by a glittering, life-size dragon named Zephy and filled with color, creatures and fantastical imagery. As the police build their case, they need Blaze's testimony to secure a conviction, and she is drawn into the legal process, facing interviews and the prospect of giving evidence in court, which the film portrays as poorly equipped to deal with a child's trauma. Meanwhile, Blaze's fantasies, rendered through Barton's own artwork, stop-motion animation, puppetry and elaborate design, swing between comfort and terror, while she also confronts the confusing changes of adolescence and her awakening anger at the violence men inflict on women. Gradually, through her imagination and her bond with her father, Blaze begins to find her voice and a measure of agency and healing.

Blaze received critical acclaim, with particular praise for Savage's performance and Barton's bold visual style. Metacritic gave it a score of 85, indicating universal acclaim, and it held an 88 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Peter Debruge of Variety called it the debut of a distinctive new voice despite a certain woodenness in its narrative, while critics in The Guardian and Time Out described it as breathtaking.

original_title: Tom and Jerry: Back to Oz
overview: After capturing the good witch, the villainous King Gnome creates havoc throughout Oz as he needs Dorothy's ruby slippers to take control of the Emerald City. So, it is up to Tom and Jerry to save the land of Oz!
tagline: We're off to see Tom and Jerry, in an all-new movie!

overview: It is the winter of 2018, the men and women of the UAE military are deployed to provide aid. At the Mocha Base, spirits are high as three Emirati soldiers anticipate an imminent return home. While on their final routine patrol, the three soldiers, Ali, Bilal and Hindasi are ambushed by heavily armed militants on their route, through a narrow canyon. Trapped, wounded, and out of communication range, the three soldiers realize the gravity of their situation. They are running out of options, munitions - and time. Back at the base, their commander receives word and realizes that the assault on the UAE army patrol was premeditated. A rescue mission is quickly put into action, but will air and land support reach the men in time, and will they survive?
tagline: They will bring their brothers home by any means necessary.
title: The Ambush
plot:
The Ambush (Arabic: Al Kameen) is a 2021 Emirati war action film directed by the French filmmaker Pierre Morel and written by Brandon and Kurtis Birtell. Based on a real incident during the Yemen war, it was produced by Image Nation Abu Dhabi and AGC Studios, with producers Derek Dauchy and Jennifer Roth and a score by Harry Gregson-Williams. The all-Emirati lead cast includes Marwan Abdulla Saleh, Khalifa Al Jassem, Mohammed Ahmed, Abdulla Saeed Bin Haider, Saeed Alharsh, Hassan Yousuf Alblooshi, Khalifa Albahri, Ghanim Nasser and Mansoor Alfeeli.

In the winter of 2018, soldiers of the UAE armed forces are deployed in Yemen, and at their base in Mocha morale is high, as three of them, Ali, Bilal and Al Hindasi, look forward to returning home soon. During what should be their last routine patrol, their vehicle is caught by heavily armed militants in a narrow mountain canyon. Wounded, trapped and out of radio contact, the three men realize how desperate their position is as they run short of options, ammunition and time. At the base, their commander learns of the attack and understands that the assault on the patrol was planned in advance. He quickly launches a rescue operation, sending another squad of Emirati soldiers with ground and air support into the valley in a race to reach the men before it is too late. The film also follows the families of some of the soldiers at home.

The production was described as the largest Arabic-language feature ever filmed in the Gulf Cooperation Council states, involving a cast and crew of around 400 and shot entirely in the United Arab Emirates, with a team of Emirati filmmakers and cultural consultants, including Hana Kazim, Talal Al Asmani, Alwiya Thani and Alia AlQemzi, working alongside the foreign crew.

The film had its world premiere at VOX Cinemas Yas Mall, attended by the cast and by the real soldiers whose story inspired it, and was released by VOX Distribution in the UAE on 25 November 2021. Its opening weekend drew 100,000 admissions, the fifth-largest opening of the year in the country, and within a week it had become the highest-grossing Emirati and Arabic-language film ever in the UAE, eventually earning more than $5 million worldwide. Morel described it as an inspirational story of brotherhood. In the United States, Well Go USA released it on Blu-ray; one reviewer praised the striking desert scenery but found the film thin, consisting almost entirely of combat.

overview: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.
title: Changing Lanes
plot:
Changing Lanes is a 2002 American legal thriller directed by Roger Michell, starring Ben Affleck as a young Wall Street lawyer and Samuel L. Jackson as an insurance salesman whose lives collide after a car accident. Toni Collette, Sydney Pollack, William Hurt, Amanda Peet and Kim Staunton co-star. Paramount Pictures released it in North America on April 12, 2002, and it earned nearly 95 million dollars worldwide on a 45 million dollar budget.

On a busy morning in New York, two men are racing to court. Doyle Gipson, a recovering alcoholic, is heading to a custody hearing where he hopes to keep his estranged wife from moving to Oregon with their sons, having arranged to buy a house nearby for the family. Gavin Banek, an ambitious lawyer at a prestigious firm, is rushing to file a document proving that a dead philanthropist signed control of his foundation over to the firm. On the FDR Drive, Banek's car collides with Gipson's. Instead of exchanging insurance details, Banek offers a blank cheque and drives off, leaving Gipson stranded with the words "better luck next time."

Gipson arrives late to find that the judge has ruled against him in his absence, granting his wife sole custody. Banek reaches court only to realise that the crucial file was left behind on the highway, and the judge allows him until the close of business to produce it. Gipson has the file but, bitter at what he has lost, refuses at first to return it.

The feud escalates. Banek pays a shady fixer to wreck Gipson's credit rating, destroying his chances of getting a mortgage, which drives Gipson to the brink of drinking again. In revenge, Gipson loosens the wheel nuts on Banek's car, causing a crash. Banek then calls Gipson's sons' school and claims that their father plans to abduct them, and Gipson is arrested, while his wife vows he will never see the children again. Along the way, Banek discovers that his own firm, including his boss and father-in-law, has been involved in fraud.

Shaken by what they have done, both men step back from their vendetta and apologise to each other. Gipson returns the file, which Banek uses to force his boss to run the firm honestly and to let him represent Gipson without charge. Banek also visits Gipson's wife and asks for five minutes of her time, and the next day Gipson sees his wife and sons smiling at him from across the street. The film was well reviewed, with 77% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: When Mystery, Inc. are guests of honor at the grand opening of the Coolsville Museum of Criminology, a masked villain shows up and creates havoc before stealing the costumes of the gang's most notorious villains...Could it be that their nemesis, mad scientist Jonathan Jacobo has returned and is trying to recreate their deadliest foes?
tagline: Doo the fright thing.
title: Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed
plot:
Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed is a 2004 American comedy-supernatural mystery film directed by Raja Gosnell and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The movie begins with the Mystery Inc. gang - Fred Jones, Daphne Blake, Velma Dinkley, Shaggy Rogers, and Scooby-Doo - returning to Coolsville after their previous adventure in the first film. However, they soon discover that a mysterious portal has opened up in the town, unleashing a horde of classic movie monsters from various films.

The gang decides to investigate the source of the monsters and put an end to them before they cause any more chaos. Along the way, they meet a new character, Emily Hart (played by Amanda Bynes), who is a fan of the gang's work and has been searching for them. She joins forces with the gang to help solve the mystery.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the monsters are being controlled by a mysterious figure known as "The Shadow" (played by Peter Boyle). The Shadow is revealed to be a former movie star who was obsessed with the monsters and wanted to bring them back to life. He uses his knowledge of special effects and makeup to create an army of monsters, which he controls using a device that emits a high-pitched frequency.

The gang soon discovers that The Shadow's plan is to use the monsters to scare people away from a new theme park called "Monster Land," which is being built in Coolsville. However, they also learn that The Shadow has a personal vendetta against the town and its residents, who he blames for his downfall as an actor.

As the gang delves deeper into the mystery, they encounter various monsters from classic films, including Dracula, Frankenstein's monster, the Wolf Man, and the Mummy. Along the way, they also uncover clues that suggest The Shadow's true identity and motivations.

In the end, the gang is able to defeat The Shadow and shatter his device, freeing the monsters from his control. However, not before he reveals that he was once a famous actor who was obsessed with the supernatural and wanted to bring it into the real world.

The movie ends with the gang reflecting on their adventure and realizing that they have saved Coolsville from destruction. Emily Hart is also shown to be a valuable addition to the team, and the gang welcomes her as one of their own.

Overall, Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed is a fun and lighthearted mystery film that pays homage to classic horror movies while still delivering plenty of laughs and excitement.

overview: Months after a zombie plague has wiped out 90 percent of the American population, a small group of survivors fight their way cross-country to a rumored refuge on the island of Catalina.
tagline: Mankind Survived... But Not Alive.
title: Zombie Apocalypse
plot:
Zombie Apocalypse, also released as 2012: Zombie Apocalypse, is a 2011 American zombie horror film produced by The Asylum for the Syfy channel. Directed by Nick Lyon, it stars Ving Rhames, Taryn Manning, Johnny Pacar, Lesley-Ann Brandt and Gary Weeks. It premiered on Syfy on October 29, 2011, and was released on DVD and Blu-ray that December.

Flashbacks explain that in June 2012 a virus known as VM2 was discovered in a woman in France. Within a month most of Europe was infected, and the disease spread around the world, turning its victims into flesh-eating zombies.
