A Single Man is a 2009 American drama film directed by Tom Ford, based on the 1964 novel of the same name by Christopher Isherwood.

The main themes of A Single Man include:

1. **Mourning and Grief**: The film explores the emotional journey of George Falconer (played by Colin Firth), a middle-aged English professor who is struggling to cope with the sudden death of his partner, Jim. The movie delves into the complexities of grief, loss, and the process of healing.

2. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As George navigates his new reality without Jim, he begins to re-evaluate his life, relationships, and sense of identity. The film becomes a introspective exploration of who George is, what he wants, and how he can move forward in a world that seems to have lost its meaning.

3. **Love and Relationships**: A Single Man examines the complexities of love, desire, and intimacy. George's relationship with Jim is portrayed as deep and meaningful, but also fraught with challenges. The film raises questions about the nature of love, whether it can be rekindled or recreated after loss.

4. **Social Commentary**: Set in 1960s Los Angeles, A Single Man offers a commentary on the social norms and expectations of that era. The film critiques the superficiality of wealthy communities and the societal pressures that govern relationships.

5. **Existentialism and Absurdism**: George's experiences are marked by moments of absurdity, humor, and existential crisis. The film touches on the idea that life is inherently meaningless, and it's up to individuals to create their own purpose and meaning in a seemingly indifferent world.

Overall, A Single Man is a poignant exploration of human emotions, relationships, and the search for meaning in a chaotic world.

overview: The film follows a man with an unwanted gift for healing who meets a teenager with cancer who helps him to find himself.
tagline: You will believe in miracles
title: The Healer
plot:
The Healer is a 2016 Spanish-Canadian-American comedy-drama written and directed by Paco Arango. Oliver Jackson-Cohen stars as Alec Bailey, a down-on-his-luck electrical engineer, with Camilla Luddington, Kaitlyn Bernard, Jorge Garcia and Jonathan Pryce. The profits from the film were pledged to the SeriousFun Children's Network, founded by Paul Newman to run camps for children with serious illnesses. It was released in the United States in February 2017.

In London, Alec is in a downward spiral after the deaths of his parents and his twin brother, Charlie. He sleeps around, gambles, runs a failing television repair shop called The Healer and is deep in debt. Out of the blue, his estranged uncle, Raymond Heacock, offers to pay off his debt of 88,000 pounds if Alec agrees to move to Nova Scotia and live there for a year. Chased by Russian debt collectors into a church, where a priest suggests the offer might be a second chance, Alec accepts and travels to his uncle's house near the coastal town of Lunenburg.

His first days in town go badly. He meets Cecilia, a local veterinarian who knows his uncle and helps him place an advertisement for his services; he tells the local priest, Father Malloy, that he is a Buddhist to avoid church; and a police officer, Tom, who dislikes his uncle, issues him a citation. Worse, the advertisement, headlined "The Healer" and promising that he can fix anything, is misunderstood, and townspeople start arriving at his door asking for miracles. Frustrated and short of money, Alec takes a job helping Cecilia. Strangely, the people who came to him in search of healing begin to recover, even though he turned them away, insisting that he is an engineer and not a doctor. As rumors of his gift spread, Alec learns that his family has a history of healers, and he is asked to help Abigail, a teenage girl with terminal cancer, forcing him to confront his skepticism, his grief and the responsibilities that come with his unexpected ability.

The Healer was panned by critics, holding a 17 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Michael Rechtshaffen of the Los Angeles Times wrote that although the cause was noble, the end result was decidedly less rewarding, and reviewers generally agreed that its altruistic intentions were not matched by its quality.

overview: Tormented by a past life, garbage man Clean attempts a life of quiet redemption. But when his good intentions mark him a target of a local crime boss, Clean is forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.
tagline: Revenge is a dirty business.
title: Clean
plot:
Clean is a 2021 American action thriller directed by Paul Solet and starring Adrien Brody, who also produced and wrote the film. Brody plays a garbage collector known as Clean, a solitary man with a violent past, whose attempt to protect a girl from his neighborhood brings him into conflict with a local crime boss.

In Utica, New York, Clean works as a garbage collector in a decaying, crime-ridden neighborhood. He salvages discarded objects, repairs them and sells them to a pawn shop, and lives alone in a workshop, haunted by the death of his daughter. He forms a protective bond with Dianda, a teenage girl who lives with her grandmother Ethel, driving her to school after her bus service is cut. While on his rounds, he witnesses Michael, a ruthless drug dealer who runs a seafood restaurant as a front, conducting his business, and later finds the remains of one of Michael's victims; Michael, who has beaten a supplier to death as a warning in front of his horrified son Mikey, offers Clean money for his silence, which he refuses. Ethel, meanwhile, questions Clean's motives, and he tells her he is only trying to save himself.

When Clean saves Dianda from a gang of young thugs who are assaulting her, one of whom is Michael's son Mikey, the drug lord orders a corrupt police officer to kill Dianda and her grandmother and bring Clean to him. Clean tries to flee the city with them, but when Michael's men catch up and the family's safety is threatened, he is forced to return to his violent past. It is revealed that he was once a feared professional assassin known as the Grim Reaper, and he arms himself and sets out to confront Michael and his gang directly.

The film is a character-driven vigilante story, focusing on themes of redemption, grief and the decay of urban communities.

Clean premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on June 19, 2021, and was released in theaters by IFC Films on January 28, 2022, earning about 162,000 dollars in its opening weekend, and it was later released on the streaming service AMC+ on May 6, 2022. Reviews were mixed, with 46 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes; Variety called it obvious and derivative.

overview: In 1909, two explorers fight to survive after they're left behind while on a Denmark expedition in ice-covered Greenland.
tagline: Survive the search. Survive each other.
title: Against the Ice
plot:
Against the Ice is a 2022 historical survival drama directed by Peter Flinth, with a screenplay by Nikolaj Coster-Waldau and Joe Derrick adapted from Ejnar Mikkelsen's memoir Two Against the Ice. Coster-Waldau plays the Danish explorer Mikkelsen and Joe Cole his companion Iver Iversen, with Charles Dance, Heida Reed and Gísli Örn Garðarsson. Shot in Iceland and Greenland, it premiered at the 72nd Berlin International Film Festival in February 2022 and was released on Netflix on March 2, 2022.

In 1909, Captain Ejnar Mikkelsen leads the Alabama expedition to Shannon Island in north-east Greenland. His goal is to recover the records of the ill-fated Denmark expedition, whose leader died while mapping the coast. The documents are crucial because the United States claims that a channel divides Greenland in two, which would undermine Denmark's sovereignty over the north of the island. A first attempt to reach the records fails and costs a crewman his toes to frostbite, but on the way Mikkelsen finds the body of a member of the earlier expedition with a map showing the location of a cairn.

Only the inexperienced engineer Iver Iversen volunteers to join him on a second attempt. The two set off by dog sled across the ice, gradually sacrificing their dogs to feed the remaining ones, and fight off a polar bear. After three months they find the cairn and its records, which prove that there is no channel and that Greenland is a single island. Fearing they may not survive the return journey, they leave the documents in a new cairn hundreds of kilometres from their base.

When they finally reach Shannon Island, they find that their ship has been crushed and the crew has gone home, leaving them stranded. They spend two winters in a small hut built from the wreckage, as hope of rescue fades. They retrieve the hidden records, while would-be rescuers visit the hut in their absence and find no one. Isolation and hunger push them towards madness: Mikkelsen imagines his beloved Naja is with him, Iversen sees his grandfather, and Mikkelsen almost shoots his companion.

In 1912 a Norwegian sealing ship finally rescues them, and their evidence supports Denmark's claim to the whole of Greenland. An epilogue notes that Mikkelsen married Naja the following year and that the two men remained lifelong friends. Reviews were mixed, with 57% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

original_title: The Figo Affair: The Transfer That Changed Football
overview: This documentary spotlights one of the most contentious deals in football history and the extraordinary player at the center of the storm: Luís Figo.
title: The Figo Affair: The Transfer That Changed Football
plot:
The Figo Affair: The Transfer That Changed Football (Spanish: El caso Figo) is a 2022 Spanish-British sports documentary film directed by David Tryhorn and Ben Nicholas, the duo behind the Netflix documentary Pelé and the earlier Crossing the Line. Produced by Hi-Pitch Productions, it was released on Netflix in August 2022 and runs 105 minutes. It features interviews with Luís Figo, Pep Guardiola, Roberto Carlos, Fernando Hierro, Jorge Valdano, Paulo Futre, the agent José Veiga, the former Barcelona president Joan Gaspart, the Real Madrid president Florentino Pérez and the journalist José Ramón de la Morena.

The film recounts the controversial transfer in the summer of 2000 of the Portuguese footballer Figo from Barcelona to their bitter rivals Real Madrid, in the same year he won the Ballon d'Or. Opening with a brooding Figo behind the wheel of a car, insisting that while many people think they know the story, only he knows the truth, it combines archive footage with the testimony of those involved. To explain why the move was seen as such a betrayal, it sets out the cultural and political divide between Catalonia and Madrid, including the legacy of Franco's dictatorship, with Guardiola, Figo's former roommate and confidant, describing what Barcelona means to Catalans. It follows Pérez's campaign for the Real Madrid presidency, in which he promised to sign Figo if elected and to pay the membership fees of every member if he failed, his use of the sports press, and his media sparring with Gaspart. The negotiations led by Veiga and Pérez's associates build to a deal that, despite Figo repeatedly saying he wanted to stay at Barcelona, made the seemingly impossible inevitable. The world-record fee of around £37 million launched Real Madrid's Galácticos era and, the film argues, reshaped the transfer market. The directors said they deliberately structured it as a heist movie focused on a three-week period.

Liam Miller of Urban Pitch praised its gripping mix of jaw-dropping archive footage and candid interviews, saying it shattered simplistic good-versus-evil accounts of the saga and showed that the player is the least important part of a transfer. RobScene rated it 6/10, calling it an accomplished, engrossing and compelling account in which the participants contradict one another, but felt it was too long and lingered too much on the negotiations at the expense of the aftermath.

overview: A desperate father tries to return home to his pregnant wife after a mysterious apocalyptic event turns everything to chaos.
tagline: No one survives alone
title: How It Ends
plot:
How It Ends is a 2018 American apocalyptic action thriller directed by David M. Rosenthal and written by Brooks McLaren. Theo James stars as Will, a young lawyer, with Forest Whitaker as his prospective father-in-law Tom, Kat Graham as his pregnant girlfriend Sam, Grace Dove, Nicole Ari Parker and Mark O'Brien. Netflix released the film on 13 July 2018.

Will and Sam, a young couple living in Seattle, are expecting their first child. Will flies to Chicago to visit Sam's parents, intending to ask her father, Tom, a retired Marine, for permission to marry her. Dinner ends in an argument between the two men, and Will leaves without mentioning either the pregnancy or the proposal. The next day, as Will waits for his flight home, Sam calls him in alarm, saying that something is wrong, before the line goes dead. All flights are canceled, and television news reports a mysterious seismic event off the West Coast that has knocked out power and communications.

Will returns to Sam's parents' house, and he and Tom set aside their differences to drive across the country to find her. As they head west, they encounter jammed highways, military roadblocks and growing social collapse. Tom uses his military background to talk their way through a checkpoint, and that night they are pulled over by a man in a police car who turns out to be an escaped prisoner; in the violent confrontation that follows, Tom is injured. They tow their damaged car to a Native American reservation, where a young mechanic, Ricki, repairs it and agrees to travel with them. The journey grows increasingly dangerous as they face desperate survivors, violent bandits, strange atmospheric phenomena and dwindling supplies of fuel and food. Along the way, Will and Tom slowly develop mutual respect, while the cause of the catastrophe remains a mystery and the land around them becomes ever more hostile as they near the Pacific Northwest.

How It Ends received negative reviews, holding a 17 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 36. Critics praised Whitaker's performance and some of the action sequences but were frustrated by the film's refusal to explain the nature of the disaster and especially by its abrupt, ambiguous ending, which became the most discussed aspect of the film among viewers.

overview: In Madrid, Spain, a mysterious serial killer ruthlessly murders his victims by recreating the first appearance of several comic book superheroes. Cosme, a veteran police inspector who is about to retire, works on the case along with the tormented inspector David Valentín and his own son Jorge Elías, a nerdy young man who owns a comic book store.
title: Unknown Origins
plot:
Unknown Origins (Spanish: Orígenes secretos) is a 2020 Spanish thriller film directed by David Galán Galindo, who wrote the screenplay with Fernando Navarro, adapting his own novel of the same name. It stars Javier Rey, Verónica Echegui and Brays Efe alongside Antonio Resines. The film combines a police procedural with an affectionate tribute to comic books and superhero mythology.

In Madrid in 2019, a series of grotesque murders shakes the city. The killer stages each crime as a recreation of the origin story of a famous superhero: one victim is pumped full of supplements and steroids until he resembles the Hulk, while another has his heart removed and his body encased in a metal suit. The case falls to David, a serious and methodical police inspector who considers comic books childish entertainment for overgrown adults, a prejudice that quickly proves to be a handicap. He is initially partnered with Cosme, a veteran officer spending his last days on the force after being forced to resign.

Realizing that the investigation demands specialist knowledge, Cosme suggests that his son, Jorge Elías, a passionate comic book fan who runs a comic store in the city, would be better suited to help David. The mismatched pair work under the homicide chief, Norma, an enthusiastic cosplayer who prefers films and anime to comics. As the killer remains a step ahead of them and the press makes the murders public, David discovers that the death of his own parents mirrors the murder of Bruce Wayne's parents, Thomas and Martha Wayne, revealing a personal connection to the case. Racing against time, the trio uncover the identity of the killer, who turns out to be someone from inside the police department, and try to stop his final plans.

The film plays with superhero conventions and comic book references, contrasting the skeptical detective with the devoted fan who becomes his indispensable partner.

Unknown Origins was originally scheduled to screen at the 2020 Málaga Film Festival, but the filmmakers withdrew it when the festival was moved from March to August because of scheduling changes. It was released worldwide on Netflix on August 28, 2020, reaching an international audience through the streaming service.

overview: When the sky really is falling and sanity has flown the coop, who will rise to save the day? Together with his hysterical band of misfit friends, Chicken Little must hatch a plan to save the planet from alien invasion and prove that the world's biggest hero is a little chicken.
tagline: When it comes to saving the world, it helps to be a little chicken.
title: Chicken Little
plot:
Chicken Little is a 2005 animated comedy film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie follows the story of a chicken named Chicken Little, who lives on a farm with his friends and family.

The film begins with Chicken Little, played by Zach Braff, being a carefree and naive chicken who loves to explore the outdoors. One day, while out foraging for food, Chicken Little sees an acorn fall from the sky and believes it is a sign that the world is ending. He rushes back to the farm to warn his friends, including Duckworth (Don Knotts), a wise old duck, and Abby Mallard (voiced by Joan Cusack), a kind-hearted chicken.

Chicken Little's warning causes panic among the animals on the farm, leading to chaos and destruction. The other animals believe that the world is indeed ending, and they start to prepare for their final days together. Meanwhile, Chicken Little becomes convinced that he has seen the end of the world and sets out on a journey to find the "Great Prince" who can save them.

Along the way, Chicken Little meets a group of birds who are also searching for the Great Prince. There's Buck Cluck (Steve Martin), a wise-cracking rooster who becomes Chicken Little's friend and ally; Runt (Matthew Broderick), a fast-talking pigeon who is initially skeptical of Chicken Little's claims but eventually joins him on his quest.

As they journey through the forest, the group faces various obstacles and challenges, including treacherous terrain, fierce predators, and their own personal doubts and fears. Through it all, Chicken Little learns valuable lessons about courage, friendship, and believing in oneself.

In the end, Chicken Little and his friends discover that the "Great Prince" is actually a wise old owl named Professor Henny Penny (Patrick Warburton), who has been watching over them from afar. The professor explains that the acorn was just a normal part of nature and that there is no need to panic.

Chicken Little returns home, where he is welcomed back as a hero by his friends and family. He learns to appreciate the simple things in life and becomes more confident and self-assured. The movie ends with Chicken Little and his friends enjoying a sunny day together on the farm, free from fear and anxiety.

Overall, Chicken Little is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of friendship, courage, and believing in oneself. With its colorful animation, witty humor, and lovable characters, it's a great choice for families and audiences of all ages.

overview: An imaginary world comes to life in a holiday tale of an eccentric toymaker, his adventurous granddaughter, and a magical invention that has the power to change their lives forever.
tagline: Discover a world of wishes and wonder
title: Jingle Jangle: A Christmas Journey
plot:
Jingle Jangle: A Christmas Journey is a Netflix original musical fantasy film released in 2020, produced by Will Packer and Marlon Wayans through their production company, Black & White Productions. The movie stars Forest Whitaker as Jeronicus Jangle, a brilliant toymaker who creates magical toys that bring joy to children.

The story begins with Jeronicus Jangle (Forest Whitaker), a renowned toymaker who lives in the fictional town of Whimsy, where he creates extraordinary toys that can come to life. However, his obsession with creating the perfect toy leads him to abandon his daughter, Journey (Madison Davenport), and his wife, Abilene (Keegan-Michael Key).

Years later, Jeronicus is haunted by a curse that was placed upon him by his estranged daughter, who has grown up in a world without magic. The only way to break the curse is for Jeronicus to reunite with Journey and make amends for his past mistakes.

Jeronicus sets out on a journey to find Journey, accompanied by his loyal apprentice, Gus (Bryan Cranston), and Abilene, who has been searching for her father all these years. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, wicked creatures, and Jeronicus's own self-doubt.

As Jeronicus navigates this challenging journey, he learns valuable lessons about love, forgiveness, and the importance of family. He also discovers that Journey has grown into a talented young woman with her own unique gifts, which she uses to help those in need.

Throughout their adventure, Jeronicus and Journey face numerous challenges, including a rival toymaker, Mr. Hobbs (Gerald McRaney), who seeks to steal Jeronicus's secrets and claim the title of greatest toymaker for himself.

Ultimately, Jeronicus and Journey reach Whimsy, where they are reunited with Abilene and the rest of their community. With the help of his friends and family, Jeronicus breaks the curse that has haunted him for so long, and he is finally able to reconnect with his daughter and rediscover his passion for creating magical toys.

The movie features a range of catchy musical numbers, including "Jingle Jangle," "Make Room for Love," and "All I Want for Christmas Is You." The film's blend of music, fantasy, and family drama makes it a heartwarming and entertaining holiday treat.

overview: Joe Gardner is a middle school teacher with a love for jazz music. After a successful audition at the Half Note Club, he suddenly gets into an accident that separates his soul from his body and is transported to the You Seminar, a center in which souls develop and gain passions before being transported to a newborn child. Joe must enlist help from the other souls-in-training, like 22, a soul who has spent eons in the You Seminar, in order to get back to Earth.
tagline: Is all this living really worth dying for?
title: Soul
plot:
Soul is a 2020 animated fantasy comedy-drama film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Joe Gardner, an aspiring jazz pianist who dreams of becoming a professional musician. He works as a middle school music teacher in Brooklyn, New York, but his passion for music is constantly overshadowed by his mundane life. One day, while playing with his students, Joe gets into an accident that leaves him clinically dead.

As he navigates the afterlife, known as "The Great Before," Joe meets 22, a soul who is on a mission to help new souls find their purpose in life. However, 22's enthusiasm and constant mistakes lead to chaos, causing many souls to become stuck in limbo. Joe sees an opportunity to help 22 and, together, they embark on a journey through the "Great Before" to find the perfect soul for each person.

Along the way, Joe and 22 encounter various characters, including Soul's mentor, 75, who teaches them about the concept of purpose and passion. They also meet other souls, such as Camila, who is stuck in limbo due to her fear of failure. As they navigate the afterlife, Joe begins to realize that his true purpose lies not in becoming a professional musician but in sharing music with others.

The movie explores themes of identity, purpose, and the importance of following one's passion. Through its vibrant animation and catchy jazz soundtrack, Soul takes audiences on an emotional journey that celebrates the beauty of life and the power of human connection.

Overall, Soul is a heartwarming and visually stunning film that will leave viewers inspired to pursue their dreams and find their true purpose in life.

overview: Two lifelong friends head up to an isolated Scottish Highlands village for a weekend hunting trip that descends into a never-ending nightmare as they attempt to cover up a horrific hunting accident.
tagline: You can't bury the truth
title: Calibre
plot:
Calibre is a 2018 British psychological thriller film written and directed by Matt Palmer in his feature debut. Jack Lowden and Martin McCann star as two lifelong friends whose hunting trip in the Scottish Highlands turns into a nightmare, with Tony Curran in support. After premiering at the Edinburgh International Film Festival, it was released on Netflix in June 2018.

Vaughn, a quiet Edinburgh man whose fiancée is expecting their first child, joins his confident, wealthy childhood friend Marcus for a weekend of deer hunting in a remote Highland village. On their first night, they drink at the local pub, where they meet the community's leader, Logan, and two young women, Kara and Iona. Marcus goes home with Kara despite being warned off. The next morning, a hungover Vaughn realizes he has forgotten his ammunition, so Marcus illegally lends him one of his rifles. When Vaughn fires at a stag, it moves at the last moment and his bullet kills a young boy who was hidden behind it. The boy's grief-stricken father seizes the rifle and turns it on Vaughn, and Marcus shoots him dead.

Vaughn wants to go to the police, but Marcus persuades him that they will be treated as murderers. They hide the bodies, and that night return to bury them after Marcus cuts the bullets out of them. Back in the village, Logan invites them to dinner and asks Marcus to help find investors for the struggling community, while one of Logan's brothers slashes their tires as revenge for Marcus's night with Kara, trapping them in the village while repairs are made. Vaughn learns that the victims were Logan's relatives, and suspicion grows when Marcus mentions the missing pair before word of the father's disappearance has spread.

The two men are drawn into the search party, and a dog leads the villagers to the grave. Marcus and Vaughn attempt to flee, but their car is disabled and they are hunted down. Captured, Vaughn confesses. Logan gives him a terrible ultimatum: kill Marcus, or both will die. After resisting, Vaughn shoots his friend, and Logan coaches him in a cover story for the police. Months later, Vaughn, now a father, sits awake in the dark at home, haunted by what he has done, before going to comfort his crying baby.

Calibre received critical acclaim, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 100% approval and Metacritic a score of 76. Critics praised its tension and its lead performances.

overview: A Foreign Service Officer in London tries to prevent a terrorist attack set to hit New York, but is forced to go on the run when she is framed for crimes she did not commit.
tagline: His next target is now hunting him
title: Survivor
plot:
Survivor is a 2015 action spy thriller directed by James McTeigue and written by Philip Shelby. Milla Jovovich stars as Kate Abbott, a Diplomatic Security Service agent, and Pierce Brosnan as a deadly assassin known as the Watchmaker, with Dylan McDermott, Robert Forster, Angela Bassett, James D'Arcy, Frances de la Tour, Genevieve O'Reilly and, in his final film role, Roger Rees. The film was released in cinemas in the United Kingdom on 5 June 2015 and direct-to-video in the United States later that month.

During a firefight in the Middle East, an American soldier, Johnny Talbot, is captured by terrorists and forced to watch the execution of a comrade. In London, Kate Abbott, who joined government service after losing friends in the September 11 attacks, works at the American Embassy screening visa applications to keep terrorists out of the United States, and introduces stricter checks. When her colleagues gather at a restaurant for the birthday of their superior, Bill Talbot, a bomb explodes, killing most of her team. Kate survives only because she stepped out to buy a last-minute present. Bill, it emerges, is Johnny's father and has been blackmailed into approving visas for terrorists under threat to his son's life.

Fleeing the bomber, Kate is attacked by Bill and kills him in self-defense, and witnesses and camera footage make her the prime suspect in the attack. Investigators find traces of chromium in the bomb, leading her superior at the embassy, Sam Parker, to conclude that the killer is the Watchmaker, one of the world's most wanted assassins, known for his precision. Hunted by the police and by the Watchmaker, who has been hired to eliminate her, Kate goes on the run through London, trying to clear her name and uncover a plot by a terrorist network and its financier to carry out a devastating attack in New York's Times Square on New Year's Eve. With few allies she can trust, she must reach New York and stop the attack before midnight, while the Watchmaker closes in.

Survivor received almost uniformly negative reviews, holding an 8 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus said it borrowed heavily from better films in the service of a predictable story. IGN gave it 5 out of 10. Critics found Brosnan's villainous turn one of the few highlights of an otherwise generic thriller.

overview: When a wounded Christian Grey tries to entice a cautious Ana Steele back into his life, she demands a new arrangement before she will give him another chance. As the two begin to build trust and find stability, shadowy figures from Christian’s past start to circle the couple, determined to destroy their hopes for a future together.
tagline: Every fairy tale has a dark side.
title: Fifty Shades Darker
plot:
Fifty Shades Darker is a 2017 American erotic romantic drama film directed by Christian Ditter and written by Kelly Marcel. The film is based on the novel of the same name by E.L. James.

The movie picks up where the previous installment, Fifty Shades of Grey, left off. Anastasia Steele (played by Dakota Johnson) has been in a tumultuous relationship with billionaire Christian Grey (played by Jamie Dornan). Despite their differences, they have grown closer, but their relationship is put to the test when Anastasia's past comes back to haunt her.

Anastasia's former boyfriend, Jack Hyde (played by Daniel Gillies), reappears and reveals that he has been in contact with Anastasia's ex-boyfriend, Robert, who had died under mysterious circumstances. This revelation threatens to destroy Anastasia's relationship with Christian, as she struggles to reconcile her feelings for him with the pain of her past.

Meanwhile, Christian is dealing with his own demons. He is haunted by a traumatic event from his childhood and is struggling to come to terms with his own darkness. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Christian's past is more complex than Anastasia initially thought.

As tensions rise between Anastasia and Christian, they engage in a game of cat and mouse. Christian tries to win Anastasia back by showering her with gifts and attention, but she remains uncertain about her feelings for him. On the other hand, Anastasia struggles to reconcile her desire for Christian with her growing sense of unease about his controlling behavior.

The film's climax revolves around a dramatic confrontation between Anastasia and Christian. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Christian has been hiding a dark secret: he has been involved in human trafficking and has been using his wealth and influence to exploit vulnerable women.

Anastasia is horrified by this revelation and feels betrayed by Christian's deception. However, as she reflects on their relationship, she realizes that she has grown to love Christian despite his flaws. In the end, Anastasia chooses to stay with Christian, but not before he makes a dramatic gesture of devotion to her.

The film ends on a hopeful note, with Anastasia and Christian embarking on a new chapter in their relationship. However, the ending is also somewhat ambiguous, leaving audiences wondering whether Anastasia has truly found happiness with Christian or if she is simply trapped in a toxic relationship.

Overall, Fifty Shades Darker is a complex and thought-provoking film that explores themes of love, control, and redemption. While it may not be to everyone's taste, the film is undeniably captivating and will keep viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

overview: America's coolest heroes, the Teen Titans, go to Tokyo to track down the mysterious Japanese criminal Brushogun.
tagline: The Titans go ninja on the notorious villain Brushogun in their awesome first feature-length movie.
title: Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo
plot:
Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo is a 2006 animated superhero film based on the DC Comics/Vertigo imprint's Teen Titans series. The movie follows the story of Robin, Starfire, Raven, Cyborg, and Beast Boy as they travel to Japan for a martial arts tournament.

The main themes of Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo include:

1. Friendship and teamwork: The movie highlights the strong bond between the Teen Titans, who work together to overcome various challenges and defeat their enemies.
2. Cultural differences and understanding: As the team travels to Japan, they encounter different customs and traditions that lead to comedic misunderstandings and cultural clashes. However, through their experiences, they learn to appreciate and respect each other's differences.
3. Identity and self-discovery: Each character in the movie struggles with their own identity and sense of belonging. Robin grapples with his role as a leader, Starfire tries to understand human emotions, Raven deals with her dark past, Cyborg navigates his robotic heritage, and Beast Boy faces his own uniqueness.
4. Balancing individuality and unity: The Teen Titans must balance their individual strengths and weaknesses while working together to achieve their goals. This theme is reflected in the movie's action-packed sequences and comedic moments.

The film also explores some darker themes, such as:

1. Trauma and PTSD: Raven's past experiences with her mother, Arella, are revealed, showing the emotional scars she carries.
2. Loyalty and duty: The team faces a moral dilemma when they must choose between their personal goals and their responsibilities to each other.

Overall, Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo is a lighthearted, action-packed film that balances humor with heart, exploring themes of friendship, identity, and teamwork.

overview: After their high school basketball coach passes away, five good friends and former teammates reunite for a Fourth of July holiday weekend.
tagline: Boys will be boys. . . some longer than others.
title: Grown Ups
plot:
Grown Ups is a 2010 American comedy film directed by Dennis Dugan and written by Adam Sandler, Fred Wolf, and Tim Herlihy. The movie stars Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock, David Spade, Rob Schneider, and Salma Hayek.

The story begins with Lenny Feder (Adam Sandler), a wealthy and successful businessman who is married to Roxanne Chase-Feder (Salma Hayek). They have two children, but their marriage has become stale due to the lack of intimacy. Lenny's friends from high school, including Eric Lamonsoff (Kevin James), Kurt McKenzie (Chris Rock), Marcus Higgins (David Spade), and Rob Hilliard (Rob Schneider), are all going through similar midlife crises.

The group decides to take a trip together to Central America for their friend's 40th birthday party. However, things quickly go awry when they discover that the party is actually a funeral for their old high school friend, who died in a tragic accident. The group is forced to confront their past and re-evaluate their lives.

Upon arrival at the funeral, Lenny realizes that he has lost touch with his friends and that they have all become more like family than friends. He decides to take matters into his own hands and organize a backyard barbecue for the group's 40th birthday party, which becomes an opportunity for them to reconnect and reminisce about old times.

As the party progresses, Lenny's marriage is put to the test when Roxanne discovers that he has been having an affair with a younger woman. The group rallies around Lenny, offering their support and advice, but ultimately, it's up to Lenny to make things right with his wife.

Throughout the movie, the characters' relationships are put to the test as they navigate love, friendship, and growing older. In the end, Lenny learns a valuable lesson about the importance of family and friendship, and he makes amends with Roxanne. The movie ends on a heartwarming note, with the group celebrating their 40th birthdays together and looking forward to many more years of friendship.

Overall, Grown Ups is a lighthearted and entertaining comedy that explores themes of friendship, love, and growing older. With its talented ensemble cast and witty dialogue, it's no wonder why this movie became a box office hit.

overview: Dave Lizewski is an unnoticed high school student and comic book fan who one day decides to become a super-hero, even though he has no powers, training or meaningful reason to do so.
tagline: Shut up. Kick-Ass.
title: Kick-Ass
plot:
Kick-Ass is a 2010 superhero action-comedy film directed by Matthew Vaughn, based on the comic book series of the same name by Mark Millar and John Romita Jr. The movie follows the story of two young protagonists who decide to become superheroes despite having no powers or experience.

The film begins with Frank D'Amico (Michael Angarano), a 12-year-old boy who witnesses his mother being brutally murdered by a group of thugs led by Big Daddy (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Little Daddy (Chloe Moretz). The event sparks Frank's desire to become a superhero, inspired by the comic book heroes he reads about.

Frank creates his own superhero alter ego, Kick-Ass (Aaron Johnson), using a homemade costume and a toy sword. He sets out to fight crime in his neighborhood, but his lack of skills and experience lead to more chaos than justice. Meanwhile, Big Daddy and Little Daddy are hired by Frank's father, Damon D'Amico (Nicolas Cage), to take care of the neighborhood.

As Kick-Ass continues to try and make a name for himself as a superhero, he attracts the attention of Hit-Girl (Chloe Moretz), a 12-year-old girl who has been trained by Big Daddy in the art of combat. The two form an unlikely partnership, with Kick-Ass learning from Hit-Girl's expertise.

However, their efforts are soon disrupted by the arrival of The Big Daddy and Mother Russia (Olga Kurylenko), a Russian assassin hired to kill Frank D'Amico. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Big Daddy is not just a simple hitman but also a complex character with his own motivations.

Throughout the film, Kick-Ass and Hit-Girl face various challenges as they try to stop The Big Daddy's plans. Along the way, they encounter other characters, including Mind-Numbing Menace (Jemaine Clement), a villainous mastermind who uses his powers of persuasion to manipulate others.

As the story reaches its climax, Kick-Ass and Hit-Girl must confront their own limitations and work together to stop The Big Daddy's true intentions. In the end, Frank D'Amico is killed by The Big Daddy, but not before he has a change of heart and decides to protect his son from becoming a vigilante.

The film concludes with Kick-Ass and Hit-Girl reflecting on what they have learned about themselves and their place in the world. Despite the chaos and violence that surrounds them, they have found a sense of purpose and belonging as superheroes. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even the most unlikely heroes can make a difference.

Overall, Kick-Ass is a darkly comedic take on the superhero genre, exploring themes of identity, morality, and the consequences of playing with fire. The film's success can be attributed to its unique blend of action, humor, and heart, making it a standout in the world of superhero movies.

overview: A team of U.S. government agents is sent to investigate the bombing of an American facility in the Middle East.
tagline: How do you stop an enemy who isn't afraid to die?
title: The Kingdom
plot:
The Kingdom is a 2007 American action thriller directed by Peter Berg and starring Jamie Foxx, Chris Cooper, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman, with Ashraf Barhom, Ali Suliman and Jeremy Piven. Set in Saudi Arabia, it follows an FBI team investigating a terrorist attack, drawing on the 1996 Khobar Towers bombing, the 2003 Riyadh compound bombings and the 2004 Khobar massacre. It premiered at the Edinburgh International Film Festival before Universal Pictures released it in the United States on September 28, 2007.

In Riyadh, militants disguised as Saudi police storm a compound housing American oil workers and their families, shooting residents before a suicide bomber blows himself up; Sergeant Haytham of the Saudi police manages to stop one gunman. As investigators gather, a second, much larger bomb devastates the site, killing Francis Manner, the FBI's legal attaché, among others. In Washington, Special Agent Ronald Fleury, Manner's friend, suspects that the attack was masterminded by the elusive terrorist Abu Hamza.

Although the Justice and State Departments try to keep the FBI out, Fleury pressures the Saudi ambassador into granting his team a short visit. He brings forensic examiner Janet Mayes, intelligence analyst Adam Leavitt and bomb technician Grant Sykes. In Riyadh they are assigned to Colonel Faris al-Ghazi of the Saudi State Police, while a National Guard general keeps them from the evidence. At a meeting with a Saudi prince, Fleury persuades him to put al-Ghazi in charge, giving the Americans access to the crime scene, and Fleury and al-Ghazi develop a mutual respect.

The investigators find that the second bomb was hidden in an ambulance, leading to a raid on a militant hideout. Ordered home by the embassy, the team's convoy is ambushed and Leavitt is kidnapped. Al-Ghazi and the agents chase the abductors into a dangerous district and a fierce gun battle erupts; Mayes rescues Leavitt moments before his filmed execution.

In a nearby apartment, al-Ghazi realises that an old man is Abu Hamza. Abu Hamza's teenage grandson shoots al-Ghazi, and Fleury and Haytham kill the boy and the terrorist. Al-Ghazi dies in Fleury's arms. Back home, Leavitt asks what Fleury whispered to Mayes after Manner's death, and the film reveals that Fleury's words and those of Abu Hamza to his grandchild were the same: that they would kill them all.

The film received mixed reviews, with 51% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and was banned in Kuwait and Bahrain.

overview: Waking Life is about a young man in a persistent lucid dream-like state. The film follows its protagonist as he initially observes and later participates in philosophical discussions that weave together issues like reality, free will, our relationships with others, and the meaning of life.
tagline: Dreams. What are they? An escape from reality or reality itself?
title: Waking Life
plot:
Waking Life is a thought-provoking animated film that delves into the complexities of human existence, free will, and the nature of reality. The movie's narrative is presented in a non-linear fashion, featuring a young man who finds himself in a series of surreal conversations with various characters, each representing different philosophical perspectives.

At its core, Waking Life explores the idea of existentialism, questioning the notion of a predetermined path in life and the concept of free will. The film's protagonist is presented with a series of choices that challenge his perception of reality, forcing him to confront the possibility that his decisions may be influenced by external factors beyond his control.

The movie also touches on the theme of nihilism, as some characters express a sense of hopelessness and despair in the face of an seemingly meaningless world. However, this bleakness is balanced by moments of introspection, self-discovery, and a deep appreciation for the complexities of human experience.

Furthermore, Waking Life critiques the notion of a singular, objective truth, instead suggesting that reality is subjective and multifaceted. The film's use of multiple perspectives and conflicting viewpoints serves to underscore this idea, leaving the viewer to ponder the nature of reality and their place within it.

Ultimately, Waking Life presents a nuanced and thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, inviting viewers to consider the complexities of existence and the choices that shape our lives.

overview: In the near future, Cameron Turner is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Presented with an experimental solution to shield his wife and son from grief, he grapples with altering their fate.
tagline: A thought-provoking exploration of love, loss, and sacrifice.
title: Swan Song

overview: An inspirational speaker becomes reinvigorated after meeting a lively woman who shakes up his mundane existence.
tagline: Welcome to the Kaufman surreal-neorealism tale in a dull world of sameness.
title: Anomalisa
plot:
Anomalisa is a 2015 American adult stop-motion animated comedy-drama directed by Charlie Kaufman and Duke Johnson from a screenplay by Kaufman, based on his 2005 "sound play" written under the pseudonym Francis Fregoli. Drawing on the Fregoli delusion, a condition in which a person believes that different people are the same person, it combines psychological drama, romance and surrealism. David Thewlis voices Michael Stone, Jennifer Jason Leigh voices Lisa Hesselman, and Tom Noonan voices every other character. The film was partly financed through a Kickstarter campaign and produced by Starburns Industries.

In 2005, Michael Stone, an English-born customer-service expert and motivational author living in Los Angeles, travels to Cincinnati to speak at a convention, staying at the Fregoli Hotel. Lonely and depressed, he perceives everyone around him, including his wife and son, as having the same face and the same voice. In his room, preparing his speech, he is haunted by an angry letter from Bella, a former lover he abandoned years earlier without explanation. He meets her at the hotel bar, but she is still hurt, and when he invites her to his room she storms out. Wandering the city, he enters what he thinks is a toy store to buy his son a present and finds himself in an adult shop, where he is fascinated by an antique Japanese animatronic doll.

Back at the hotel, Michael hears a distinctive female voice and rushes to find its owner. She is Lisa, a shy, self-conscious woman from Akron attending the convention with her co-worker Emily, and to Michael she looks and sounds unlike anyone else. He invites both women for drinks and then, to Lisa's surprise, invites her to his room. Enchanted, he asks her to sing, and she performs Cyndi Lauper's "Girls Just Want to Have Fun." When she calls herself an anomaly, he gives her the nickname Anomalisa. They spend the night together, and Michael resolves to leave his family for her, but as the next day begins, his perception of her begins to change, and his breakdown at the convention exposes the depth of his alienation.

Anomalisa received widespread acclaim, holding a 92 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 88. It won the Grand Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, becoming one of the first R-rated animated films to receive that nomination.

overview: Dissatisfied with the dishonesty they see in dating, strangers Naima and Sergio make a pact to spend 24 straight hours together in an attempt to fast forward their relationship.
title: Duck Butter
plot:
Duck Butter is a 2018 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Chris Morris and written by Chris Morris and Will Reiser. The movie follows the story of two men, Peter (played by Clé Bennett) and Buck (played by Jerry Stiller), who are part of an international organization called Duck Butter, which aims to promote unity among its members through a series of rituals and ceremonies.

The main theme of Duck Butter revolves around the exploration of masculinity, identity, and human connection. The film delves into the complexities of male relationships, particularly those that exist outside of traditional societal norms. Peter and Buck's relationship is at the center of this exploration, as they navigate their feelings for each other amidst a backdrop of absurd rituals and ceremonies.

Through Duck Butter, the filmmakers critique traditional notions of masculinity and challenge the audience to rethink what it means to be a man. The film also touches on themes of loneliness, vulnerability, and the search for meaning in life. As Peter and Buck's relationship deepens, they must confront their own insecurities and fears, leading to a poignant exploration of human connection and intimacy.

Ultimately, Duck Butter is a heartwarming and humorous film that celebrates the beauty of human relationships and challenges societal norms around masculinity and identity.

overview: When troubled musical prodigy Charlotte seeks out Elizabeth, the new star pupil of her former school, the encounter sends both musicians down a sinister path with shocking consequences.
tagline: It's time to face the music
title: The Perfection
plot:
The Perfection is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, particularly in the realm of music and performance. At its core, the film explores the theme of obsession, as embodied by the complex and multifaceted character of Claire Fitch, a cello prodigy with an unrelenting drive for perfection.

Through Claire's character, the film examines the blurred lines between genius and madness, highlighting the devastating consequences of an all-consuming passion that can both elevate and destroy. The movie also touches on the theme of trauma, as Claire's past is slowly revealed to be marred by a tragic event that has left her with emotional scars.

Furthermore, The Perfection critiques the cutthroat world of classical music, where the pursuit of excellence can lead to ruthless competition and exploitation. The film raises questions about the true cost of artistic ambition and the toll it takes on one's mental health.

Ultimately, The Perfection is a thought-provoking exploration of the darker corners of human psychology, where the lines between reality and fantasy are constantly blurred.

overview: An 18-year-old begins dating a charming 50-year-old man who treats her to shopping sprees and fancy restaurants, creating a huge rift with her mother. Mom’s instincts prove right when the man becomes psychologically manipulative, turning the girl into an emotional prisoner in his mansiIon.
title: Prisoner of Love
plot:
Prisoner of Love, also known as Trapped by My Sugar Daddy, the title under which it aired on Lifetime, is a 2022 Canadian thriller television film directed by Lindsay Hartley from a screenplay by Casey Bose, based on a story by Bose and Dave Hickey. Produced by Almost Never Films with Reel One Entertainment for the Lifetime network, it stars Katie Kelly as an 18-year-old drawn into a relationship with a much older man, with James Hyde, Tiffany Montgomery, Heather Lynn Harris, Ryan Francis, Ashton Leigh and Hartley herself in supporting roles. The film premiered on Lifetime in January 2022 and runs 85 minutes.

After a prologue in which a woman boarding a private jet is abducted, the story moves to Connecticut, where Carly (Kelly) and her mother Sarah (Montgomery) work together as a home décor team. When a wealthy new neighbour, Kyle (Hyde), moves into a mansion nearby, they lose the job to the overbearing rival designer Amanda James (Hartley), but persuade him to hire them instead. Kyle, a charming man of about fifty, takes a particular interest in Carly, inviting her to dinner and treating her to shopping sprees and fancy restaurants. Encouraged by her friend Mel, who becomes involved with Kyle's friend Brent, Carly is dazzled and breaks up with her boyfriend Ben. When Sarah learns of the romance, the two clash bitterly and Carly leaves home. Kyle's charm gives way to jealousy and psychological manipulation: he puts Ben in a coma, isolates Carly from her parents and becomes physically abusive, turning her into an emotional prisoner in his mansion. When Sarah tries to intervene, Kyle calls the police on her. After learning from Mel the truth about the two men, Sarah investigates and discovers that Kyle and Brent groom young women and sell them into sex trafficking. Carly and Mel are taken to the private jet, and Sarah and her husband track Carly's phone and race to rescue them.

Marc Fusion found the film a solid thriller for Lifetime devotees, noting that it tackled bigger issues than the usual obsessed-psycho story by focusing on grooming, which it depicted in a sometimes difficult-to-watch way, though the trafficking theme received too little attention and the rift between mother and daughter felt rushed. He praised Kelly as an authentic, naive young woman, making it understandable that Carly missed so many red flags, but found Hyde only passable and not always believable as the groomer.

overview: When blind former skier Sophie cat-sits in a secluded mansion, three thieves invade for the hidden safe. Sophie's only defense is army veteran Kelly, who she meets on the See For Me app. Kelly helps Sophie defend herself against the invaders and survive.
tagline: Seeing is surviving.
title: See for Me
plot:
See for Me is a 2021 Canadian thriller film directed by Randall Okita. It stars Skyler Davenport as Sophie Scott, a visually impaired young woman, and Jessica Parker Kennedy as Kelly, a gamer who guides her through a smartphone app, with Laura Vandervoort, Matthew Gouveia, Emily Piggford, Joe Pingue and Kim Coates. The filmmakers spent several years searching for a blind or visually impaired actor for the lead role; Davenport is visually impaired in real life.

Sophie was a promising downhill skier until a diagnosis of retinitis pigmentosa, a degenerative eye disease, ended her Olympic dreams. Refusing her friend Cam's offer to guide her in training for the Paralympics, she gives up skiing and earns money by house-sitting and cat-sitting for wealthy clients, secretly stealing expensive bottles of wine to resell. She takes a job looking after the cat of Debra, a recently divorced woman with a remote mansion in upstate New York. After locking herself out, Sophie uses See for Me, an app that connects blind people with sighted volunteers through video calls, and is helped by Kelly, a gamer in Florida.

That night, three men break into the house to steal millions of dollars hidden in a safe. With the police far away, Sophie contacts Kelly again, but the intruders catch her and cut the call. Sophie tries to bargain with them for a share of the money, but when a sheriff's deputy is killed, she escapes with his gun and reconnects with Kelly, who uses her gaming skills to guide Sophie through the house and help her fight back. In the final confrontation, Sophie discovers who is really behind the robbery and must use her wits and the darkness of the house to survive.

The film adds a twist to the home-invasion thriller through its blind heroine, who is neither a simple victim nor a conventional hero.

See for Me was shot in Canada and released in 2022, grossing about 726,000 dollars worldwide. It received positive reviews, with 80 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised its nifty twist on the home invasion thriller and Davenport's magnetic lead performance.

overview: On a particularly busy day at a suburban Ohio fast food restaurant, manager Sandra receives a phone call from a police officer saying that an employee has stolen money from a customer.
tagline: How far would you go?
title: Compliance
plot:
Compliance is a 2012 American thriller written and directed by Craig Zobel, starring Ann Dowd, Dreama Walker, Pat Healy and Bill Camp. It is closely based on the strip search phone call scams that culminated in an incident at a fast-food restaurant in Mount Washington, Kentucky, in 2004, in which a caller posing as a police officer persuaded a restaurant manager and others to subject an innocent employee to unlawful and humiliating treatment. The names of the real people were changed.

On a busy day at a ChickWich fast-food restaurant in Ohio, the manager, Sandra, is already under pressure when she receives a phone call from a man who identifies himself as Officer Daniels. He claims that a customer has accused one of her employees of stealing money from her purse and that he is in contact with Sandra's regional manager. Based on his description, Sandra identifies Becky, a young cashier, as the suspect and brings her into the back office. Becky denies the accusation, but the caller insists that Sandra detain her until police officers arrive.

Speaking with calm authority and invoking legal consequences, the caller persuades Sandra to search Becky's belongings and then to strip-search her, claiming that the alternative is jail. Over the course of several hours, as Sandra returns to running the busy restaurant, the caller enlists other employees and finally Sandra's fiancé, Van, to watch over Becky, escalating his demands into increasingly degrading and abusive acts. Only when an older maintenance worker refuses to cooperate and Sandra calls her regional manager does the deception unravel. The police eventually trace the calls to a family man working as a telemarketer, and in the aftermath Sandra insists that she too was a victim.

The film examines obedience to authority and the ease with which ordinary people can be manipulated into participating in abuse.

Compliance premiered at the 2012 Sundance Film Festival, where it provoked strong reactions, and received a limited release in the United States in August 2012. It received generally positive reviews, with 89 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised its sensitive direction and strong performances. Dowd's performance as Sandra won the National Board of Review Award for Best Supporting Actress.

original_title: Spiral: From the Book of Saw
overview: Working in the shadow of an esteemed police veteran, brash Detective Ezekiel “Zeke” Banks and his rookie partner take charge of a grisly investigation into murders that are eerily reminiscent of the city’s gruesome past.  Unwittingly entrapped in a deepening mystery, Zeke finds himself at the center of the killer’s morbid game.
production_companies: Canadian Film or Video Production Tax Credit (CPTC)
title: Spiral: From the Book of Saw
plot:
Spiral: From the Book of Saw is a 2021 American supernatural thriller film directed by Darren Lynn Bousman, written by Josh Stolberg and Peter Goldfinger, and produced by Lionsgate. The film serves as a sequel to the Saw franchise.

The story begins with Detective Ezekiel "Zeke" Banks (Chris Rock), a tough and seasoned detective from New York City, who is investigating a series of gruesome murders that seem to be connected to an old case from his past. As Zeke delves deeper into the investigation, he discovers that the murders are linked to Jigsaw's (Tobin Bell) legacy.

Zeke soon finds himself in the midst of a deadly game, where he must navigate through a series of puzzles and traps set by Jigsaw's successor, a mysterious figure known as "The Conductor" (Max Hogan). The Conductor is revealed to be a former apprentice of Jigsaw who has taken up his mantle and continues his twisted games.

As Zeke navigates the deadly game, he meets Amanda Young (Samantha Sloyan), a young woman with a troubled past who was once an apprentice of Jigsaw. Amanda becomes a key player in the game, as she is forced to confront her own dark past and the consequences of her actions.

Throughout the film, Zeke must use his wits and resourcefulness to survive the deadly traps and puzzles set by The Conductor. Along the way, he uncovers clues that suggest Jigsaw's legacy lives on through Amanda, who has become a complex and conflicted character in her own right.

As the game reaches its climax, Zeke discovers that The Conductor is actually a former cop who was obsessed with Jigsaw's philosophy and saw him as a twisted genius. The Conductor believes that by continuing Jigsaw's games, he can bring about a new era of enlightenment and self-discovery for humanity.

In the end, Zeke manages to outsmart The Conductor and escape the deadly game, but not before Amanda is forced to confront her own demons and make a choice between redemption and further descent into darkness. The film ends with a sense of closure for Zeke, but also raises questions about the legacy of Jigsaw's twisted games and whether they can ever be truly escaped.

Overall, Spiral: From the Book of Saw is a tense and thrilling ride that explores the darker themes of the Saw franchise while introducing new characters and plot twists. The film's use of puzzles and traps is clever and inventive, making for a fun and suspenseful viewing experience.

overview: An orphaned dinosaur raised by lemurs joins an arduous trek to a sancturary after a meteorite shower destroys his family home.
tagline: You have never seen anything like this.
title: Dinosaur
plot:
Dinosaur is a computer-animated adventure film produced by Walt Disney Pictures, released in 2000. The movie takes place during the Late Cretaceous period, around 65 million years ago.

The story begins with an elderly Iguanodon named Aladar, who lives on an island called Sodor with his adopted family, including his son Zip, daughter Saera, and nephew Bucky. Aladar is a kind and gentle soul, loved by all the animals on the island. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when a severe storm hits the island, causing widespread destruction and separating Aladar from his family.

Aladar sets out on an epic journey to find his adopted family, facing numerous challenges and dangers along the way. He meets a group of young dinosaurs, including Yar, a brave and adventurous triceratops; Cera, a stubborn but lovable iguanodon; and Spike, a small but fierce stegosaurus. Together, they form an unlikely family unit, with Aladar as their leader.

As they travel across the treacherous terrain of the Late Cretaceous period, the group encounters various obstacles, including ferocious predators like the Tyrannosaurus Rex and the Gorgonops. However, through teamwork and determination, they overcome these challenges and continue on their quest to find Aladar's family.

Along the way, the group discovers a hidden oasis, where they meet a wise old Troodon named Ray. Ray becomes a mentor to the group, teaching them about the importance of working together and trusting one another. He also shares his knowledge of the ancient world, revealing secrets about the dinosaurs' habitats and behaviors.

As the journey progresses, the group faces its greatest challenge yet: a treacherous mountain pass filled with steep cliffs and raging rivers. However, through their combined strength and ingenuity, they successfully navigate this perilous terrain and finally reach Aladar's family.

The movie culminates in an emotional reunion between Aladar and his adopted family, as well as the young dinosaurs who have become like a second family to him. The group celebrates their reunion with a joyful dance party, marking the beginning of a new era of friendship and adventure for all.

Throughout the film, the characters undergo significant development, learning valuable lessons about loyalty, trust, and the importance of family. The movie's stunning animation and engaging storyline make it an unforgettable experience for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Dinosaur is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that explores the themes of family, friendship, and perseverance in the face of adversity.

overview: After emigrating to Greece from Nigeria, Vera and Charles Antetokounmpo struggled to survive and provide for their five children, while living under the daily threat of deportation. Desperate to obtain Greek citizenship but undermined by a system that blocked them at every turn, the family's vision, determination and faith lifted them out of obscurity to launch the careers of three NBA champions.
tagline: A king will come from across the sea.
title: Rise
plot:
Rise is a 2022 American biographical sports drama directed by Akin Omotoso from a screenplay by Arash Amel. It tells the true story of the Nigerian-Greek Antetokounmpo brothers, Giannis, Thanasis and Kostas, who emigrated to the United States and reached the National Basketball Association. Newcomers Uche Agada, Ral Agada and Jaden Osimuwa play the three brothers, with Dayo Okeniyi and Yetide Badaki as their parents, Charles and Veronica, and Elijah Shomanke. Produced by Walt Disney Pictures, it was released on Disney+ on 24 June 2022.

In 1990, Charles and Veronica Adetokunbo leave Nigeria for Greece in search of a better life, forced to leave their eldest son, Francis, behind. Unable to obtain visas, they live without papers and in constant fear of discovery. By 2004 they have settled in Athens and have four more sons, Thanasis, Giannis, Kostas and Alexandros. Although the boys were born in Greece, its nationality laws, based on descent, deny them citizenship, leaving the family at constant risk of deportation and separation. Charles's efforts to obtain documents run into a cruel catch: he needs a visa to work but cannot get the job required for a visa. The family name itself was rendered as Antetokounmpo during immigration processing.

Thanasis and Giannis start playing basketball in a local park. Thanasis has natural talent, while Giannis struggles to learn the game but shows promise. They are invited to train for free at the gym of the club Filathlitikos, where coach Takis Zivas sees potential in both. By 2007 Thanasis is a star player and Giannis has improved dramatically, but the family continues to face hardship, including the loss of opportunities because of their lack of legal status. The boys sell goods on the street to help their parents, while Giannis's remarkable growth and work ethic attract the attention of international scouts. As the 2013 NBA draft approaches, the family must fight for citizenship papers so that Giannis can travel and pursue his dream, which culminates in his selection by the Milwaukee Bucks.

Rise received generally positive reviews, with critics praising its warm portrayal of family, immigration and perseverance, as well as the performances of its young cast, though some found it a conventional and sanitized sports biopic. The real Giannis Antetokounmpo went on to become a two-time NBA Most Valuable Player and to lead the Bucks to the 2021 NBA championship.

overview: A young woman newly returned to her hometown becomes the subject of harassment by a man named Blackway, an ex-cop turned violent crime lord who operates with impunity in this small community on the edge of the wilderness. Forsaken by the local townspeople—and advised by the Sheriff to leave town—Lillian decides instead to take a stand against her sociopathic stalker, and enlists the help of ex-logger Lester and his laconic young sidekick.
tagline: Sometimes revenge is the only answer.
title: Blackway
plot:
Blackway, known on the festival circuit as Go with Me, is a 2015 thriller directed by Swedish filmmaker Daniel Alfredson and written by Joseph Gangemi and Gregory Jacobs, based on Castle Freeman Jr.'s 2008 novel Go with Me. Julia Stiles stars as Lillian, with Anthony Hopkins as the elderly logger Lester, Alexander Ludwig as his young protégé Nate, Ray Liotta as the menacing Blackway and Hal Holbrook. Filmed in Canada in 2014, it premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2015 and was released theatrically in June 2016. It was Holbrook's final film appearance.

In a logging community in the Pacific Northwest, Lillian, a young woman recently returned to her hometown, is being terrorized by Blackway, a former deputy sheriff who now controls the local criminal underworld. After finding her cat decapitated, she goes to the sheriff, who tells her to leave town and suggests she talk to a man named Scotty. When she goes looking for him at a timber mill, he is away, and the mill's elderly owner and workers also advise her to get out. The owner jokingly offers a week's pay and funeral expenses to anyone willing to help her, and to everyone's surprise, an old man, Lester, agrees. His young protégé, Nate, a strong but quiet mill worker, comes along.

Lillian, Lester and Nate drive around the area searching for Blackway, visiting the places he frequents. Through conversations and flashbacks, it becomes clear how deeply Blackway has scarred the lives of all three and of many other townspeople; he is universally hated yet feared, and no one has dared to stand up to him. As the day goes on, the confrontation escalates. The trio fight with Blackway's men, cripple his associate Murdoch, destroy a building and steal weapons, provoking Blackway to come after them. As night falls, they wait for him at a remote abandoned logging camp that holds significance for both Lester and Blackway, where Lester prepares for a final reckoning and the three must decide how far they are willing to go to end Blackway's reign of fear.

Blackway received poor reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 20 percent rating based on five reviews, and Guy Lodge of Variety called it a turgid, tension-free revenge thriller. Some critics nonetheless appreciated the atmospheric setting and Hopkins's understated performance.

overview: Decades since their successful television series was canceled, Chip has succumbed to a life of suburban domesticity as an insurance salesman. Dale, meanwhile, has had CGI surgery and works the nostalgia convention circuit, desperate to relive his glory days. When a former cast mate mysteriously disappears, Chip and Dale must repair their broken friendship and take on their Rescue Rangers detective personas once again to save their friend’s life.
tagline: It's not a reboot. It's a comeback.
title: Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers
plot:
Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers is a 2022 American live-action and animated action-adventure comedy based on Disney's chipmunk duo and serving as a follow-up to the 1989 animated series of the same name. It was directed by Akiva Schaffer from a screenplay by Dan Gregor and Doug Mand. John Mulaney voices Chip and Andy Samberg voices Dale, with KiKi Layne, Will Arnett, Eric Bana, Seth Rogen and J. K. Simmons. It premiered at the El Capitan Theatre and was released on Disney+ on May 20, 2022.

In a world where humans and cartoon characters live side by side, Chip and Dale become best friends in elementary school and later move to Hollywood, where they rise from bit parts to stardom with the hit series Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers. When Dale is offered a solo spin-off, the pair fall out bitterly and the show is cancelled. Thirty years later, Chip is a cautious, jaded insurance salesman, while Dale, who has undergone "CGI surgery" to look three-dimensional, works the fan convention circuit.

Their old co-star Monterey Jack, deep in debt to the criminal Valley Gang because of his addiction to cheese, warns them of a ring that kidnaps cartoons, alters their appearance and forces them to star in cheap bootleg films overseas. When Monty disappears, the estranged chipmunks reluctantly reunite to find him, helped by Ellie Steckler, an eager police officer and devoted fan of their show.

Their investigation leads to the gang's leader, Sweet Pete, a grown-up, embittered Peter Pan who was cast aside by the industry when he aged, and his henchmen. The chipmunks trace the operation to a warehouse containing a machine for reshaping toons, and realise that someone in the police is working with Pete. During a chase at a fan convention Chip is captured, and Ellie discovers that her captain is in league with the villain.

Dale rallies their old co-stars Gadget and Zipper, now married with a large family, and stops the machine before it can be used on Chip. In the chaos, Pete is transformed into a monstrous amalgam of cartoon parts. Using a trick from one of their old episodes, the chipmunks trap him, and the FBI, led by Ugly Sonic, arrests the gang. When Dale survives a cannon blast thanks to a keepsake Chip once gave him, the friends reconcile, free Monty and the other captive toons and go on to make a successful reboot of their show.

Critics responded warmly, with 81% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and the film later won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Television Movie.

overview: What happens when a man and a woman share a common passion? They fall in love. And this is what happens to Jean-René, the boss of a small chocolate factory, and Angélique, a gifted chocolate maker he has just hired. What occurs when a highly emotional man meets a highly emotional woman? They fall in love, and this is what occurs to Jean-René and Angélique who share the same handicap. But being pathologically timid does not make things easy for them. So whether they will manage to get together, join their solitudes and live happily ever after is a guessing matter.
production_companies: Media Programme of the European Community
Movie Tax Shelter Empowered by Dexia
title: Romantics Anonymous
plot:
Romantics Anonymous is a 2010 French romantic comedy film directed by Richard Berry. The movie revolves around the story of two young people who work at a video rental store and find love in an unexpected way.

The main theme of Romantics Anonymous explores the idea of finding love in the most unlikely of places, often referred to as "love in hiding." The characters, both introverted and shy, discover their true feelings for each other through a series of awkward yet endearing encounters. This theme is beautifully captured by the film's nostalgic portrayal of video rental stores, which serve as a backdrop for the blossoming romance.

The movie also delves into the idea of self-discovery and embracing one's true nature. The protagonist, Sophie, struggles to find her place in the world and define herself outside of her relationships with others. Through her journey, she learns to be more confident and authentic, ultimately finding love on her own terms.

Furthermore, Romantics Anonymous touches on the theme of escapism and the power of movies to bring people together. The video rental store serves as a sanctuary for Sophie and her co-worker, Pierre, where they can escape their mundane lives and find solace in the stories and characters on screen.

Overall, Romantics Anonymous is a heartwarming film that celebrates the beauty of love, self-discovery, and the power of human connection.

overview: During a rainy day, and while their mother is out, Conrad and Sally, and their pet fish, are visited by the mischievous Cat in the Hat. Fun soon turns to mayhem, and the siblings must figure out how to rid themselves of the maniacal Cat.
tagline: Don't mess with the hat.
title: The Cat in the Hat
plot:
The Cat in the Hat is a 2003 live-action/CGI comedy film directed by Bo Welch, based on the children's book of the same name by Dr. Seuss. The movie stars Mike Myers as the iconic character of the Cat in the Hat.

The story begins with two mischievous children, Sally (Dakota Fanning) and her brother Conrad (Spencer Breslin), who are left alone at home on a rainy day while their mother is away. The kids are bored and looking for something to do when they hear a knock at the door. To their surprise, it's the Cat in the Hat (Mike Myers), a mischievous and eccentric feline with a penchant for trouble.

The Cat in the Hat promises to entertain the children and keep them out of trouble, but his antics quickly spiral out of control. He brings along two of his friends, Thing 1 and Thing 2 (also played by Mike Myers), who are just as mischievous as he is. The trio wreaks havoc on the house, causing chaos and destruction wherever they go.

As the day progresses, the Cat in the Hat's antics become more and more outrageous, with the children getting into all sorts of trouble. However, despite the chaos, the kids begin to enjoy themselves and have a blast with their new feline friend.

Meanwhile, the mother (Kelly Preston) is frantically trying to find a way to get home from her trip, but she's stuck in traffic due to the rain. The Cat in the Hat tries to help her by creating a diversion, but things only get worse.

As the day comes to an end, the Cat in the Hat realizes that he has gone too far and that it's time for him to leave. He cleans up the mess he made and says goodbye to the children, who are both relieved and disappointed that their fun-filled adventure is over.

In the end, the mother returns home, none the wiser about the chaos that occurred while she was away. The Cat in the Hat disappears into thin air, leaving behind a note for the children that reads: "I'm off to find something else to do... but don't worry, I'll be back soon!"

Overall, The Cat in the Hat is a fun and entertaining film that brings Dr. Seuss's beloved character to life on the big screen. While it may not be perfect, it's a delightful and lighthearted movie that's sure to bring smiles to the faces of both kids and adults alike.

overview: Young dancers gather in a remote and empty school building to rehearse on a cold and wintry night. The all-night celebration soon turns into a hallucinatory nightmare when they learn that their sangria is laced with LSD.
tagline: Birth and death are extraordinary experiences. Life is a fleeting pleasure.
title: Climax
plot:
Climax is a 2018 French drama film directed by Claire Denis, not ARTE France Cinéma (although it was produced in association with ARTE). The movie premiered at the 2018 Cannes Film Festival.

The main themes of Climax revolve around the exploration of female relationships, desire, and the complexities of human interaction. The story takes place on a bus traveling from Paris to a music festival in Bulgaria, where the women are preparing for a performance with their all-female band.

As the journey progresses, tensions rise among the group, and the boundaries between friendship, love, and lust become increasingly blurred. The film delves into the intricacies of female relationships, revealing the complexities and nuances that exist beneath the surface of seemingly harmonious friendships.

Throughout the movie, Denis skillfully weaves together themes of desire, power dynamics, and the fragility of human connections. As the story unfolds, the characters' emotions and desires are revealed, exposing the darker aspects of their relationships.

Ultimately, Climax is a thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of female relationships, revealing the intricate web of emotions, desires, and tensions that exist among women.
