Gaylen and Buddy find Addison, and the Creeper returns to Gaylen's house to find a sign declaring that they know what it is. The next day Buddy leaves for a basketball game on the bus later attacked in the second film. Twenty-three years later, Trish writes an open letter vowing revenge for her brother Darry's death.

Originally billed as a one-night event, the film opened in 635 theaters on September 26, 2017, with a second showing in October, and grossed about $4 million worldwide during its brief run. It holds a 17% rating on Rotten Tomatoes from a small number of reviews.

overview: Raised by her father, an ex-CIA agent, in the wilds of Finland, Hanna's upbringing has been geared to making her the perfect assassin. Sent into the world by her father on a mission, Hanna journeys across Europe, eluding agents dispatched after her by a ruthless intelligence operative. As she nears her ultimate target, Hanna faces startling revelations about her existence.
tagline: Adapt or die.
title: Hanna
plot:
Hanna (2011) is a spy thriller film directed by Joe Wright, starring Saoirse Ronan as the titular character. The movie follows the story of Hanna Heller, a young girl raised by her father, Erik Heller (Eric Bana), to be an assassin.

The main themes of Hanna include:

1. **Motherhood and Maternal Instinct**: The film explores the complexities of motherhood and maternal instincts through the relationship between Hanna and her father. Erik's decision to raise Hanna as a deadly assassin raises questions about the nature of parenthood, love, and sacrifice.
2. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Hanna navigates her way in the world, she struggles to reconcile her dual identity: that of a child and an assassin. This theme is reflected in her relationships with other characters, particularly Sophie (Jessica Hynes), who becomes a surrogate mother figure to her.
3. **Trauma and Emotional Scarring**: The film depicts Hanna's traumatic experiences at the hands of her father and the various assassins she encounters throughout her life. These events have left emotional scars on Hanna, making it difficult for her to form connections with others or trust herself.
4. **Redemption and Sacrifice**: As Hanna grows older, she begins to question her father's motives and the morality of their actions. This leads to a confrontation that ultimately forces Erik to make a choice between his love for Hanna and his own survival.
5. **Coming of Age and Independence**: The movie follows Hanna's journey from childhood to adulthood, as she learns to navigate the world on her own terms. Her experiences serve as a rite of passage, allowing her to assert her independence and forge her own path.

Overall, Hanna is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes through its engaging narrative and well-developed characters.

overview: Peace and tranquility have set in Belogorie. The evil was defeated and Ivan is now enjoying his well-deserved fame. He is surrounded by his family, friends and small wonders from the modern world that help him lead a comfortable life. Luckily, he has his Magic Sword to cut a gap between the worlds to get some supplies quite regularly. But when an ancient evil rises and the existence of the magic world is put to danger, Ivan has to team up with his old friends and his new rivals. They will set out on a long journey beyond the known world to find a way to defeat the enemies and to return peace to Belogorie.
title: The Last Warrior: Root of Evil
plot:
The Last Warrior: Root of Evil (Russian: Последний богатырь: Корень зла, literally "The Last Bogatyr: Root of Evil"), also known as The Last Warrior 2, is a 2021 Russian fantasy comedy directed by Dmitry Dyachenko and produced by The Walt Disney Company CIS with the Russian studio Yellow, Black and White. A sequel to The Last Warrior (2017), it continues the story of the meeting between modern Moscow and the magical land of Belogorie, a fairy-tale version of ancient Rus' inhabited by the heroes of Russian folklore. Viktor Khorinyak returns as Ivan Naydenov, with Mila Sivatskaya as Vasilisa, Ekaterina Vilkova, Elena Yakovleva and Konstantin Lavronenko. It was released in Russia on 1 January 2021.

Ivan, a young Muscovite who discovered in the first film that he belongs to Belogorie, now lives there as a hero, or bogatyr. The film opens with a campaign led by Finist the Bright Falcon, the strongest of the heroes, who mocks Ivan for lacking heroic strength. After the band captures a monster that has been attacking cattle and turns out to be the folk character Kolobok, Ivan returns to his mansion, which he has filled with modern technology. Tired of life in ancient Rus', he often uses a magic sword to travel back to modern Moscow and dreams of moving there for good with Vasilisa, who does not share his wish.

When a competition is held in Belogorie to choose the best hero, all the contestants except Finist fail the obstacle course. Annoyed by Finist's jokes and his attempts to flirt with Vasilisa, Ivan decides to take part himself. Before the contest he tries to cross back to Moscow, but the sword's magic has faded and the portal will not open. Where Finist relied on strength and agility, Ivan completes the course through ingenuity. His triumph is cut short when the witches Varvara and Galina arrive to seize a magic treasure from the hero Ilya, setting off a new adventure. Ivan and his companions must journey across Belogorie to confront an ancient evil that threatens both worlds, forging unlikely alliances and learning secrets about the origins of the magical land along the way.

The film was a major box-office success in Russia, becoming one of the highest-grossing Russian films of its year, and it was followed by a third installment, The Last Warrior: A Messenger of Darkness, released later in 2021.

overview: A real-time account of the events on United Flight 93, one of the planes hijacked on 9/11 that crashed near Shanksville, Pennsylvania when passengers foiled the terrorist plot.
tagline: September 11, 2001. Four planes were hijacked. Three of them reached their target. This is the story of the fourth.
title: United 93
plot:
United 93 is a 2006 docudrama written, produced and directed by Paul Greengrass about United Airlines Flight 93, one of the four planes hijacked during the September 11 attacks and the only one that failed to reach its target, because of the actions of its passengers. Alongside events on board, the film follows government officials and air traffic controllers as they watch the attacks unfold, recreating the hijacking and its aftermath as closely as possible in real time.

On the morning of September 11, 2001, four al-Qaeda hijackers led by Ziad Jarrah pray in a Newark hotel before boarding Flight 93, whose passengers include Tom Burnett, Todd Beamer, Jeremy Glick, Lauren Grandcolas and Mark Bingham. While the flight sits delayed on the ground, controllers lose contact with American Airlines Flight 11, realise it has been hijacked, and then see it and United Airlines Flight 175 strike the twin towers of the World Trade Center.

Once airborne, Jarrah hesitates before the hijackers finally act. They stab a passenger and the two pilots, herd the passengers to the rear with the threat of a fake bomb, and Jarrah turns the plane towards Washington, D.C., aiming for the Capitol. On the ground, American Airlines Flight 77 hits the Pentagon and FAA operations manager Ben Sliney orders the closure of all American airspace.

Through calls to their families on the airphones, the passengers learn of the other attacks and understand that the hijackers intend to die. With the flight crew they gather improvised weapons and plan to storm the cockpit so that a passenger with a pilot's licence and a former air traffic controller can try to land the plane. After praying and making final calls home, they rush the hijackers at Beamer's cry of "Let's roll", overpower two of them and discover the bomb is fake. As they batter down the cockpit door, Jarrah throws the aircraft into a dive, and the plane crashes into a field in Pennsylvania, killing everyone on board. Closing titles note that the order to shoot down hijacked aircraft was given only after Flight 93 had crashed.

Released on April 28, 2006, United 93 opened second at the American box office and became one of the most acclaimed films of the year, with a 90% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. It earned Academy Award nominations for Greengrass's direction and for its film editing.

original_title: The Land Before Time IX: Journey to Big Water
overview: When heavy rains create a mysterious "new water", Littlefoot sets off to explore the Great Valley and quickly becomes friends with Mo, a fun-loving dolphin-like creature, who has been isolated from his pod by the weather. When Littlefoot and friends get separated from their parents because of an Earthshake, they help Mo get back home to the Big Water, while avoiding a hungry "Sharptooth Swimmer".
title: The Land Before Time IX: Journey to Big Water
plot:
The Land Before Time IX: Journey to Big Water is an animated adventure film that explores the timeless themes of friendship, perseverance, and self-discovery. At its core, the movie delves into the complexities of growing up and navigating the challenges of adolescence.

As the Great Valley faces a severe drought, Littlefoot and his friends must embark on a perilous journey to find a new source of water, Big Water. Along the way, they encounter treacherous landscapes, ferocious predators, and unexpected allies. Through their trials and tribulations, the characters are forced to confront their own fears, doubts, and insecurities.

One of the primary themes of the movie is the struggle for independence and self-reliance. As Littlefoot and his friends venture further away from home, they must learn to rely on themselves and trust their instincts in order to survive. This journey serves as a metaphor for the challenges of growing up and becoming more confident in one's abilities.

The film also explores the importance of friendship and loyalty. Despite the many obstacles they face, Littlefoot and his friends remain steadfast in their support for each other, demonstrating the power of unity and cooperation in the face of adversity.

Furthermore, The Land Before Time IX: Journey to Big Water touches on the theme of environmentalism and conservation. The movie highlights the delicate balance between nature and humanity, emphasizing the need to protect and preserve our natural resources for future generations.

Ultimately, the film's narrative is driven by a sense of wonder, curiosity, and exploration. As Littlefoot and his friends navigate the unknown territories of Big Water, they discover new wonders, encounter unexpected challenges, and learn valuable lessons about themselves and the world around them.

overview: Barry B. Benson, a bee who has just graduated from college, is disillusioned at his lone career choice: making honey. On a special trip outside the hive, Barry's life is saved by Vanessa, a florist in New York City. As their relationship blossoms, he discovers humans actually eat honey, and subsequently decides to sue us.
tagline: Born to bee wild.
title: Bee Movie
plot:
Bee Movie is a computer-animated comedy film released in 2007 by DreamWorks Animation. The movie follows the story of Barry B. Benson, a young and ambitious bee who lives in New York City.

The film begins with Barry (voiced by Jerry Seinfeld) graduating from Bee College, where he learns about the importance of bees in pollination and honey production. However, Barry's fascination with human culture and his desire to explore beyond the hive lead him to question the traditional roles of bees.

One day, while out on a flight, Barry meets Vanessa Bloome (voiced by Renée Zellweger), a florist who is unaware that she is responsible for the decline of bee populations due to her role in promoting non-organic flowers. Intrigued by this discovery, Barry decides to take matters into his own hands and sue the human population for stealing honey.

As Barry delves deeper into the world of humans, he discovers a complex web of deceit and corruption that has led to the decline of bee populations. He also meets Adam Flayman (voiced by Matthew Broderick), a lawyer who agrees to help Barry with his lawsuit.

The plot thickens as Barry and Vanessa grow closer, but their relationship is put to the test when they must navigate the challenges of their respective worlds. Meanwhile, Layton T. Montgomery (voiced by Patrick Warburton), a ruthless bee executive, will stop at nothing to silence Barry and maintain the status quo.

As the story unfolds, Barry's lawsuit gains momentum, and he becomes an unlikely hero for bees everywhere. However, his actions also put him at odds with the human population, who are forced to confront their role in the decline of bee populations.

In the end, Barry and Vanessa succeed in changing the way humans interact with bees, and a new era of cooperation and understanding begins. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Barry returning to his hive as a hero, but also with a newfound appreciation for the complexities of human culture.

Throughout the film, Jerry Seinfeld's signature wit and humor shine through, making Bee Movie a delightful and entertaining ride. The animation is vibrant and colorful, bringing the world of bees and humans to life in a way that is both whimsical and engaging.

overview: Brave is set in the mystical Scottish Highlands, where Mérida is the princess of a kingdom ruled by King Fergus and Queen Elinor. An unruly daughter and an accomplished archer, Mérida one day defies a sacred custom of the land and inadvertently brings turmoil to the kingdom. In an attempt to set things right, Mérida seeks out an eccentric old Wise Woman and is granted an ill-fated wish. Also figuring into Mérida’s quest — and serving as comic relief — are the kingdom’s three lords: the enormous Lord MacGuffin, the surly Lord Macintosh, and the disagreeable Lord Dingwall.
tagline: Change your fate.
title: Brave
plot:
Brave is a 2012 animated fantasy adventure film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures. The film is set in Scotland in the 10th century and follows the story of Merida, a young princess with a fiery personality.

The movie begins with Merida, a skilled archer and horseback rider, celebrating her 18th birthday with her family at their castle. However, during the celebration, Merida's parents, King Fergus and Queen Elinor, announce that they have arranged for her to marry one of three suitors: two princes from neighboring kingdoms. Merida is not interested in marrying any of them and longs for independence and freedom.

Merida visits a witch who lives on the outskirts of the kingdom, where she learns about magic and makes a deal with the witch to change her fate. The witch gives Merida a magical cake that will alter her destiny, but warns her that the spell comes with unintended consequences.

As the story unfolds, Merida's wish is granted, and she finds herself transformed into a horse. She must navigate the challenges of being a horse while trying to reverse the spell and find a way to win back her parents' love and respect.

Meanwhile, Prince Harris and Prince Hamish, the two princes that Merida was supposed to marry, arrive at the kingdom, and tensions rise as they try to win Merida's hand in marriage. However, Merida is not interested and tries to escape from them.

As Merida struggles to reverse the spell, she learns valuable lessons about family, loyalty, and the importance of communication. She also discovers that her parents are not perfect but are loving and well-intentioned individuals who want what's best for her.

In the end, Merida finds a way to break the curse by using her own unique qualities and strengths to win back her parents' love and respect. The film ends with Merida and her family coming together in a heartwarming moment of reconciliation and understanding.

Throughout the movie, Brave features stunning animation, memorable characters, and a richly detailed Scottish setting. The film's themes of female empowerment, self-discovery, and the importance of family are timely and relevant, making it a beloved classic among audiences of all ages.

overview: While searching for her missing mother, intrepid teen Enola Holmes uses her sleuthing skills to outsmart big brother Sherlock and help a runaway lord.
tagline: Mystery runs in the family.
title: Enola Holmes
plot:
Enola Holmes is a 2020 mystery film directed by Harry Bradbeer, based on the novel of the same name by Nancy Springer. The movie stars Millie Bobby Brown as Enola Holmes, the younger sister of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson.

The story begins in Victorian-era London, where we meet Enola (Millie Bobby Brown), a brilliant and feisty 16-year-old who has been raised by her mother, Eudoria (Helena Bonham Carter), after their father's mysterious disappearance. Eudoria is a skilled detective and inventor who has been searching for her missing husband, Lord Tewkesbury.

When Eudoria receives a letter from an unknown sender claiming to have information about her husband's whereabouts, she sets out on a journey to find him. However, she soon realizes that the letter is actually a trap set by the villainous Lady Tewkesbury (Helen McCrory), who seeks revenge against Enola and her family.

Enola decides to take matters into her own hands and sets out on a perilous adventure to uncover the truth about her father's disappearance. Along the way, she meets a group of allies, including a street-smart young man named Jack (Fionn Whitehead) and his sister, Mary (Aisling Franciosi).

As Enola navigates the treacherous world of Victorian-era London, she uses her intelligence, wit, and resourcefulness to outsmart Lady Tewkesbury's henchmen and uncover clues about her father's disappearance. Along the way, she also discovers more about her own identity and her place in the world.

Throughout the movie, Enola faces numerous challenges and obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, cunning villains, and her own self-doubt. However, with the help of her allies and her own determination, she eventually uncovers a shocking truth about her father's disappearance and the true identity of Lady Tewkesbury.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between Enola and Lady Tewkesbury, as Enola uses all her skills and knowledge to outwit her nemesis and bring justice to her family. In the end, Enola emerges victorious, having solved the mystery of her father's disappearance and found a new sense of purpose and belonging.

Overall, Enola Holmes is a thrilling adventure that celebrates the intelligence, wit, and determination of its heroine. With its engaging plot, memorable characters, and stunning visuals, it is a must-see for fans of mystery, adventure, and strong female protagonists.

overview: A spellbinding and romantic supernatural thriller. Ten years after an apocalyptic event left the world haunted by ghosts, Roni receives a threatening message from beyond the grave. Joining forces with a mysterious classmate, Kirk, Roni descends into a shadow world that blurs the bounds of the living and the dead-and begins a desperate race against time to stop a cunning killer.
tagline: What if your whole world was haunted?
title: I Still See You
plot:
I Still See You is a supernatural horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human psychology and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows a young woman, Jill, who begins to experience terrifying hallucinations after being stalked by her ex-boyfriend.

At its core, I Still See You explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Jill's experiences serve as a metaphor for the ways in which past traumas can resurface and haunt us, often in unexpected ways. The film suggests that the wounds of the past can be just as painful and debilitating as physical injuries.

The movie also touches on the idea of gaslighting and the manipulation of perception. Jill's ex-boyfriend uses psychological tactics to make her question her own sanity, highlighting the ways in which abusers can control their victims' perceptions of reality. This theme is particularly relevant in today's society, where issues like domestic violence and emotional abuse are becoming increasingly recognized.

Furthermore, I Still See You explores the concept of identity and how it can be shaped by our experiences. Jill's struggles with her own identity serve as a backdrop for the supernatural events that unfold, highlighting the ways in which our past experiences can define us – both positively and negatively.

Overall, I Still See You is a thought-provoking film that delves into the darker aspects of human psychology, exploring themes of trauma, perception, and identity.

overview: A woman in her sixties embarks on a journey through the western United States after losing everything in the Great Recession, living as a van-dwelling modern-day nomad.
tagline: See you down the road.
title: Nomadland
plot:
Nomadland is a 2020 American drama film directed by Chloé Zhao, written by Zhao and Jeremy Keller, and starring Frances McDormand. The film is based on the non-fiction book "Nomadland: Surviving America in the Twenty-First Century" by Jessica Bruder.

The story follows Fern (Frances McDormand), a 61-year-old widow who has lost her home and her husband to cancer. After being evicted from their mobile home park, Fern is forced to leave behind everything she knows and embark on a journey across America in her van, which she names "Violet." She becomes a modern-day nomad, living off the grid and taking on various temporary jobs to make ends meet.

As Fern travels through the American West, she encounters a community of fellow nomads who have also been forced out of their homes by economic hardship. They share stories of struggle and resilience, and Fern begins to find a sense of belonging among them. She meets Swankie (David Strathairn), a veteran who has been living on the road for years; Linda May (Charlene Swankie), a fellow nomad who becomes one of Fern's closest friends; and Bob Wells (David Zayas), a young man who is struggling to find his place in the world.

Throughout her journey, Fern faces numerous challenges, including harsh weather conditions, mechanical breakdowns, and encounters with hostile strangers. However, she also experiences moments of beauty and connection, such as watching the sunset over the desert landscape or sharing meals with her fellow nomads.

As the story unfolds, Fern begins to realize that she has a choice: she can continue to live on the fringes of society, always looking over her shoulder, or she can take control of her life and create a new sense of purpose. With the help of her friends and the support of the nomad community, Fern starts to build a new identity for herself, one that is rooted in freedom and self-sufficiency.

The film's title, Nomadland, refers to the fictional town of Nomadland, Nevada, which has been abandoned due to economic decline. However, as Fern travels through the American West, she discovers that there are many other places like Nomadland, where people have been forced out of their homes and are struggling to survive.

Ultimately, Nomadland is a film about resilience, community, and the human spirit's ability to thrive in the face of adversity. Through Fern's journey, we see that even in the darkest of times, there is always hope for a better future, and that with courage and determination, we can create a new life for ourselves.

The film received widespread critical acclaim, including several Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actress for Frances McDormand. It was also nominated for several other awards, including Best Supporting Actor for David Strathairn and Best Original Score.

overview: In a world overrun by zombies, military personnel and survivalists live in an underground bunker while they seek a cure.
tagline: Join the undying war.
title: Day of the Dead: Bloodline
plot:
Day of the Dead: Bloodline is a 2017 action horror film directed by Hèctor Hernández Vicens, a loose remake of George A. Romero's 1985 film Day of the Dead and the second remake of it after the 2008 version. It stars Sophie Skelton as a young doctor, with Johnathon Schaech as her obsessive stalker, Marcus Vanco and Jeff Gum. It was released in Vietnam on December 29, 2017, and in the United States on January 5, 2018.

Zoe Parker, a medical student, reluctantly attends a party at her school. When she goes down to the morgue to fetch beer, she is attacked by Max, a disturbed patient who is obsessed with her and whose blood carries unusually strong antibodies. As he tries to rape her, a corpse comes back to life and bites him. Zoe escapes and warns the partygoers, but the reanimated dead, later called "rotters," overrun the building and the city. Zoe is among the survivors sent to refugee camps.

Five years later, Zoe works as a doctor at a military emergency bunker commanded by Lieutenant Miguel Salazar, which has lost contact with headquarters and the other camps. While Miguel considers a cure hopeless, Zoe and her friend Elyse study rotter blood in search of one. To obtain medicine for a sick girl, Lily, Zoe persuades Miguel to send a team, including his brother, Baca, who is Zoe's boyfriend, to the nearby university. There Zoe encounters Max, now partly transformed but still able to think, and a member of the team is killed. Max follows them back and infiltrates the bunker.

After Max is captured, Zoe realizes that his hybrid condition and his blood could hold the key to a vaccine, and Miguel reluctantly gives her forty-eight hours. An attempt to obtain blood from a live rotter goes wrong when the dead burst through the gates, and Elyse is bitten and killed by Miguel. Max frees himself and again tries to assault Zoe, then opens the doors to the horde, which overruns the bunker. Miguel is killed and Baca is bitten. Zoe kills Max in a greenhouse, then saves Baca with the vaccine, proving that it works. Later, with the bunker restored, she broadcasts a message to any remaining survivors that they have found a cure.

The film was panned by critics, who found it generic; Rotten Tomatoes reported 11% approval from nine reviews, and Rue Morgue called the remake a foolish exercise.

overview: Tony spends his Saturdays at a disco where his stylish moves raise his popularity among the patrons. But his life outside the disco is not easy and things change when he gets attracted to Stephanie.
tagline: ... Catch it!
title: Saturday Night Fever
plot:
Saturday Night Fever is a classic American romantic drama film released in 1977, directed by John Badham and produced by Robert Stigwood. The movie stars John Travolta as Tony Manero, a young Italian-American man from Brooklyn, New York.

The film begins with Tony (John Travolta) dancing the night away at a local disco club, Studio 54, where he is known for his impressive dance moves and charismatic personality. We see glimpses of Tony's life outside the club, including his relationships with his family, particularly his mother (Barbara Barrie), and his friends, including his best friend, Johnny Boy (David Shire).

As the story progresses, we learn that Tony is struggling to find direction in his life. He works at a local car wash and spends most of his free time dancing and socializing with his friends. However, he also has a secret: he's engaged to be married to Stephanie Mangano (Karen Lynn Gorney), a woman from a more affluent background.

Despite their engagement, Tony finds himself drawn to the freedom and excitement of the disco scene, where he can let loose and be himself. He becomes infatuated with the idea of leaving his mundane life behind and pursuing a career in dance.

Meanwhile, Stephanie is struggling to come to terms with her own desires and aspirations. She feels trapped in her engagement and longs for independence and self-discovery. As Tony's relationship with Stephanie begins to fray, he finds himself increasingly drawn to the disco scene and the people who inhabit it.

The plot thickens as Tony becomes embroiled in a rivalry with a rival dancer, Disco Duck (Vincent Giglione), at Studio 54. The tension between Tony and Disco Duck culminates in a dramatic dance-off that showcases Tony's skills and cement his status as a disco king.

As the story reaches its climax, Tony is forced to confront the consequences of his actions. He realizes that he has been running away from his problems rather than facing them head-on. In a poignant moment, Tony breaks off his engagement with Stephanie and begins to explore his own identity and desires.

The film ends on a hopeful note, as Tony finds a new sense of purpose and direction. He continues to dance and perform, but now he does so with a newfound sense of confidence and self-awareness. The final shot of the film shows Tony dancing alone in the empty streets of Brooklyn, lost in his own thoughts and aspirations.

Saturday Night Fever was a critical and commercial success, grossing over $237 million worldwide and cementing John Travolta's status as a Hollywood star. The film's soundtrack, featuring hits like "Stayin' Alive" and "How Deep Is Your Love," became one of the best-selling soundtracks of all time.

overview: A Christmas elf accidentally takes off in Santa's sleigh, crash lands in a small town, and loses the magic toy bag. Beethoven must rescue the elf, recover the bag from greedy crooks, and return the sleigh to Santa in time to save Christmas.
title: Beethoven's Christmas Adventure
plot:
Beethoven's Christmas Adventure is a 2011 animated film produced by Universal Pictures. 

The movie revolves around Beethoven, the lovable St. Bernard, who gets into various misadventures with his family during the holiday season. The main themes of the film include:

1. Family: The movie highlights the importance of family and the bond between Beethoven and his human family members. It shows how they come together to support each other despite their differences.

2. Friendship: Beethoven forms an unlikely friendship with a stray dog named Santa's Little Helper, who becomes his companion during the holiday season.

3. Kindness and generosity: The film promotes kindness and generosity, especially during the Christmas season. Beethoven and his family learn valuable lessons about giving to others and spreading joy to those around them.

4. Loyalty: Throughout the movie, Beethoven demonstrates unwavering loyalty to his family, even when they are faced with challenges and obstacles.

5. Holiday spirit: The film captures the essence of the holiday season, emphasizing the importance of love, kindness, and generosity during this time of year.

Overall, Beethoven's Christmas Adventure is a heartwarming animated film that celebrates the values of family, friendship, kindness, loyalty, and the holiday spirit.

overview: When an unlikely ally enters the Bloom family's world in the form of an injured baby magpie they name Penguin, the bird’s arrival makes a profound difference in the struggling family’s life.
tagline: The true story of an unlikely hero.
title: Penguin Bloom
plot:
Penguin Bloom is a heartwarming and uplifting drama that explores the transformative power of love, resilience, and self-discovery. The film tells the story of Sam Bloom, a young woman who, after being diagnosed with a rare form of cancer, embarks on an extraordinary journey to rediscover herself and find meaning in her life.

At its core, Penguin Bloom is a movie about the human spirit's capacity for growth, adaptation, and hope. It delves into the complexities of grief, loss, and the search for identity, as Sam navigates her new reality with courage and determination. Through her experiences, the film highlights the importance of embracing life's uncertainties and finding beauty in the unexpected.

The movie also explores themes of love, family, and relationships, showcasing the profound impact that those around us can have on our lives. The bond between Sam and her husband, Tom, is particularly poignant, as they work together to support each other through the challenges they face.

One of the most striking aspects of Penguin Bloom is its portrayal of the human condition, with all its complexities and vulnerabilities. The film encourages viewers to confront their own fears, doubts, and limitations, and to find strength in their weaknesses. Ultimately, it offers a powerful message of hope and resilience, reminding us that life is precious, and that every moment is an opportunity to bloom.

Overall, Penguin Bloom is a beautifully crafted film that will resonate with audiences seeking a story of inspiration, hope, and the human spirit's capacity for transformation.

overview: A story of love and life among the landed English gentry during the Georgian era. Mr. Bennet is a gentleman living in Hertfordshire with his overbearing wife and five daughters, but if he dies their house will be inherited by a distant cousin whom they have never met, so the family's future happiness and security is dependent on the daughters making good marriages.
tagline: A romance ahead of its time.
title: Pride & Prejudice
plot:
Pride & Prejudice is a 2005 period romance directed by Joe Wright in his feature debut, based on Jane Austen's 1813 novel and written by Deborah Moggach. It stars Keira Knightley as Elizabeth Bennet and Matthew Macfadyen as Mr Darcy, with Brenda Blethyn and Donald Sutherland as Mr and Mrs Bennet, Rosamund Pike as Jane, Carey Mulligan, Talulah Riley and Jena Malone as the younger Bennet sisters, and Judi Dench as Lady Catherine de Bourgh. Produced by Working Title Films with StudioCanal, it was shot entirely on location in England.

In late eighteenth-century England, the Bennets and their five daughters live at Longbourn, a modest estate in Hertfordshire that, because it is entailed to the male line, will pass to a cousin on Mr Bennet's death. Mrs Bennet is determined to marry her daughters well and is thrilled when the wealthy bachelor Mr Bingley rents the nearby Netherfield Hall. At a local ball, Bingley and Jane are immediately drawn to each other, while the spirited Elizabeth takes an instant dislike to Bingley's proud friend, Mr Darcy, after overhearing him dismiss her.

Elizabeth rejects a proposal from the pompous clergyman Mr Collins and is charmed by the officer George Wickham, who claims that Darcy cheated him of his inheritance. When Bingley abruptly leaves for London, Elizabeth learns that Darcy persuaded him to abandon Jane. Darcy then confesses his love to Elizabeth and proposes, but she angrily refuses him. A letter from Darcy reveals the truth about Wickham, and when Wickham elopes with Elizabeth's youngest sister Lydia, threatening the family with disgrace, Darcy's secret intervention leads Elizabeth to reconsider her prejudices and recognize her own feelings.

Wright and Moggach set the story in an earlier period and presented a more realistic, "muddy hem" version of Austen's world, emphasizing romanticism and family.

Released in the United Kingdom on 16 September 2005, Pride & Prejudice grossed 131.9 million dollars worldwide on a budget of 28 million dollars and received positive reviews, with praise for Knightley's performance. It earned four Academy Award nominations, including Best Actress for Knightley.

overview: Set in a world where superheroes are commonly known and accepted, young Will Stronghold, the son of the Commander and Jetstream, tries to find a balance between being a normal teenager and an extraordinary being.
tagline: Saving The World... One Homework Assignment At A Time.
title: Sky High
plot:
Sky High is a 2005 American superhero comedy film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie follows the story of two teenage brothers, Troy and Robby Bullock, who are learning to control their superpowers at a high school for superheroes.

The story begins with the introduction of Troy (played by Michael Angarano) and Robby (played by Jamie Chung), two ordinary teenagers who live with their father, Wade (played by Kevin Zegers), in a small town. However, on their 14th birthday, they discover that they are not like other teenagers - they have superpowers! Troy has the ability to fly, while Robby can turn invisible.

The Bullocks soon learn that they are part of a long line of superheroes and that their father is a retired superhero who works as a principal at Sky High School, a prestigious high school for young superheroes. The school is designed to help these teenagers control their powers and become the next generation of heroes.

As Troy and Robby navigate their new lives as superheroes-in-training, they befriend a group of students from different countries, each with unique superpowers. There's Gwen Grayson (played by Mary Elizabeth Winstead), a beautiful and popular student who is also a superhero; Warren Peace (played by Chris Evans), a cocky and confident student who has the ability to create force fields; and Gwen's brother, Will Grayson (played by Dane Cook), a nerdy but lovable student who can turn invisible.

Throughout the movie, Troy and Robby face various challenges as they learn to control their powers and work together with their friends. They also have to deal with the villainous Madam Watanabe (played by Lois Smith), a former superhero who seeks revenge against Sky High School for banishing her from the school's faculty.

As the story unfolds, Troy and Robby discover that Madam Watanabe has created an army of robotic minions to take over the world. The two brothers must use their powers and work together with their friends to stop Madam Watanabe and save the city.

In the end, Troy and Robby successfully defeat Madam Watanabe and her robots, saving the day as heroes. The movie ends on a high note, with Troy and Robby graduating from Sky High School and setting off into the world of superheroes, ready to face new challenges and adventures.

Overall, Sky High is a fun and entertaining movie that explores themes of identity, friendship, and self-discovery. With its lighthearted tone and colorful characters, it's a great choice for families and fans of superhero movies.

overview: Reunited after 15 years, famous chef Sasha and hometown musician Marcus feel the old sparks of attraction but struggle to adapt to each other's worlds.
tagline: There's Always Been Something Between Them.
title: Always Be My Maybe
plot:
Always Be My Maybe is a 2019 American romantic comedy film directed by Nahnatchka Khan and written by Ali Wong and Randall Park. The movie follows the story of two childhood friends, Sasha (Ali Wong) and Marcus (Randall Park), who reconnect as adults in San Francisco.

The main themes of Always Be My Maybe include:

1. Unrequited love: The film explores the complexities of unrequited love and how it can affect people's lives. Sasha and Marcus have had feelings for each other since childhood, but their friendship has always been platonic.
2. Identity and self-discovery: As adults, Sasha and Marcus are on different paths in life, trying to figure out who they are and what they want. The movie shows how they navigate their identities and find themselves through their relationships with others.
3. Friendship and loyalty: Despite the romantic tension between them, Sasha and Marcus's friendship is a core aspect of the film. They support each other through thick and thin, and their bond is tested as they confront their feelings for each other.
4. Cultural identity and belonging: The movie touches on the experiences of Asian Americans, particularly women, who often navigate multiple cultural identities. Sasha and Marcus grapple with their Korean-American heritage and find ways to balance their cultural roots with their individuality.
5. Love and vulnerability: As Sasha and Marcus confront their feelings for each other, they must also learn to be vulnerable and open with each other. The film shows how love can be a powerful catalyst for growth and self-discovery.

Overall, Always Be My Maybe is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of love, friendship, and identity, set against the vibrant backdrop of San Francisco's Asian-American community.

overview: When a San Francisco exec wins a New Zealand inn, she ditches city life to remodel and flip the rustic property with help from a handsome contractor.
tagline: Never assume anything on the internet matches its profile picture.
title: Falling Inn Love
plot:
Falling Inn Love is a romantic comedy-drama film that explores the theme of second chances and finding love in unexpected places. The movie follows Tully, a successful businesswoman who wins a small inn in a New Zealand town through a contest she didn't even enter. As she navigates her new life in the quaint town, she butts heads with the inn's handsome owner, Josh, who is initially resistant to her presence.

Through their interactions, the film delves into themes of identity, community, and the importance of embracing one's true self. Tully, who has been so focused on her career, must confront her own desires and values as she gets to know Josh and the charming town he calls home. As she learns to let go of her past and open herself up to new experiences, she discovers a sense of belonging and purpose that she never knew was missing.

The movie also touches on the idea of finding love in unexpected places, where two people from different walks of life come together and form an unlikely connection. Through their romance, Tully and Josh learn to appreciate each other's quirks and flaws, and find common ground in their shared desire for happiness and fulfillment.

Ultimately, Falling Inn Love is a heartwarming film that celebrates the power of love, community, and self-discovery. It's a story about finding one's true home, whether it's a physical place or a sense of belonging within oneself.

overview: The great sorcerer Merlin has returned to Camelot, a kingdom now vulnerable to ill fates and war since the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest gift and protection. With the help of Jack, an irascible young beggar-thief imbued with his own unruly magic, the fight against unknown dangers begins-to find the Grail, restore it to its rightful place, and bring Camelot back to its glory days.
title: Merlin's Apprentice
plot:
Merlin's Apprentice is a 2006 fantasy miniseries made for the Hallmark Channel, directed by David Wu from a script by Roger Soffer and Christian Ford. A sequel to the 1998 miniseries Merlin, it brings back Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson as the wizard Merlin and the Lady of the Lake. John Reardon plays the young thief Jack, with Meghan Ory, Christopher Jacot and Tegan Moss in supporting roles. Loosely drawn from Arthurian legend, it is set after the death of King Arthur and takes liberties with the traditional stories.

Content with the state of Camelot, Merlin retires for what he intends to be a restorative sleep of a few months, only to wake fifty years later. Nearly everyone he knew is dead, the kingdom is run by Lord Weston, and the Holy Grail has vanished from the castle, leaving Camelot weak, although Merlin's enchantments still keep invaders out. Into the city slips Jack, a vagrant thief with a pet pig named Sir Snout and a raw talent for magic. After catching him trying to steal his wand, Merlin takes Jack on as an apprentice when both share a vision of the Grail. Jack soon discovers that the squire Brian is really a young woman, Brianna, in disguise to avenge a wrong done to her family. Merlin learns in a vision that the Lady of the Lake enchanted him into his long sleep and that Jack is their son. Guided by the Lady, a barbarian army led by Rauskaug enters Camelot through a secret passage. Merlin and Jack conjure a magical bridge to lead the townspeople to safety, but the effort drains the wizard, who stays behind and is killed.

In the second part, the survivors wander the countryside for months searching for the Grail while the barbarians pursue them. Through Jack's visions it emerges that Yvonne, who is promised to Lord Weston, is not truly the granddaughter of Sir Gawain, and that her guardian Master Burton and Weston grew rich by oppressing the surrounding people, the source of Brianna's grudge. Jack and Brianna fall in love, and when Burton schemes to sell Yvonne and the citizens to a Scottish king, Brianna kills him and his wife. In the Grail's cave, the corrupt Weston touches the cup and turns to dust, while Jack rejects his mother's offer of power and asks only that the Grail end the slaughter outside. Moved by his selflessness, it restores the fallen, Camelot begins to be rebuilt, and Jack is allowed a reunion with his father in the land of the dead.

overview: Two teens facing personal struggles form a powerful bond as they embark on a cathartic journey chronicling the wonders of Indiana.
tagline: Live life at full brightness
title: All the Bright Places
plot:
All the Bright Places is a 2020 American teen romantic drama directed by Brett Haley from a screenplay by Jennifer Niven and Liz Hannah, adapted from Niven's 2015 novel. Elle Fanning stars as Violet Markey and Justice Smith as Theodore Finch, with Alexandra Shipp, Kelli O'Hara, Lamar Johnson, Virginia Gardner, Felix Mallard, Sofia Hasmik, Keegan-Michael Key and Luke Wilson. Netflix released the film on 28 February 2020.

Violet and Finch are two teenagers living unhappy lives in a small Indiana town. Violet is quietly struggling with survivor's guilt after the death of her older sister, Eleanor, in a car crash nine months earlier, while Finch is a troubled loner whom other students call a freak. They meet on the bridge where Eleanor died. On what would have been her sister's nineteenth birthday, Violet, who survived the crash and has not been in a car since, is standing on the bridge's ledge when Finch, out on a run, climbs up beside her and gently talks her down.

Finch persuades a reluctant Violet to partner with him on a school project that requires students to explore and document the wonders of Indiana. He looks her up online, reads about her sister's accident and her old writing, and chats with her. Together they visit unusual places he has chosen, cycling to the state's highest point because Violet refuses to ride in a car, until she finally agrees to get into Finch's car to reach a distant miniature roller coaster. Violet begins writing again for the first time since Eleanor's death, and Finch helps her talk about her sister in a way no one else has. As they fall in love, Violet slowly emerges from her grief, but Finch, who has a history of disappearing for days, is fighting his own hidden battle with mental illness and a painful family past, and as his moods darken, Violet realizes that the boy who saved her may need saving himself.

All the Bright Places received positive reviews, with a 64 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus said that although it at times buckles under the emotional weight of its source material, it succeeds on the strength of Fanning's and Smith's charming, tender performances. Critics also noted its sensitive treatment of depression and suicide.

overview: What starts as a poignant medical documentary about Deborah Logan's descent into Alzheimer's disease and her daughter's struggles as caregiver degenerates into a maddening portrayal of dementia at its most frightening, as hair-raising events begin to plague the family and crew and an unspeakable malevolence threatens to tear the very fabric of sanity from them all.
tagline: Evil lives within you
title: The Taking of Deborah Logan
plot:
The Taking of Deborah Logan is a 2014 American found-footage horror film directed by Adam Robitel. The movie follows a group of filmmakers who make a documentary about an Alzheimer's patient, Deborah Logan, but soon discover that she has become possessed by a malevolent spirit.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. **The Dangers of Playing with Forces Beyond Human Control**: The film explores the idea of meddling with forces beyond human control, as the filmmakers unwittingly unleash a dark entity on Deborah. This theme is reflected in the way the characters' actions have unintended and terrifying consequences.
2. **Alzheimer's Disease as a Metaphor for Possession**: The movie uses Alzheimer's disease as a metaphor for possession, highlighting the ways in which the disease can erode one's sense of identity and autonomy. Deborah's descent into madness serves as a catalyst for the supernatural events that unfold.
3. **The Blurred Lines between Reality and Fantasy**: As the documentary progresses, it becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish between reality and fantasy. The film's use of found-footage and mockumentary style adds to this sense of ambiguity, leaving the viewer questioning what is real and what is just a product of Deborah's imagination.
4. **The Consequences of Exploiting Vulnerable Individuals**: The movie critiques the exploitation of vulnerable individuals, particularly those with mental or physical disabilities. The filmmakers' decision to make a documentary about Deborah without her consent serves as a commentary on the ways in which society often takes advantage of those who are most in need.
5. **The Power of Trauma and Memory**: The film explores the idea that trauma and memory can be powerful forces that shape our experiences and perceptions. Deborah's past traumas and memories serve as a catalyst for her possession, highlighting the ways in which our experiences can both define us and destroy us.

Overall, The Taking of Deborah Logan is a thought-provoking horror film that explores themes of possession, trauma, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control.

overview: A scandal in the royal family: the wayward princess Barbara escaped from the palace and went through the forest in search of a handsome prince. However, instead of the cherished meeting with her beloved, she is captured by Buka, the most dangerous robber of the kingdom. But it quickly becomes clear that the brisk princess is ready to turn Buka's life into a nightmare, just to reach her goal. So the restless Varvara begins to establish her own order in the forest.
tagline: Cutie and the beast
title: My Sweet Monster
plot:
My Sweet Monster (Russian: Бука. Моё любимое чудище) is a 2021 Russian animated musical fantasy directed by Viktor Glukhushin and Maksim Volkov and produced by the CTB Film Company. The English-language version distributed in the United States by Lionsgate features the voices of Haylie Duff, Jon Heder and Pauly Shore.

Barbara is a young princess who longs to marry a prince, but her father, King Elijah, dismisses her romantic dreams. The scheming postman Bundy Joyce, who delivers her a love letter from a Prince Edward, blackmails the king into forcing Barbara to marry him instead. On her birthday the princess escapes from the palace and runs into the forest, where she is captured by Bogey, a gruff monster, and his companion, a rabbit, who take her back to their hideout.

Barbara gradually wins over her captors and persuades them to escort her to Edward's palace. On the journey Bogey teaches her about Mother Nature, the source of all life in the forest, and the rabbit explains that Bogey was once a human who got lost in the woods and was saved by a magic fountain, which turned him into a monster and made him the forest's protector. Meanwhile, Elijah reveals to Joyce that years earlier he took a life-giving liquid called the Spark from the same fountain to cure Barbara of an illness. Joyce builds Spark-powered robots to hunt down Bogey and sets out to find the fountain for himself.

At Edward's palace Barbara discovers that the prince she dreamed of does not exist, and Bogey comes to her rescue. Joyce's robots then capture the three friends at the fountain, and he drains its magic. Elijah arrives to disable the robots, but Joyce drinks the Spark, turns into a monstrous figure and is swallowed by a whirlwind that empties the fountain. With the magic gone, Barbara and the rabbit begin to fail, and Elijah sadly admits that he once built her a new heart. Bogey calls on Mother Nature to save them and gives up his own life to do so. Later, as Barbara grieves beside the fountain, its waters return and Bogey is restored in his original human form.

The film was released theatrically in Russia in 2022. Common Sense Media found the songs acceptable and the story somewhat complicated, calling the result standard fare with a decent but abrupt fairy-tale ending.

overview: A young Shaolin follower reunites with his discouraged brothers to form a soccer team using their martial art skills to their advantage.
tagline: Get ready to kick some grass!
title: Shaolin Soccer
plot:
Shaolin Soccer is a 2001 Hong Kong martial arts comedy film directed by Stephen Chow. The movie follows the story of Sing (played by Stephen Chow), a former Shaolin monk who has lost his touch with his kung fu skills and now works as a janitor at a local temple.

The story begins with Sing, who was once a skilled Shaolin monk, being kicked out of the temple for not following the rules. He is forced to watch as his fellow monks are chosen to represent the temple in an inter-school soccer tournament against their arch-rivals, the rival school's team, led by the arrogant and talented player, Wudang (played by Charlie Yeung).

Sing decides to enter the tournament with a group of misfit students from his own school, including his friend and teammate, Ba Ba (played by Ken Tong), who is an expert at playing soccer but has no kung fu skills. The team faces numerous challenges as they struggle to work together and develop their teamwork skills.

As Sing tries to help his teammates improve their soccer skills, he also tries to regain his own kung fu skills, which have been dormant for years. He meets a new student, Fa (played by Siu-yin Chan), who is a talented young monk with exceptional kung fu skills. Together, they work on developing Sing's skills and preparing the team for the tournament.

Throughout the movie, Sing faces numerous challenges as he tries to balance his desire to help his teammates with his own personal struggles. He also has to deal with the pressure from his rival school's coach, who is determined to win at all costs.

As the tournament progresses, Sing and his team face off against Wudang's team in a series of intense matches. The final match is a thrilling showdown between Sing's team and Wudang's team, which ends with Sing using his kung fu skills to score the winning goal.

In the end, Sing's team emerges victorious, and he finally finds redemption as a Shaolin monk. The movie ends on a high note, with Sing and his teammates celebrating their victory and looking forward to future tournaments.

Overall, Shaolin Soccer is a hilarious and action-packed comedy that combines elements of martial arts, sports, and coming-of-age themes. The movie features impressive fight choreography, witty dialogue, and memorable characters, making it a beloved classic among fans of Hong Kong cinema.

overview: Controversy and legal problems follow Dr. Jack Kevorkian as he advocates assisted suicide.
tagline: Angel of mercy… or murderous “Doctor Death”?
title: You Don't Know Jack
plot:
You Don't Know Jack is a 2010 American television biographical film written by Adam Mazer and directed by Barry Levinson for HBO. Al Pacino stars as Jack Kevorkian, the Michigan pathologist and right-to-die activist dubbed "Dr. Death" by the press, with Brenda Vaccaro as his sister Margo Janus, John Goodman as his friend and medical technician Neal Nicol, Susan Sarandon as Janet Good, founder of a regional chapter of the Hemlock Society, and Danny Huston as his lawyer Geoffrey Fieger. It premiered on HBO in April 2010.

Moved by the case of David Rivlin, a quadriplegic man who went to court to be removed from his respirator, by the sight of a dying woman in a hospital and by the memory of his mother's painful death decades earlier, Kevorkian builds his first suicide machine, the "Mercitron," from parts bought at flea markets. The device allows a patient to self-administer, through an intravenous line, a harmless saline solution followed by drugs that induce a coma and then stop the heart. Because the drugs are expensive and difficult to obtain, he also develops a method using carbon monoxide. Rivlin, however, becomes agitated during their meeting, and he later dies after his respirator is removed and food and water are withheld. In an interview with the journalist Jack Lessenberry, Kevorkian condemns the cruelty of such a drawn-out death and begins offering his services as a "death counselor."

His first patient is Janet Adkins, a woman from Portland, Oregon, in the early stages of Alzheimer's disease, whose death in the back of his van in 1990 makes national headlines. Over the following years Kevorkian helps more than a hundred people end their lives, provoking outrage and admiration in equal measure. Fieger defends him in a series of trials, winning acquittals, while prosecutors, religious groups and medical authorities try to stop him. Increasingly determined to force a legal confrontation, Kevorkian videotapes himself directly administering a lethal injection to a man with ALS and allows it to be broadcast on 60 Minutes in 1998, leading to his conviction for second-degree murder.

The film received positive reviews, with an 83 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes praising Levinson's direction and Pacino's outstanding performance. Pacino won the Primetime Emmy Award and the Golden Globe Award for his portrayal, and the real Kevorkian attended the premiere.

overview: After moving from New York City to Indiana, a 12 year old navigates his parents' divorce, his impending bar mitzvah and his new school's social circles.
tagline: Raise your voice. Even if it cracks.
title: 13: The Musical
plot:
13: The Musical is a 2022 American musical coming-of-age comedy-drama film directed by Tamra Davis and written by Robert Horn, based on the 2007 stage musical 13 by Horn, Jason Robert Brown and Dan Elish. Eli Golden stars as a boy preparing for his bar mitzvah, leading a young ensemble cast with Debra Messing, Rhea Perlman, Josh Peck and Peter Hermann. After an earlier attempt by CBS Films, Netflix announced its version in 2019 and released it on August 12, 2022.

After his parents separate, twelve-year-old Evan Goldman moves with his mother, Jessica, from New York City to his grandmother Ruth's home in the small town of Walkerton, Indiana. Unhappy at leaving his father, his friends and his rabbi behind, Evan resolves to become popular quickly and to make his upcoming bar mitzvah the biggest party his new school has ever seen. He befriends his neighbor Patrice and her friend Archie, who uses a wheelchair, but he is soon more interested in winning acceptance from the popular crowd.

The popular group is led by the football star Brett and the cheerleader Kendra, who like each other, while Kendra's best friend, Lucy, secretly wants Brett for herself and resents always being second. To win the group's favor, Evan offers to arrange a movie date for Brett and Kendra, but Lucy threatens to persuade everyone to skip his bar mitzvah unless he stops them from kissing. Evan enlists Archie, who has a crush on Kendra, to sit between the couple at the theater. Patrice, hurt that Evan has been using her and Archie, tells Kendra's overprotective mother, who arrives and ruins the date. Brett's friends blame Evan, Archie and Patrice turn away from him, and Lucy seizes the moment to kiss Brett and make him her boyfriend.

With everything falling apart, Evan reconciles with his mother and talks with his father, who encourages him to own up to his mistakes. He apologizes to Patrice and Archie and helps Brett repair his relationship with Kendra, after which Brett leaves Lucy and Lucy makes amends with Kendra. On the day of his bar mitzvah, Patrice forgives Evan and comes with Archie and the rest of the class, and the celebration brings them all together. Jessica returns to her writing, and Evan settles into his new home.

The film received mixed reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported 60% approval and Metacritic a score of 57.

overview: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.
tagline: Never give up.
title: All Is Lost
plot:
All Is Lost is a 2013 survival drama film directed by J.C. Chandor and starring Robert Redford. The movie was produced by Plan B Entertainment, not Sudden Storm Productions.

The main themes of All Is Lost include:

1. **Survival against all odds**: The film tells the story of a solo sailor, played by Robert Redford, who finds himself stranded in the Indian Ocean after his yacht is damaged in a storm. The movie showcases his struggles to survive against incredible odds, highlighting the human spirit's capacity for resilience and determination.
2. **Isolation and loneliness**: As the protagonist navigates the vast ocean, he is left alone with his thoughts, confronting his own mortality and the fragility of life. This theme explores the psychological effects of isolation and the importance of human connection in times of crisis.
3. **Nature vs. humanity**: The film presents a stark contrast between the natural world's power and humanity's vulnerability. The storm that damages the yacht serves as a metaphor for the uncontrollable forces of nature, while the protagonist's struggles represent humanity's capacity to adapt and survive against adversity.
4. **Existentialism and meaning**: Throughout the movie, Redford's character grapples with the meaning of life and his place in the world. As he faces death and destruction, he is forced to confront the impermanence of human existence and the search for purpose in a seemingly indifferent universe.

These themes are woven throughout the film, creating a powerful and thought-provoking narrative that explores the complexities of human nature and our relationship with the natural world.

overview: Three friends attempt to recapture their glory days by opening up a fraternity near their alma mater.
tagline: All the fun of college, none of the education.
title: Old School
plot:
Old School is a 2003 American comedy film directed by Todd Phillips and written by Scott Caan, John Flynn, and Craig Mazin. The movie stars Will Ferrell, Luke Wilson, Vince Vaughn, and Jeremy Piven.

The story begins with Frank the Tank (Will Ferrell), a charismatic but irresponsible bachelor who has just been dumped by his girlfriend. Frank's friends, Mitch Martin (Luke Wilson) and Beanie (Vince Vaughn), try to convince him to join their fraternity, Lambda Epsilon Pi, which is in danger of being shut down due to lack of membership.

The three friends decide to revive the fraternity by throwing a wild party that will attract new members. However, things quickly spiral out of control as Frank's antics and Beanie's womanizing cause chaos among the group. The plan is to get a girl, but Frank's obsession with a beautiful woman named Lauren (Julianne Potter) causes tension among the group.

As the story progresses, Mitch becomes increasingly frustrated with Frank's behavior and tries to take charge of the situation. Meanwhile, Beanie's attempts to woo women only lead to embarrassment and humiliation for himself and his friends.

The plot takes a turn when Frank's party attracts a new member, Steve (Jeremy Piven), who is initially hesitant but eventually warms up to the group. However, things get out of hand as the party gets wilder and more destructive, causing the fraternity house to be shut down by the police.

In the end, the friends must come together to save their fraternity and restore order to their lives. Frank learns a lesson about responsibility and maturity, while Mitch and Beanie learn to accept Frank's quirks and work together as a team.

The movie features many memorable scenes, including a wild party sequence that showcases the group's antics, a hilarious montage of Beanie's failed attempts at seduction, and a heartwarming moment where Frank finally finds love with Lauren.

Overall, Old School is a raunchy and irreverent comedy that explores themes of friendship, responsibility, and growing up. The movie features strong performances from its cast, particularly Will Ferrell, who shines as the charismatic but irresponsible Frank the Tank.

overview: A drama centered on a rebellious girl who is sent to a Southern beach town for the summer to stay with her father. Through their mutual love of music, the estranged duo learn to reconnect.
tagline: A story about family, first love, second chances and the moment in life that lead you back home.
title: The Last Song
plot:
The Last Song is a 2010 romantic drama film that explores the complex and often tumultuous relationship between two young souls, Ronnie Miller (played by Miley Cyrus) and Will Blakelee (played by Liam Hemsworth). At its core, the movie delves into the universal themes of love, loss, and self-discovery.

The film masterfully weaves together the narrative of Ronnie's summer with Will in a beach town, where she finds solace and healing from her painful past. As their relationship blossoms, they must confront the harsh realities of life, including the fragility of relationships, the weight of family secrets, and the struggle to find one's identity.

One of the primary themes that resonates throughout The Last Song is the power of love to heal emotional wounds. Ronnie's journey is marked by her desperate need for connection and acceptance, which Will provides in abundance. Their romance serves as a catalyst for Ronnie's growth, forcing her to confront her inner demons and learn to let go of the past.

The movie also explores the theme of family dynamics and the complexities that can arise when loved ones are flawed or struggling with their own issues. Ronnie's complicated relationship with her mother, Mary (played by Kelly Preston), serves as a poignant reminder of the challenges that can come with family ties.

Ultimately, The Last Song is a poignant coming-of-age story about finding one's place in the world and learning to navigate the complexities of love, loss, and identity. Through Ronnie's journey, the film reminds us that it's never too late to find solace, healing, and happiness, even in the face of adversity.

original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ ビクティニと白き英雄 レシラム
overview: The Kingdom of the People of the Earth once ruled over the land, but now all that remains is the Sword of the Earth. in the city of Eindoak. Satoshi, Iris, and Dent arrive in Eindoak during a harvest festival's Pokémon Tournament and meet the legendary Pokémon Victini who wishes to share its powers of victory to someone. Elsewhere in the city, a descendant of the People of the Earth named Dred Grangil has arrived who seeks to revive the kingdom's power with the Sword of the Earth, bringing them back into power over the land, and Satoshi and his friends must stop him before he destroys the land along with Victini.
tagline: A hero must choose: the power of ideals... or the courage of truth?
title: Pokémon the Movie: Black - Victini and Reshiram
plot:
Pokémon the Movie: Black - Victini and Reshiram is a 2011 Japanese animated science fantasy adventure film produced by OLM, Inc. and directed by Kunihiko Yuyama.

The movie begins with Ash Ketchum, a young Pokémon trainer from Pallet Town, who has been searching for the mythical Pokémon Victini. According to legend, Victini can grant wishes to those who possess it. Ash is determined to find Victini before his rival, Barry, does.

Ash and his friends, Iris and Cilan, arrive in Elesa's city, where they meet Elesa, a powerful Electric-type Pokémon trainer from Unova. Elesa has been searching for Reshiram, the mythical Pokémon said to have the power to control time. Ash and his friends soon discover that Reshiram is being held captive by Team Plasma, a group of rogue trainers who seek to free all Pokémon from their trainers.

As Ash and his friends try to rescue Reshiram, they learn about the history of Reshiram and its connection to the mythical Pokémon Victini. According to legend, Reshiram and Victini were once connected, but they were separated by a powerful artifact known as the "Reshiram Crystal." The crystal was said to have been created by the ancient Pokémon, Dialga.

Ash and his friends soon discover that Team Plasma is planning to use the Reshiram Crystal to free all Pokémon from their trainers. They also learn that Elesa's city is in danger of being destroyed if the crystal is used.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Ash and his friends are forced to make a difficult choice: to save Elesa's city or to rescue Reshiram. In the end, they decide to work together with Team Plasma to stop the destruction of the city.

In the climactic final battle, Ash and his friends face off against Team Plasma leader, Ghetsis. With the help of Elesa and her Pokémon, Ash is able to defeat Ghetsis and shatter the Reshiram Crystal, freeing Reshiram from its prison.

With Reshiram freed, it is revealed that the crystal was actually a powerful artifact created by Dialga, which had been keeping Reshiram captive for centuries. The movie ends with Ash and his friends reflecting on their adventure and the lessons they learned about friendship and teamwork.

Overall, Pokémon the Movie: Black - Victini and Reshiram is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and the importance of understanding and respecting the natural world.

overview: Blending lively music and brilliant animation, this sequel to the original 'Fantasia' restores 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' and adds seven new shorts.
title: Fantasia 2000
plot:
Fantasia 2000 is a 1999 animated film produced by Walt Disney Pictures, which serves as a sequel to the original Fantasia (1940). The film features eight segments, each set to a different piece of classical music. Here are some of the main themes present in Fantasia 2000:

1. **Imagination and Fantasy**: The film celebrates the power of imagination and fantasy, showcasing various animated sequences that bring classical music to life. Each segment is designed to evoke a sense of wonder and enchantment.

2. **Nature and the Environment**: Several segments, such as "The Sorcerer's Apprentice" and "Pines," feature natural landscapes and emphasize the importance of preserving our environment. These themes are reflected in the use of organic shapes and textures in the animation.

3. **Good vs. Evil**: The film explores the struggle between good and evil through various characters and storylines. For example, "The Sorcerer's Apprentice" features a young apprentice who must learn to control his magical powers, while "Pines" depicts a forest under threat from human destruction.

4. **Personal Growth and Transformation**: Some segments, such as "Rite of Spring," feature characters undergoing significant transformations or growth. These themes are often tied to the natural world and the cycle of life.

5. **Classical Music and Culture**: The film is deeply rooted in classical music and culture, with each segment showcasing a different piece by renowned composers like Beethoven, Tchaikovsky, and Stravinsky. The animation is designed to evoke the emotional and expressive qualities of these musical works.

6. **Technology and Innovation**: Fantasia 2000 was one of the first films to heavily incorporate computer-generated imagery (CGI) and other advanced technologies. This allowed for greater control over the animation process and enabled the creation of more complex and detailed environments.

Overall, Fantasia 2000 is a film that celebrates the beauty of classical music, the power of imagination, and the importance of preserving our natural world.

overview: Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek the help of an incarcerated serial killer named The Artist when a copycat killer strikes. While Mary searches for clues in The Artist's brilliant but twisted psyche, she and Jake are lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse, racing against time to stay one step ahead of The Artist and his copycat.
tagline: The art of the kill.
title: Mindcage
plot:
Mindcage is a 2022 American supernatural mystery thriller directed by Mauro Borrelli from a screenplay by Reggie Keyohara III, based on a story by Borrelli; the two had previously worked together on WarHunt. It gave Martin Lawrence his first dramatic, non-comedy lead, as the veteran detective Jake Doyle, opposite Melissa Roxburgh as his younger partner Mary Kelly and John Malkovich as the imprisoned serial killer Arnaud Lefeure, known as the Artist. Robert Knepper plays Lieutenant Owings, with Neb Chupin as Dr. Loesch, Jacob Grodnik, Aiden Turner, Ritchie Montgomery as Father Linares and Chris Mullinax as a homeless man.

Over five years, the Artist murdered six women, decorating their bodies and posing them in elaborate, quasi-religious public tableaux, before Doyle caught him; he now spends his days on death row in Arkansas making charcoal drawings in his cell. Years later, women begin turning up dead again, sculpted and posed like angels in apparent homage to his work. With the toll rising, Doyle and Kelly turn to the Artist for help. Since he resents the man who caught him, Kelly becomes the point of contact, and he agrees to cooperate in exchange for having his death sentence commuted to life in prison.

As Kelly probes the Artist's brilliant but twisted mind, he speaks in riddles, holds forth on the corruptibility of the human mind and questions her about recurring nightmares from her adolescence, while she is harassed by a seemingly homeless stranger and the clues left on the bodies point toward people from the detectives' own past. Kelly's devout, oddly behaved boyfriend becomes a suspect, a kidnapped politician adds a ticking clock, and the two detectives are drawn into a game of cat and mouse as they try to stay ahead of both the Artist and his imitator. In its final stretch the film turns to the supernatural, revealing that the Artist's reach extends far beyond the walls of his cell.

Shot in Springdale and Fayetteville, Arkansas, in August 2021, the film was released by Lionsgate in a small number of theaters and on demand on 16 December 2022. Critics were largely negative, comparing it unfavorably with The Silence of the Lambs, Seven and Fallen; TheWrap found it clichéd and illogical, and The A.V. Club faulted its flat script while praising Malkovich's droll performance. It later found a wide audience on Netflix, entering the platform's global top ten in January 2024.

overview: Ex-hitman John Wick comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him.
tagline: Don't set him off.
title: John Wick
plot:
John Wick is a 2014 action-thriller film directed by Chad Stahelski and written by Derek Kolstad. The movie follows the story of John Wick, a retired hitman who seeks vengeance against a group of criminals who kill his dog, a gift from his late wife.

The film begins with John Wick (Keanu Reeves), a former hitman who has retired to a quiet life in New York City. He is living with his wife, Helen (Bridget Moynahan), and their dog, Daisy, a Beagle that was a gift from her mother. After Helen's death, John Wick is left alone and struggling to cope with the loss.

However, his peaceful life is disrupted when Iosef Tarasov (Alfie Allen), the son of a powerful crime lord, Vladimir Tarasov (Michael Nyqvist), breaks into John Wick's home and steals his 1969 Mustang. The car holds sentimental value for John Wick, as it was a gift from his late wife.

Iosef, who is arrogant and reckless, kills Daisy in front of John Wick, which sets off a chain reaction of events that puts John Wick on the path to revenge. He seeks out Viggo Tarasov's men, including Marcus (Willem Dafoe) and Tessa (Adrianne Palicki), who are responsible for his dog's death.

As John Wick navigates the underworld of high-stakes assassins, he faces off against a series of deadly opponents, each with their own unique skills and abilities. He also encounters Santino D'Antonio (Riccardo Scamarcio), a ruthless Italian gangster who is working for Viggo Tarasov.

Throughout the film, John Wick's skills as a hitman are put to the test as he takes on his enemies in intense hand-to-hand combat sequences. The action scenes are fast-paced and well-choreographed, showcasing Keanu Reeves' physical abilities.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Viggo Tarasov is using Iosef's actions as a way to provoke John Wick into coming out of retirement. However, John Wick's motivations for revenge are complex, driven by a mix of anger, sadness, and a desire for justice.

The film culminates in an epic showdown between John Wick and Santino D'Antonio at the Continental Hotel, where John Wick seeks refuge from Viggo Tarasov's men. The final confrontation is intense and bloody, with John Wick emerging victorious but scarred by his experiences.

Overall, John Wick is a gripping action-thriller that explores themes of grief, redemption, and the consequences of violence. Keanu Reeves delivers a standout performance as the titular character, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and intriguing story.

overview: Will is looking for an escape from his family when he encounters Lee, the school bully. Armed with a video camera and a copy of Rambo, Lee plans to make his own action-packed video epic.
tagline: Make Believe. Not War.
title: Son of Rambow
plot:
Son of Rambow is a 2007 British comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of childhood innocence and the struggles of growing up. The movie follows the story of Lee Carter, an 11-year-old boy who becomes obsessed with the infamous 1975 film "Rambow," a martial arts film starring Bruce Lee.

As Lee delves deeper into the world of "Rambow," he begins to emulate its hero, and his obsession takes over his life. However, this fixation also leads him to confront the harsh realities of his own life, including his troubled relationship with his stepfather and his struggles in school.

The film masterfully captures the essence of childhood, highlighting the vulnerability, curiosity, and sense of wonder that defines this stage of life. Through Lee's journey, the movie explores themes of identity, belonging, and the search for meaning, as he navigates the challenges of growing up and finding his place in the world.

One of the main themes of Son of Rambow is the power of imagination and its ability to both inspire and distract us from reality. The film shows how Lee's obsession with "Rambow" becomes a coping mechanism for his difficulties, allowing him to temporarily escape the complexities of his life.

The movie also touches on the theme of family dynamics and the struggles that can arise when parents or caregivers are absent or neglectful. Lee's stepfather is portrayed as a somewhat distant figure, who fails to provide the emotional support and guidance that Lee needs, leading to feelings of abandonment and insecurity.
