1. **Mortality and Loss**: The film explores the theme of mortality and loss through Poe's own experiences with grief and tragedy. His mother's death has a profound impact on his life, and he struggles to cope with the loss.
2. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Poe becomes more involved in the murder investigation, he begins to question his own identity and purpose. He is torn between his desire for fame and success as a writer, and his sense of duty to uncover the truth.
3. **Morality and Justice**: The film raises questions about morality and justice, particularly in the context of the murder investigation. Poe's determination to solve the case leads him to confront the darker aspects of human nature.
4. **Obsession and Fixation**: Poe's fixation on the murder investigation becomes an all-consuming obsession, leading him to neglect his own well-being and relationships. This theme is reflected in his writing, as he becomes increasingly fascinated with death and the supernatural.

The Pale Blue Eye features a talented cast, including Christian Bale as Edgar Allan Poe, Harry Melling as Albert Hodges, and Anya Taylor-Joy as Sarah Helen Whitman. The film received generally positive reviews for its atmospheric and introspective portrayal of Poe's life and work.

original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
overview: Captain Jack Sparrow crosses paths with a woman from his past, and he's not sure if it's love -- or if she's a ruthless con artist who's using him to find the fabled Fountain of Youth. When she forces him aboard the Queen Anne's Revenge, the ship of the formidable pirate Blackbeard, Jack finds himself on an unexpected adventure in which he doesn't know who to fear more: Blackbeard or the woman from his past.
tagline: Live Forever Or Die Trying.
title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
plot:
Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides is a 2011 adventure film directed by Rob Marshall, produced by Jerry Bruckheimer, and distributed by Walt Disney Pictures.

The story follows Captain Jack Sparrow (played by Johnny Depp), who is on a quest to find the Fountain of Youth. He teams up with Angelica (played by Penélope Cruz), the daughter of the infamous pirate Blackbeard (played by Ian McShane). Together, they embark on a perilous journey across the seas in search of the elusive fountain.

As they navigate through treacherous waters, Jack and Angelica are pursued by the Royal Navy, led by Captain Norrington (played by Jamaine Rich), who is determined to capture Blackbeard. Along the way, they encounter the enigmatic and beautiful Syrena (played by Astrid Bergès-Frisbey), a mermaid who possesses magical powers.

As Jack and Angelica delve deeper into their quest, they discover that the Fountain of Youth holds the key to eternal life, but it also comes with a terrible curse. The trio must confront Blackbeard's ghostly spirit, as well as the Royal Navy, in order to reach the fountain before it falls into the wrong hands.

Throughout the film, Jack Sparrow's wit and cunning are put to the test as he navigates complex moral dilemmas and confronts his own demons. His relationship with Angelica is also explored, revealing a deeper side to their complicated past.

The film features stunning visual effects, impressive action sequences, and memorable performances from the cast. However, it received mixed reviews from critics, who felt that the story was convoluted and lacked the charm of previous Pirates of the Caribbean installments.

Despite this, On Stranger Tides remains a thrilling adventure that explores themes of power, identity, and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control. The film's climax features an epic battle between Jack, Angelica, and Blackbeard, which sets the stage for the next installment in the franchise.

Overall, Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides is a visually stunning and action-packed adventure that expands on the Pirates of the Caribbean universe while introducing new characters and themes.

overview: The story of John Wilmot, a.k.a. the Earl of Rochester, a 17th century poet who famously drank and debauched his way to an early grave, only to earn posthumous critical acclaim for his life's work.
tagline: He didn't resist temptation. He pursued it.
title: The Libertine
plot:
The Libertine is a 2004 period drama and the first feature directed by Laurence Dunmore, adapted by Stephen Jeffreys from his own play. It stars Johnny Depp as John Wilmot, 2nd Earl of Rochester, the notorious poet and rake of the Restoration court, and Samantha Morton as the actress Elizabeth Barry, with John Malkovich as King Charles II, Rosamund Pike as Rochester's wife Elizabeth, Rupert Friend and Kelly Reilly. The film portrays the brilliant, self-destructive earl during the last years of his life.

In 1675, Rochester addresses the audience in a prologue, warning them that they will not like him. Recalled from banishment by King Charles II, who needs his support in the House of Lords, he returns to London and his "Merry Gang" of dissolute friends, including the young Billy Downs, whom he warns that he will die of their company. At the theater, he sees Elizabeth Barry being booed off the stage and, recognizing her talent, takes it upon himself to coach her as an actress. Under his guidance she becomes a sensation, and the two begin a complicated relationship.

Seeking money from France, the king commissions Rochester to write a play to honor the visit of the French ambassador and celebrate his reign. Rochester instead writes Sodom, an obscene satire that mocks the king, humiliating Charles in front of his guest. Forced to flee London, Rochester sinks into drink and disease, his face disfigured by syphilis, while his friend Downs is killed in a brawl. Eventually forgiven by the king, he returns to his long-suffering wife and makes a final, dramatic appearance in the House of Lords before his early death.

The film depicts Rochester as a man of great wit and talent destroyed by his own excesses, and it ends with an epilogue in which Rochester, fading into the candlelight, asks the audience whether they like him now.

An unfinished version of The Libertine was shown at the 2004 Toronto International Film Festival, and a substantially recut version premiered at AFI Fest in November 2005 before its British release that month. It grossed about 10.9 million dollars worldwide and received mixed to negative reviews, with 34 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised Depp's zealous performance but faulted muddled direction and murky cinematography, and a Metacritic score of 44.

overview: An actual princess has some mechanical issues and is temporarily grounded.  Does she have time for a lobster roll? It is Christmas time in Maine which means snow, quaint scenery, and lots of Christmas lights near the ocean.  With the crew distracted attending to the repair, Princess Amelia deplanes to walk through a magical Christmas tree lot near the airport perimeter.
title: Jingle Bell Princess
plot:
Jingle Bell Princess is a 2021 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Don McBrearty from a screenplay by Blaine Chiappetta and James D. Hughes. Produced by Brad Krevoy Television, the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Hideaway Pictures and All Canadian Entertainment, it stars Merritt Patterson as a European princess and Trevor Donovan as a widowed father, with Charlie Boyle, Marnie McPhail and Matthew Finlan in supporting roles. The film was shot in Ontario in the autumn of 2021 and premiered on the then-new GAC Family cable network on 4 December 2021, during the channel's first season of original Christmas films; it was later made available on Peacock. It runs 85 minutes.

Princess Amelia (Patterson), the polished royal of a fictional European kingdom, is due to fly home after a speaking engagement on the East Coast of the United States when mechanical problems ground her plane. While the crew is busy with the repairs and an old-fashioned snowstorm settles over the area, she slips away from the aircraft to wander through a magical Christmas tree lot near the edge of the airport. Through a series of mishaps she ends up stranded in Tucker, a small, snow-covered seaside town in Maine full of quaint scenery and Christmas lights. There she is taken in as an ordinary guest by the unsuspecting Cutler family, including widower Sam Cutler (Donovan) and his young daughter Sophie (Boyle), who do not know who she really is. As Amelia experiences small-town holiday traditions with them, she and Sam grow close and each learns lessons that leave them with renewed hope, while she must decide when to reveal her royal identity.

Reviews from holiday-film critics were mixed. Rissi JC of RissiWrites called it a sweet happenstance romance whose derivative plot mattered little given its cute story and its likable, familiar leads; she found the production less polished than its competitors, with busy backgrounds and some awkward transitions, but praised the script for letting the revelation of Amelia's secret unfold without the usual dramatic fallout. The Terrible Christmas Movie Project was harsher, judging the chemistry and plot merely fine and the film boring, and mocking Patterson's vaguely British accent, which it said slipped away in most scenes. The Christmas Everyday Club found it cute, festive and at times funny, with two leads who worked well together.

overview: Craig and Smokey are two guys in Los Angeles hanging out on their porch on a Friday afternoon, smoking and drinking, looking for something to do.
tagline: A lot can go down between thursday and saturday...
title: Friday
plot:
Friday is a classic American comedy film released in 1995 by New Line Cinema. Directed by F. Gary Gray, the movie stars Ice Cube, Chris Tucker, Nia Long, and John Witherspoon.

The story takes place on a typical Friday afternoon in South Central Los Angeles. The main character, Craig Jones (played by Ice Cube), is a laid-back and responsible high school student who has just finished his final exams. He's looking forward to a relaxing weekend with his friends and family.

However, things take a turn when Craig's friend Smokey (played by Chris Tucker) comes over to his house, uninvited. Smokey is a hyperactive and eccentric friend who always seems to find trouble. Despite their differences, the two have been friends since childhood, and Craig tries to accommodate Smokey's antics.

As the day progresses, Smokey convinces Craig to join him on a series of misadventures, including a botched attempt to sell marijuana, a wild ride through the streets, and a chaotic encounter with a group of thugs. Meanwhile, Craig's girlfriend, Dee (played by Nia Long), is trying to get her life together after a recent breakup.

Throughout the movie, the characters' interactions are filled with witty banter, humorous observations, and relatable struggles. The film's humor is rooted in its portrayal of urban life, tackling topics like racism, poverty, and social inequality.

As the day wears on, Craig and Smokey find themselves in a series of absurd situations, including a wild goose chase through the neighborhood and a confrontation with a group of gang members. Despite the chaos, the two friends ultimately come out on top, learning valuable lessons about loyalty, friendship, and growing up.

The movie's climax features an iconic scene where Craig and Smokey are chased by a group of thugs, leading to a thrilling showdown in front of Craig's house. In the end, Craig emerges victorious, having successfully defended his home and his friend.

Friday was a critical and commercial success, grossing over $27 million at the box office on its opening weekend. The film received widespread acclaim for its authentic portrayal of urban life, clever writing, and outstanding performances from the cast. It has since become a cult classic, widely regarded as one of the greatest comedies of the 1990s.

Overall, Friday is a hilarious and heartwarming movie that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and growing up in a way that resonates with audiences of all ages.

overview: Three children accidentally get turned into fish after drinking a potion made by an eccentric scientist. The kids end up in the sea, with one problem. They must find and drink the antidote within 48 hours, or forever remain as fish.
tagline: A potion put them in the ocean
title: Help! I'm a Fish
plot:
Help! I'm a Fish (Danish: Hjælp, jeg er en fisk), also known as A Fish Tale, is a 2000 Danish animated musical fantasy directed by Stefan Fjeldmark, Greg Manwaring and Michael Hegner, and written by Fjeldmark, Karsten Kiilerich, John Stefan Olsen and Tracy J. Brown. Its English-language voice cast includes Alan Rickman, Terry Jones and a young Aaron Paul.

Twelve-year-old Fly, his little sister Stella and their cautious, science-minded cousin Chuck slip out to go fishing while their aunt Anna is babysitting. Caught by the rising tide, they take shelter in the boathouse of Professor MacKrill, an eccentric marine biologist who believes melting ice caps will soon flood the world. He has invented a potion that turns people into fish, along with an antidote to reverse it. Stella drinks the potion thinking it is lemonade and becomes a starfish, and Fly unwittingly tosses her into the sea. When their boat sinks in a storm during the search, Fly and Chuck also take the potion, becoming a flying fish and a jellyfish.

The antidote, meanwhile, has leaked into the ocean, where a pilot fish and a shark swallow it and gain human intelligence. The fish, calling himself Joe, uses it to build an army of clever sea creatures inside a sunken oil tanker and plans an uprising against humanity, with the dim shark as his henchman. Reunited and joined by a seahorse that Stella adopts, the children learn that they have only forty-eight hours before their transformation becomes permanent.

Captured while trying to steal the antidote, they are ordered to produce more of it, but they escape and gather ingredients around the ocean to recreate the formula. Joe corners them, drinks the last of the original antidote and grows hands, while a crab seizes the new batch and proclaims himself king. Passing overhead in a makeshift boat, MacKrill and Fly's father create an underwater whirlpool with a water pump that sucks up Joe's army. The children then travel through intake pipes to the professor's flooded laboratory, where Fly tricks Joe into drinking so much of the spare antidote that he turns human and drowns, Chuck and Stella turn human as their families arrive, and after a frightening moment Fly emerges from a pipe, human again but with a broken leg.

Released in Denmark by Nordisk Film in October 2000, the film was a moderate success there during the school holidays and later opened in the United States and the United Kingdom in 2001.

overview: Dance teacher and mother Nadja left her son Mario with her own mother when he was little. Now she has reappeared on his doorstep, seeking a closeness that knows fewer and fewer boundaries. An uncompromising film about family relationships.
title: Grand Jeté
plot:
Grand Jeté is a 2022 German drama directed by Isabelle Stever and written by Anna Melikova, based on Anke Stelling's novel Fürsorge. Sarah Nevada Grether stars as Nadja, a former ballet dancer, and Emil von Schönfels as Mario, her son, with Susanne Bredehöft, Stefan Rudolf and Ellen Müller in supporting roles. The film premiered in the Panorama section of the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2022.

Nadja has devoted her entire life to ballet. Trained from childhood to pursue perfection in movement, body and discipline, she gave up personal relationships and ordinary experiences in the service of her art. She now works as a ballet teacher, but her body is breaking down after years of strain. She lives with chronic pain, relies on painkillers to keep up with the physical demands of teaching, and her feet bear the scars of decades of dancing. Her life is rigid and controlled, and she keeps her students, colleagues and everyone else at an emotional distance.

Years earlier, to pursue her career, Nadja left her son, Mario, to be raised by her mother. When she reconnects with Mario, now a young man who is almost a stranger to her. As they spend time together, the awkward reunion between mother and son slowly evolves into an intense physical intimacy and ultimately into an incestuous relationship. The film observes this transgression with clinical detachment, focusing on bodies, touch and physical sensation rather than explanation, while Nadja's mother and the people around them react to what is happening, or choose to ignore it. As Nadja's body continues to fail and her control over her life slips away, she is forced to confront the consequences of a life spent suppressing her emotions and of the bond she has formed with the son she abandoned.

Grand Jeté drew attention for its radical visual style, built on extreme close-ups, and for its uncompromising treatment of a taboo subject. Beth Accomando of the Alliance of Women Film Journalists praised the commitment of Stever and Grether, and Carlos Aguilar of TheWrap noted that it remains impartial toward its characters. Other critics found the characters' psychological motivations underexplored.

overview: A policewoman whose childhood friend disappeared in Patagonia years ago starts a new search to find answers, and soon finds her own life in danger.
tagline: Never stop searching
title: Perdida
plot:
Perdida is a 2018 crime thriller directed by Alejandro Montiel, an Argentine, Spanish and Peruvian co-production adapted from Florencia Etcheves's novel Cornelia. Luisana Lopilato stars as police officer Manuela "Pipa" Pelari and Amaia Salamanca as the mysterious Nadine "La Sirena" Basset, with Rafael Spregelburd as Commissioner Ramón Oreyana, Nicolás Furtado as Pipa's partner, Martín Seretti, and Oriana Sabatini as her friend Alina.

In 2003, on a school trip to Patagonia, teenager Cornelia Villalba vanishes after a night out dancing with her friends and is never found. Fourteen years later her best friend, Pipa, is a gifted but reckless detective specializing in kidnapping and human trafficking. At the memorial mass for Cornelia, Pipa notices a woman who hurries away, leaving behind a scarf printed with a two-headed mermaid. Pressed by Cornelia's mother and intrigued by a cryptic death notice reading "half of your absence is love", Pipa reopens the case against Oreyana's orders, helped by Alina. The trail leads to a mute psychiatric patient bearing the mermaid tattoo, whose only visitor, a Spanish woman named Nadine Basset, comes every October 18 with a birthday cake. Nadine is Sirena, a survivor of sexual exploitation in the Canary Islands now tied to a trafficking ring, whose tattooed henchman, Adalberto, throws Alina to her death from Pipa's window.

Suspended, Pipa follows Nadine's flights to San Martín de los Andes and returns to the hotel where the girls stayed in 2003. There she is drugged by Ariel, the owner's son, who had drugged the girls that night and abducted Cornelia, and he locks her in a basement before he and his mother are shot. Sirena then reveals that she is Cornelia: she was taken after seeing Ariel abuse their friend Leonora and sold into trafficking. When Oreyana arrives, he shoots Seretti and admits he is part of the trafficking network and ordered Alina's murder, and a heartbroken Pipa kills him. Back in Buenos Aires, she tells Cornelia's mother that her daughter and those who killed her are dead, then deciphers the death notices and realizes that Leonora has been raising Cornelia's son, Rodrigo. She agrees to keep the secret and returns Cornelia's friendship necklace, accepting that their story is over.

Perdida opened in Argentina on April 19, 2018, and drew some 274,000 spectators. Argentine critics were largely negative, faulting its lack of suspense and clichéd script. A prequel, La corazonada, followed in 2020.

overview: Batman and Nightwing are forced to team with the Joker's sometimes-girlfriend Harley Quinn to stop a global threat brought about by Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue, the Floronic Man.
tagline: Gotham City's heroes need a super-villain to fight for justice.
title: Batman and Harley Quinn
plot:
Batman: Gotham Knight (2008) is not a match for the title "Batman and Harley Quinn" as it was released in 2017.

However, I can provide information on the movie "Batman and Harley Quinn" (2017).

The main themes of Batman and Harley Quinn (2017) include:

1. **Toxic Masculinity**: The film critiques traditional masculine norms by portraying Bruce Wayne's (Batman) emotional vulnerability and his struggle to balance his desire for justice with his personal life.
2. **Trauma and PTSD**: Both Bruce Wayne and Harley Quinn deal with traumatic experiences from their past, which shape their present and influence their actions in the story.
3. **Female Empowerment**: The film features a strong female protagonist in Harley Quinn, who is a complex and multifaceted character. Her journey from being a sidekick to becoming an anti-hero showcases her growth and empowerment.
4. **Love and Obsession**: The relationship between Bruce Wayne and Harley Quinn serves as a catalyst for the plot, exploring themes of love, obsession, and the blurred lines between them.
5. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: Both characters grapple with their identities, questioning who they are and what they want to achieve in life.

The movie's narrative is driven by Harley Quinn's origin story, which explores her transformation from a psychiatrist at Arkham Asylum to a partner-in-crime for the Joker. The film also delves into Bruce Wayne's backstory, revealing his emotional scars and motivations for becoming Batman.

Overall, Batman and Harley Quinn (2017) offers a fresh take on the DC Comics universe, exploring complex themes and character dynamics that add depth to the story.

overview: Greed, revenge, world dominance and high-tech terrorism – it's all in a day's work for Bond, who's on a mission to protect a beautiful oil heiress from a notorious terrorist. In a race against time that culminates in a dramatic submarine showdown, Bond works to defuse the international power struggle that has the world's oil supply hanging in the balance.
tagline: As the countdown begins for the new millennium there is still one number you can always count on.
title: The World Is Not Enough
plot:
The World Is Not Enough is a 1999 action spy film directed by Michael Apted and starring Pierce Brosnan as James Bond. The movie marks the 19th installment in the James Bond series.

Beginning:
The film opens with a dramatic sequence showing a terrorist named Elektra King (Sophie Marceau) being kidnapped by a group of terrorists led by Renard (Robert Carlyle). The story then shifts to London, where Bond is sent to investigate the kidnapping. He soon discovers that Elektra's father, Alec Trevelyan (Sean Bean), has been killed in a car bombing.

Plot Development:
Bond learns that Elektra's father was involved in a plot to sell nuclear warheads on the black market. The main villain, Renard, is revealed to be a former KGB agent who seeks revenge against Alec for his betrayal. As Bond delves deeper into the case, he discovers that Elektra is being held captive by Renard and his accomplices.

Bond's investigation leads him to a beautiful and mysterious woman named Wai Lin (Carrie-Anne Moss), an Australian intelligence officer who has been tracking Renard. Together, they form an alliance to take down Renard and rescue Elektra. Along the way, Bond also encounters a group of rogue Russian agents who are working with Renard.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Alec Trevelyan's death was not a random act of terrorism, but rather a deliberate move to distract from his true intentions. It is revealed that Alec had discovered Renard's plan and was trying to stop him, but ultimately fell victim to his own betrayal.

Ending:
The film culminates in an action-packed sequence where Bond confronts Renard at the Elektra King's family estate in Scotland. In a thrilling finale, Bond faces off against Renard and his accomplices, leading to a dramatic showdown that results in Renard's demise.

In the aftermath of the battle, Bond is left shaken but unharmed. He also finds himself drawn to Wai Lin, who has become an ally and potential love interest. The film ends with Bond reflecting on the events that have transpired, as he sets his sights on his next mission.

Overall, The World Is Not Enough is a classic Bond film that delivers on action, suspense, and intrigue. With its complex plot twists and memorable characters, it has become a fan favorite in the James Bond franchise.

belongs_to_collection.name: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes Collection

original_title: LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage Of Atlantis
overview: Aquaman must battle foes in the air, on land and in the depths of the Seven Seas, along with some help from The Justice League, to save the day.
title: LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage Of Atlantis
plot:
LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage of Atlantica is a 2018 animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character Aquaman. The movie's plot revolves around Arthur Curry, also known as Aquaman, who must stop his half-brother Orm from destroying Atlantis and taking over the world.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. **Brotherly Love vs. Power**: The conflict between Aquaman and Orm serves as a metaphor for the struggle between brotherly love and the desire for power. Orm's thirst for power and control leads him to seek destruction, while Aquaman fights to protect his people and the world.
2. **Identity and Belonging**: As an outsider in both Atlantis and the surface world, Aquaman struggles with finding his place and identity. The movie explores his journey of self-discovery and acceptance, as he navigates between his two worlds.
3. **Environmentalism and Responsibility**: The film highlights the importance of environmental stewardship and responsibility. Orm's actions are driven by a desire to reclaim Atlantis' former glory, but at the cost of destroying other ecosystems. Aquaman, on the other hand, fights to protect the world from Orm's destructive plans.
4. **Loyalty and Sacrifice**: Throughout the movie, Aquaman faces difficult choices that test his loyalty to his people, friends, and family. He must make sacrifices for the greater good, demonstrating the importance of putting others before oneself.

Overall, LEGO DC Super Heroes - Aquaman: Rage of Atlantica is a fun, action-packed film that explores themes of brotherly love, identity, environmentalism, and loyalty, all while showcasing the iconic character of Aquaman.

overview: In the town of Saima, when summer is about to begin, a group of six high school students intend to live a secret adventure by spending seven carefree days in a ruined mining facility.
title: Seven Days War
plot:
Seven Days War (Japanese: Bokura no Nanoka-kan Sensō) is a 2019 Japanese animated coming-of-age action drama directed by Yūta Murano from a screenplay by Ichirō Ōkouchi, produced by the studio Ajiadō and distributed in Japan by Gaga and Kadokawa. It is a new adaptation of Osamu Sōda's 1985 novel, the first of his long-running Bokura series, previously filmed in live action in 1988. Updating the story some thirty years to 2020, the film changes the kanji numeral in the title to an Arabic "7"; Sōda approved the remake on condition that it keep the series' themes of challenging adults and humorous battles. The setting moved to a former coal-mining town in Hokkaido. The voice cast is led by Takumi Kitamura and Kyōko Yoshine, with Rie Miyazawa in a special appearance.

In 2020, Mamoru Suzuhara (Kitamura) is a bookish, solitary high-school second-year in the old mining town of Satomiya, steeped in military history. Shortly before the summer holidays he learns that his childhood friend and neighbour Aya Chiyono (Yoshine), whom he has long loved, is about to move to Tokyo, because her father, a local politician, plans to run for a Tokyo seat. Aya, who wanted at least to spend her birthday a week later in her hometown, accepts Mamoru's proposal to run away, and dressing it up as a "camp", she invites classmates until six of them are living in a disused mine on a hill. There they find Malet, a Thai child hiding from immigration officers after being separated from her parents. When officials arrive and lock the teenagers in, Mamoru shields Malet and the six are drawn into a seven-day "war" against the adults. Following Mamoru's tactics, they thwart a search, and post videos of their stand online to draw onlookers. Aya's father, his secretary and a construction company run by the father of Aya's best friend Kaori try to break in, and when the secretary exposes the group's old secrets on social media, tensions erupt. Eventually each confesses the feelings they had kept hidden, including Aya, who reveals that she is gay, and the reunited friends launch a final plan to save Malet.

The film opened in Japan on 13 December 2019 and was selected for the feature competition at the 2020 Annecy festival. It won the award for best animated feature at the Sitges Film Festival, and in France, where Eurozoom released it as 7 Jours in 2021, Télérama called it a successful adaptation of a classic of Japanese youth literature, while Le Monde found its themes too numerous.

overview: To bring down a global human trafficking ring, an Interpol agent recruits the help of a brutal criminal with inside knowledge of the yakuza.
title: Darc
plot:
Darc is a 2018 American action thriller directed by Julius R. Nasso from a screenplay by Tony Schiena and Dennis Venter. Schiena stars as Jake Walters, a former convict known as Darc who is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate a yakuza family, with Armand Assante as the Interpol agent Lafique, Kippei Shiina, Sho Ikushima, Tetsu Watanabe and Dawn Olivieri. Filmed in the Vancouver area, including New Westminster, the film was released by Netflix in May 2018.

Jake grows up in Japan as a Western boy raised in a brothel, obsessed with manga and collecting kanji cards. When he intervenes to save his mother from a beating, he brings the wrath of the yakuza down on them, and he witnesses her murder at the hands of a gangster. Years later, now a bearded, pitiless fighter skilled with pistol and knife who calls himself Darc after his favourite comic book hero, he is granted early release from prison thanks to Lafique. In return, the Interpol agent wants his help in bringing down a global human trafficking ring run by the Koga-kai syndicate, which has also abducted Lafique's own daughter, and he urges Darc to see it as justice for his mother.

The way in comes when Darc rescues Shigeru Kageyama, the reckless son of the businessman and yakuza leader Toshio Kageyama and grandson of the clan's powerful boss Ginzo, during a clash with a rival gang. Shigeru hires the outsider as his bodyguard, hoping to prove himself to his father, and Darc is drawn into the family's operations on the West Coast, killing members of a rival biker gang, collecting protection money from local Asian businesses and frequenting the syndicate's sex clubs, while flashbacks reveal the ugly past he absorbed in Japan. He grows close to Ivy, an attractive neighbour, as he works his way towards Toshio, the man responsible for his mother's death, in a violent campaign of revenge that ends in a bloody finale.

Critical response was largely unfavourable. Roger Moore of Movie Nation praised the decent fight choreography and polished look but found Schiena a bland lead, felt Assante deserved a better film and concluded that a good yakuza thriller could not be made in Vancouver. Writing for Firstpost, Anupam Kant Verma called it a by-the-book revenge story that relied on frenetic editing to hide its lack of drama and stereotyped characters, although its slickly staged action and the stronger performances of the older cast kept it watchable.

overview: In 2030 the world is in a permanent state of economic recession and facing serious environmental problems as a result of global warming.
tagline: In the near future our government will decide who is expendable.
title: The Humanity Bureau
plot:
The Humanity Bureau is a thought-provoking science fiction film that explores the complexities of human existence and our relationship with technology. At its core, the movie delves into the theme of existentialism, questioning what it means to be human in a world where machines and artificial intelligence are increasingly integrated into our lives.

The story follows an agent who is tasked with evaluating individuals from the past to determine their worthiness to exist in the present. As he navigates this bureaucratic system, he begins to realize that the concept of humanity is not as straightforward as it seems. The film raises questions about the nature of identity, free will, and what makes us human.

Through its narrative, The Humanity Bureau also touches on the theme of nostalgia and the importance of human connection in a world where technology is increasingly isolating us. The movie's protagonist, who is tasked with evaluating individuals from the past, begins to question his own existence and the purpose of his work, highlighting the tension between progress and tradition.

Ultimately, The Humanity Bureau presents a nuanced exploration of what it means to be human in a world that is rapidly changing. It challenges viewers to consider the implications of our technological advancements on our humanity and encourages us to reflect on the values and principles that define us as individuals and as a society.

original_title: Barbie & Her Sisters in a Puppy Chase
overview: Barbie and her sisters go to an island paradise for a dance competition, but they must work together as a team to find their pets after their furry friends go missing at a horse festival.
title: Barbie & Her Sisters in a Puppy Chase
plot:
Barbie & Her Sisters in a Puppy Chase is a 2016 American computer-animated adventure film and the 34th entry in the Barbie film series. Directed by Conrad Helten with Michael Goguen from a screenplay by Amy Wolfram and Kacey Arnold, it was produced by Mattel Playground Productions with animation by Rainmaker Entertainment, with music by Steven Argila and The Math Club. It was released direct to video in the United States in October 2016 and made its television debut on Nickelodeon that November. Its theme song is "Live in the Moment".

Barbie (Erica Lindbeck) and her sisters Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea fly with their puppies Taffy, DJ, Rookie and Honey to a tropical island, where Chelsea is to compete in a dance competition against her rival, Lindsay. Chelsea wants to go straight to the hotel to rehearse, but Barbie has planned a surprise. With most rental cars taken, the sisters set off in a golf cart, send their luggage ahead and head to Banyan Tree Park for the Dancing Horse Festival, where the trainers Vivian and Marco present the nervous young horse Beauty in her debut. While the girls watch, the puppies explore a horse trailer belonging to a show dog, Archibald, and are unwittingly driven away when the trainers leave.

Trying to follow, Barbie gets the cart stuck in the arch of the great banyan tree, and with no internet signal the sisters must spend the night in the park, passing the time with imagination games and learning of a macaw constellation once used by local fishermen for navigation. The next day, finding the road washed out, they climb a mountain, take a zip-line to a village and rent a camper, only to run out of fuel near the beach campground where the trainers have stopped. Meanwhile the puppies, cared for by Vivian and Marco, enjoy their own adventure, running with the horses and learning to surf.

As her worries mount, Chelsea snaps at Barbie for being relentlessly positive, and Barbie reassures her that doing her best matters more than winning. The sisters are reunited with their pets, and when another washed-out road blocks the way, the horses carry the girls across. Barbie admits that she hid her own worries to seem dependable, and her sisters tell her she can share them. Guided north by the macaw constellation, they reach the competition. The voice cast also includes Kazumi Evans as Skipper, Claire Margaret Corlett as Stacie, Alyssya Swales as Chelsea and Mark Oliver as Archibald.

overview: A police shootout leaves four thieves dead during an explosive armed robbery attempt in Chicago. Their widows have nothing in common except a debt left behind by their spouses' criminal activities. Hoping to forge a future on their own terms, they join forces to pull off a heist.
tagline: Left with nothing. Capable of anything.
title: Widows
plot:
Widows is a 2018 heist thriller film directed by Steve McQueen, produced by Regency Enterprises, and written by Gavin Hood, Bill Collage, and Derek Cleeve.

The main themes of Widows include:

1. **Survival and Resilience**: The movie explores the lives of four women who are forced to take matters into their own hands after their husbands are murdered by a ruthless gangster. The film showcases their resilience and determination to survive in a world that seems determined to crush them.
2. **Female Empowerment**: Widows is a powerful exploration of female empowerment, as the four main characters, Veronica (Viola Davis), Linda (Michelle Rodriguez), Belle (Cynthia Erivo), and Madina (Lupita Nyong'o), come together to take control of their lives and seek revenge against those who wronged them.
3. **Grief and Trauma**: The film delves into the theme of grief and trauma, as the widows navigate their loss and try to find a way to move forward. The movie explores the emotional toll of losing loved ones and the struggle to cope with the aftermath.
4. **Class and Socioeconomic Status**: Widows highlights the stark contrast between the wealthy and the poor, as the gangster's family is portrayed as ruthless and entitled, while the widows are forced to fight for survival in a system that seems stacked against them.
5. **Revenge and Redemption**: The movie explores the theme of revenge and redemption, as the widows seek justice for their husbands' deaths. Along the way, they must confront their own demons and make difficult choices about what it means to be alive.

Overall, Widows is a gripping and thought-provoking film that explores themes of survival, female empowerment, grief, class, and revenge in a world where women are often forced to fight for their lives.

overview: Following a zombie outbreak in Las Vegas, a group of mercenaries take the ultimate gamble: venturing into the quarantine zone to pull off the greatest heist ever attempted.
tagline: Survivors take all.
title: Army of the Dead
plot:
Army of the Dead is a 2021 American zombie apocalypse film written and directed by Zack Snyder. The movie takes place in Las Vegas, where a group of mercenaries, led by Scott Ward (played by Dave Bautista), are hired to pull off a heist during a zombie outbreak.

The story begins with Scott Ward, a former Army Ranger, who is struggling to find purpose after his divorce and the loss of his daughter. He is approached by a mysterious woman named Abigail (played by Ana de Armas) who offers him a lucrative job: to lead a team of mercenaries into the zombie-infested Las Vegas Strip and retrieve $1 million from an ATM.

Ward assembles a team, including his old friend Blythe (played by Jessica Henwick), a skilled hacker; Navid (played by Michael Rooker), a seasoned mercenary; and Doc (played by Buddy Johnson), a medic. The team is joined by Abigail, who claims to have a personal stake in the heist.

As they enter the zombie-infested Strip, the team quickly realizes that the situation is more complex than they anticipated. They must navigate through hordes of zombies, avoid rival treasure hunters, and contend with their own personal demons.

Throughout the movie, Ward's character undergoes significant development as he confronts his past and learns to trust himself and his team. The group faces numerous challenges, including a zombie-infested casino, a treacherous underground bunker, and a showdown with a ruthless zombie leader.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Abigail's true intentions are not entirely altruistic. She has her own motivations for pulling off the heist, which puts the entire team at risk.

The climax of the movie features an intense battle between Ward's team and the zombies, as well as a confrontation with Abigail's true identity. In the end, Ward emerges victorious, but not without scars both physical and emotional.

One of the standout aspects of Army of the Dead is its unique blend of action, horror, and humor. The movie features a talented ensemble cast, witty dialogue, and plenty of nods to classic zombie movies.

Overall, Army of the Dead is a thrilling and entertaining ride that pays homage to the zombie genre while also offering something fresh and original. With its talented cast, clever plot twists, and over-the-top action sequences, it's no wonder this movie has become a fan favorite among horror and action fans alike.

overview: An uptight, conservative businesswoman accompanies her boyfriend to his eccentric and outgoing family's annual Christmas celebration and finds that she's a fish out of water in their free-spirited way of life.
tagline: Feel The Love
title: The Family Stone
plot:
The Family Stone is a 2005 American comedy-drama film directed by Thomas Bezucha and written by Thomas Bezucha and Robin Schiff. The movie stars Dermot Mulroney, Sarah Jessica Parker, Claire Danes, and Rachel McAdams.

The main themes of The Family Stone revolve around the complexities of family relationships, love, acceptance, and identity. Here's a brief overview:

Beginning: The film introduces us to the Stone family, who are preparing for their daughter Amy's (Sarah Jessica Parker) fiancé, Sy (Dermot Mulroney), to meet the family over Thanksgiving weekend. As the story unfolds, we see the family's dynamics, with each member having their own quirks and flaws.

Plot Development: The arrival of Sy and his eccentric relatives creates tension among the Stones, particularly between Amy and her parents, Ellen (Sarah Jessica Parker) and Sybil (Diane Keaton). As the weekend progresses, the family's true colors are revealed, showcasing their flaws, insecurities, and fears. Meanwhile, Amy struggles with her own feelings about her engagement and her desire to fit in with her family.

Ending: The film concludes with a heartwarming moment of acceptance and understanding among the Stones. Sy accepts his place within the family, and Ellen finally lets go of her need for control. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that love and acceptance can conquer even the most stubborn of family dynamics.

Throughout the film, the director explores themes such as:

* The importance of family: Despite their flaws, the Stones ultimately care for each other and want to see them happy.
* Identity: Amy's struggles with her engagement serve as a metaphor for finding one's own identity within the context of family expectations.
* Love: The movie highlights the complexities of love, including romantic love, familial love, and self-love.

Overall, The Family Stone is a witty, engaging film that explores the intricacies of family relationships and the power of love to bring people together.

overview: An impoverished leader of a small religious commune in Miami is offered cash to save his family from eviction. He has no idea his sponsor works for an FBI agent, who plans to turn him into a criminal by fueling his madcap revolutionary dreams.
tagline: A comedy based on a hundred true stories.
title: The Day Shall Come
plot:
The Day Shall Come is a 2019 dark comedy directed by Chris Morris, who co-wrote the screenplay with Jesse Armstrong. A co-production between the United Kingdom, the United States and Australia, it satirizes real FBI counterterrorism sting operations, including the case of the Liberty City Seven. Marchánt Davis stars as Moses Al Shabazz, the leader of a tiny religious commune, with Anna Kendrick as FBI agent Kendra Glack, Danielle Brooks, Denis O'Hare and Pej Vahdat. Secretly filmed in the Dominican Republic, it premiered at South by Southwest in March 2019 and was released in the United States by IFC Films in September.

Moses Al Shabazz is the impoverished, well-meaning leader of the Star of Six, a small commune in a poor neighborhood of Miami whose only members are his wife, Venus, and two followers. Its eccentric theology combines elements of Islam and Christianity with reverence for figures such as "Black Santa" and the Haitian revolutionary Toussaint Louverture. Moses preaches a coming uprising of Black people against their white oppressors but rejects the use of guns, and he refuses to take the antipsychotic medication he has been prescribed because it makes him sleepy.

Kendra Glack, an ambitious FBI agent under pressure to deliver results, discovers Moses's livestreamed sermons and decides he would make the perfect target for a terrorism sting. When Moses faces eviction, Kendra sends Reza, a disreputable shopkeeper working as an FBI informant, to offer financial help from a supposed sheikh linked to Al-Qaeda. At a meeting with the "sheikh," who is actually another informant, Moses asks only for farm equipment and a horse, but after realizing how much money the weapons represent, he agrees to accept fifty rifles while insisting he will never use them. Venus is horrified and leaves with their daughter. As the FBI's elaborate operation spirals into absurdity, with agents manufacturing evidence of a plot that does not exist, Kendra and her superiors grow desperate to make arrests that will justify their efforts, regardless of the truth.

The Day Shall Come received generally favorable reviews, with a 64 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it absurd yet anchored in knotty real-world themes, and a Metacritic score of 70. Critics praised Davis's performance and compared it with Morris's earlier terrorism satire, Four Lions.

overview: Back at home, Chuck relates the island shenanigans of his larva pals Red and Yellow to a skeptical reporter in this movie sequel to the hit cartoon.
title: The Larva Island Movie
plot:
The Larva Island Movie is a 2020 South Korean computer-animated comedy film based on Larva Island, the spin-off of the animated series Larva produced by the studio TUBA n. Directed by Ahn Byoung-wook, it features the voices of Hong Beom-gi and Kang Shin-hyung as the larvae and Eddy Lee as Chuck, with Ahn Hyo-min, Kim Yeon-woo, Choi Nak-yoon, Tom Wayland and Erica Schroeder. Netflix billed the 89-minute film as a sequel to the show, and it was released on the service on 23 July 2020 with a TV-Y7 rating.

The original Larva shorts followed the urban misadventures of two grubs, the small, short-tempered Red and his bigger, dimmer best friend Yellow, neither of whom speaks a human language. Larva Island moved them to a tiny deserted island shared with Chuck, a shipwreck survivor. In the movie, Chuck is back home in New York City, where he nearly steps on a dung beetle but spares it because of the friends he once had among such creatures. Over a meal at a restaurant, he recounts his outlandish survival story to Grace, a reporter who wants to publish it, though he worries that nobody will believe him. His recollections trigger flashbacks to his time on the island: hunger and loneliness, repeated failures to build boats and rafts, storms, freezing cold, scorching heat, typhoons, a volcanic eruption and icebergs. He tells of how he survived thanks to Red and Yellow, whose antics included Red's rivalry for the affection of a female larva and Yellow's endless flatulence, and of other island companions such as Clara, a trained seal who washed ashore, and a tiny alien who took over the body of a crab to become a robotic "Crabsformer". Gradually, the whole restaurant becomes captivated by his stories, and the film adds a sentimental coda to Chuck's arc.

Much of the film consists of footage repurposed from episodes of the series, linked by new framing scenes, and critics were unimpressed. John Serba of Decider advised viewers to skip it, calling it a clip show disguised as a sequel whose relentless fart jokes become an endurance test, while conceding that its animation is simple and colorful. Bob Hoose of Plugged In described it as a poor man's Minions aimed at very young children, noting its mild messages about friendship and seeing things from another's point of view.

overview: When Ruby and Rhett's parents are killed in a car accident, their carefree teenage lives are suddenly shattered. Moving to an incredible house in Malibu with the Glasses', old friends of the family, seems to be the beginning of a new life for them.
tagline: The glass is about to be shattered...
title: The Glass House
plot:
The Glass House is a psychological thriller film that revolves around the complex relationships and dark secrets within a wealthy family. At its core, the movie explores the theme of toxic family dynamics, where the pursuit of power, status, and material wealth can lead to corruption, manipulation, and ultimately, destruction.

The film delves into the idea of how the past can come back to haunt the present, and how the actions of one individual can have far-reaching consequences for those around them. The main character, Rachel Kemp, is a prime example of this, as her seemingly perfect life begins to unravel, revealing a web of deceit and betrayal that threatens to destroy everything she holds dear.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it can be shaped by external forces. As the characters navigate their complex relationships and confront their dark pasts, they are forced to question who they truly are and what they want from life.

Furthermore, The Glass House critiques the excesses of wealth and privilege, highlighting the emptiness and superficiality that can result from a life of luxury. The film's portrayal of the wealthy elite as morally bankrupt and self-absorbed serves as a commentary on the darker aspects of the American Dream.

Overall, The Glass House is a gripping thriller that explores the complexities of human relationships, the destructive power of secrets and lies, and the corrupting influence of wealth and privilege.

overview: From DC Comics comes the Suicide Squad, an antihero team of incarcerated supervillains who act as deniable assets for the United States government, undertaking high-risk black ops missions in exchange for commuted prison sentences.
tagline: Worst Heroes Ever
title: Suicide Squad
plot:
Suicide Squad is a 2016 superhero film directed by David Ayer and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures. The movie is based on the DC Comics anti-hero team of the same name.

The story begins with Amanda Waller (Viola Davis), a high-ranking government official, who creates a secret task force known as Task Force X, also referred to as the Suicide Squad. This team consists of supervillains who are forced to work together to complete a mission in exchange for reduced prison sentences or pardons.

The main character, Will Smith's character, Deadshot (played by Will Smith), is introduced as he escapes from prison and meets up with Rick Flag (Joel Kinnaman), the leader of Task Force X. The team also includes Harley Quinn (Margot Robbie), a former psychiatrist who was driven insane by her abusive relationship with the Joker; Captain Boomerang (Jai Courtney), an Australian mercenary; El Diablo (Jay Hernandez), a Mexican pyromaniac; and Killer Croc (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje), a humanoid crocodile.

The team is tasked with stopping a terrorist named Enchantress (Cara Delevingne) who has stolen the magical artifact known as the "Mother Box." The Enchantress plans to use the Mother Box to destroy the world. However, things don't go according to plan, and the team soon discovers that the Enchantress is not what they expected.

As the mission progresses, the team faces numerous challenges, including a confrontation with the Joker (Jared Leto), who has escaped from Arkham Asylum and is seeking revenge against Harley Quinn. The Joker's presence causes tension among the team members, particularly between Deadshot and Harley Quinn.

Throughout the movie, the characters' backstories are slowly revealed, adding depth to their personalities and motivations. For example, it is shown that Rick Flag was once a soldier who lost his wife in combat, leading him to become a mercenary. Similarly, El Diablo's pyromania is revealed to be a result of his abusive childhood.

In the climactic final battle, the team faces off against the Enchantress and her minions. The Joker also makes an appearance, causing chaos and destruction throughout the city. In the end, the team manages to defeat the Enchantress and destroy the Mother Box, saving the world from destruction.

However, the movie ends on a bittersweet note as Harley Quinn is left alone, still struggling with her mental health issues. The Joker's fate is also left uncertain, leaving room for speculation about his future appearances in the DC Extended Universe.

Overall, Suicide Squad received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $745 million worldwide. Despite its flaws, the movie introduced several new characters to the DC Extended Universe and set the stage for future films featuring the team.

overview: Mr. Kim is jobless, lost in debt and has been dumped by his girlfriend. He decides to end it all by jumping into the Han River - only to find himself washed up on a small, mid-river island. He soon abandons thoughts of suicide or rescue and begins a new life as a castaway. His antics catch the attention of a young woman whose apartment overlooks the river. Her discovery changes both their lives.
tagline: Once in a life time, There comes a moment that you live in HOPE.
title: Castaway on the Moon
plot:
Cast Away on the Moon is a 2009 South Korean romantic comedy film directed by Lee Jeong-ho. The movie tells the story of two people who fall in love despite being from different social classes.

The main theme of Cast Away on the Moon revolves around class differences and social inequality. The protagonist, Jang Geu-sik (played by Ryoo Seung-bum), is a poor but talented young man who dreams of becoming an astronaut. He falls in love with a wealthy woman, Yoon Soo-jin (played by Shin Min-a), from a higher social class.

Throughout the movie, the characters face various obstacles due to their different backgrounds, including disapproval from their families and societal expectations. However, they ultimately find a way to be together despite these challenges.

Another significant theme in Cast Away on the Moon is the power of love and relationships to overcome adversity. The film showcases how Jang Geu-sik and Yoon Soo-jin's love for each other helps them navigate their differences and find common ground.

The movie also explores the idea of social mobility and the importance of education and hard work in achieving one's goals. Jang Geu-sik's determination to pursue his dreams, despite facing numerous setbacks, serves as an inspiration to the audience.

Overall, Cast Away on the Moon is a heartwarming romantic comedy that celebrates the power of love and relationships to overcome social barriers and achieve happiness.

overview: Based on the true events of the only case in US History where a spirit caused the death of a man.
tagline: Possession Knows No Bounds
title: An American Haunting
plot:
An American Haunting is a supernatural horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the devastating consequences of unchecked emotions. The movie revolves around the true story of the Bell Witch, a malevolent spirit said to have haunted the Bell family farm in Tennessee during the early 19th century.

At its core, An American Haunting explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals and families. The film masterfully weaves together elements of psychological horror, drama, and mystery to create a sense of unease and tension that permeates every aspect of the narrative.

The movie also touches upon the idea of the destructive power of secrets and the devastating consequences of keeping them buried. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the truth about the Bell family's past is both haunting and heartbreaking, revealing a complex web of lies, deceit, and tragedy that threatens to consume them all.

Furthermore, An American Haunting examines the blurred lines between reality and madness, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just a product of the characters' fevered imaginations. This ambiguity adds to the sense of unease and uncertainty, making it difficult for the viewer to distinguish between fact and fiction.

Ultimately, the film presents a haunting (pun intended) portrayal of the human condition, revealing the darker aspects of our nature and the devastating consequences of allowing our emotions to consume us.

overview: In Bangkok, the young Kham was raised by his father in the jungle with elephants as members of their family. When his old elephant and the baby Kern are stolen by criminals, Kham finds that the animals were sent to Sidney. He travels to Australia, where he locates the baby elephant in a restaurant owned by the evil Madame Rose, the leader of an international Thai mafia. With the support of the efficient Thai sergeant Mark, who was involved in a conspiracy, Kham fights to rescue the animal from the mobsters.
tagline: Vengeance Knows No Mercy.
title: The Protector
plot:
The Protector is a 2005 martial arts film directed by Renny Harlin and starring Jason Statham as Jack Crawley, an undercover agent working for MI6. 

Beginning: The movie starts with Jack Crawley, a skilled fighter and assassin, who has been sent to Thailand to infiltrate the Triad organization. He assumes the identity of "Jack" and gains the trust of the Triad's leader, Tong Po (Sihung Lung). Jack is tasked with taking down Tong Po, but he soon discovers that his mission is not what it seems.

Plot Development: As Jack delves deeper into the world of the Triads, he meets a beautiful woman named Anna (Claire Forlani), who becomes his ally and potential love interest. Together, they uncover a plot by Tong Po to smuggle heroin out of Thailand and sell it in Europe. Jack must use his skills to take down Tong Po's men and prevent the heroin from being shipped.

However, as Jack gets closer to the truth, he realizes that there is more at stake than just stopping Tong Po. He discovers that Anna is actually a double agent working for MI6, and her true mission is to gather evidence against Tong Po. Jack must navigate his feelings for Anna while also completing his original mission.

Ending: In the climactic final battle, Jack faces off against Tong Po's top henchman, who has been secretly working with Anna all along. With the help of Anna and a few other allies, Jack manages to defeat the henchman and prevent the heroin from being shipped. However, in the process, Jack is severely injured and forced to leave Thailand.

As Jack returns to England, he reflects on his mission and the people he has met during his time in Thailand. He realizes that his feelings for Anna were genuine, but their relationship was complicated by her true loyalties. The movie ends with Jack walking away from a burning building, symbolizing his departure from the world of espionage.

Overall, The Protector is an action-packed thrill ride with plenty of twists and turns. Jason Statham delivers a strong performance as the rugged and charismatic Jack Crawley, and Claire Forlani shines as the beautiful and deadly Anna.

overview: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.
tagline: Heroes don't get any bigger.
title: Ant-Man
plot:
Ant-Man is a 2015 American superhero film directed by Peyton Reed and produced by Marvel Studios. The movie follows the story of Scott Lang, a former thief who becomes the superhero known as Ant-Man.

The film begins with Scott Lang (played by Paul Rudd), a skilled thief who has just been released from San Quentin State Prison after serving time for his crimes. Lang is struggling to find work and provide for his daughter, Cassie, due to his troubled past. He is approached by Darren Cross (played by Corey Stoll), a former partner in crime, who offers him a chance to make amends with his family.

Cross has developed a technology that allows humans to communicate with insects using a device called the Pym Particle Generator. The device uses the Pym Particles, which are tiny particles that can be used to shrink objects or create powerful blasts of energy. Cross plans to use the technology to sell it to the highest bidder, but Lang soon discovers that his former partner has been working for HYDRA, a terrorist organization.

Lang teams up with Hank Pym (played by Michael Douglas), the original Ant-Man, who had created the Pym Particle Generator. Hank is being pursued by HYDRA and needs Lang's help to stop them from getting their hands on the technology. Lang agrees to help Hank, but only if he can use the suit for personal gain.

As Lang trains with Hank to become the new Ant-Man, they are pursued by Cross, who has become obsessed with the Pym Particle Generator. The two teams engage in a series of battles, with Lang using his newfound powers to fight against HYDRA and protect Hank.

Meanwhile, Cassie is being taken care of by her mother, Maggie (played by Judy Greer), who is unaware of Scott's involvement in the superhero world. As the story unfolds, Lang must balance his life as a thief with his new role as Ant-Man, all while trying to make amends with his family.

The film culminates in an epic battle between Lang and Cross, with Hank providing crucial support from behind the scenes. In the end, Lang emerges victorious, but not before realizing that he has found a new purpose in life as Ant-Man.

Throughout the movie, there are several themes explored, including redemption, family, and the power of forgiveness. The film also features plenty of action-packed sequences, with Lang using his powers to fight against HYDRA and protect Hank.

Overall, Ant-Man is a fun and entertaining superhero film that explores the complexities of Scott Lang's character. With its blend of humor, action, and heart, it sets the stage for future Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) films.

overview: A band of Vikings cross enemy lines and a panicked race begins. The losers will pay with their lives.
tagline: There's No Time To Bleed
title: Northmen: A Viking Saga
plot:
Northmen: A Viking Saga is an action-adventure film that delves into the complexities of human nature, loyalty, and the struggle for power in a harsh, unforgiving world. The movie follows the story of a young Viking warrior, One-Eye, who embarks on a perilous journey to reclaim his tribe's stolen treasure.

At its core, Northmen: A Viking Saga explores the theme of identity and belonging. One-Eye's quest is not just about retrieving treasure but also about finding his place within his tribe and proving himself as a worthy warrior. The film highlights the tension between individual desire and collective loyalty, as One-Eye must navigate the treacherous landscape of Viking politics and confront the harsh realities of war.

The movie also touches on the theme of honor and reputation. In the world of the Vikings, one's reputation is everything, and One-Eye's journey is driven by a desire to restore his tribe's honor and reclaim their lost status. However, as he navigates the complexities of Viking society, One-Eye begins to question the true meaning of honor and whether it is worth sacrificing one's own humanity.

Furthermore, Northmen: A Viking Saga explores the theme of violence and its consequences. The film depicts a world where violence is an integral part of life, but also shows how it can lead to devastating consequences for individuals and communities. One-Eye's journey is marked by brutal battles and bloody confrontations, which serve as a reminder that violence often leaves scars that never fully heal.

Overall, Northmen: A Viking Saga is a gripping tale of adventure, action, and self-discovery, set against the richly detailed backdrop of Viking culture and society.

overview: This time around, Chucky and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then the horror goes Hollywood as Chucky unleashes his own brand of murderous mayhem!
tagline: Time to raise some hell.
title: Seed of Chucky
plot:
Seed of Chucky is a 2004 American horror comedy film directed by Don Mancini and written by Don Mancini, David Kirschner, and Leigh Dunlap. The film stars Brad Dourif, Jennifer Tilly, Billy Boyd, and Elizabeth Anne Allen.

The movie takes place five years after the events of Bride of Chucky (1998). Glen (Billy Boyd), the son of Chuckie (Brad Dourif) and Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), is a teenager who has grown up with his mother's cursed doll, Chucky. Glen begins to experience strange and terrifying occurrences, which he believes are caused by Chucky.

As Glen delves deeper into the mystery, he discovers that Chucky has been resurrected and is now seeking revenge on those who wronged him in life. Chucky's plan is to use a magical seed to bring about his own resurrection and wreak havoc on the world.

Meanwhile, Tiffany is struggling with her own demons, including her addiction to painkillers and her complicated relationship with Glen. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Tiffany is not what she seems, and her true intentions are shrouded in mystery.

As Chucky's plan comes to fruition, Glen must navigate a series of gruesome and supernatural events to stop his mother's killer doll from unleashing chaos on the world. Along the way, he teams up with a group of unlikely allies, including a punk rock musician (Elizabeth Anne Allen) who becomes his love interest.

Throughout the film, Don Mancini pays homage to classic horror movies, including The Evil Dead and Halloween. The film's tone is irreverent and self-aware, with plenty of humor and wit. However, it also delivers on the scares, with some truly terrifying moments that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

In the end, Glen must confront his mother's dark past and make a choice between saving himself or saving those he loves. The film's climax is both shocking and satisfying, providing a sense of closure for the characters while also setting up potential future storylines.

Overall, Seed of Chucky is a clever and entertaining horror comedy that expands on the Chucky franchise in unexpected ways. With its witty dialogue, memorable characters, and plenty of scares, it's a must-see for fans of the series and horror enthusiasts alike.

overview: A married couple on the verge of separation are leveled by the news their 18-year-old son committed a mass-shooting at his college, then took his own life.
tagline: To confront the truth, first they had to face each other.
title: Beautiful Boy
plot:
Beautiful Boy is a 2010 American drama directed by Shawn Ku, who wrote it with Michael Armbruster. Michael Sheen and Maria Bello play Bill and Kate Carroll, a married couple whose lives fall apart when their eighteen-year-old son Sam, played by Kyle Gallner, dies in a shooting at his school and is revealed to be the gunman. Alan Tudyk, Moon Bloodgood, Austin Nichols and Meat Loaf appear in supporting roles.

Bill, a businessman, and Kate, a proofreader, have drifted into a cold and distant marriage held together mainly by their son, who is having a hard time at college. One morning the news reports a shooting spree on Sam's campus, and police arrive to tell the couple that Sam is dead and that he was responsible. Kate refuses to believe it and obsessively restores his searched bedroom. Besieged by reporters, the couple take refuge with Kate's brother Eric and his wife Trish, whose son Dylan has seen a video message Sam left about the massacre. Bill reads a statement asking for privacy, and Sam is buried at a small family funeral.

Tensions rise in the crowded house as Trish resents Kate's controlling behaviour toward Dylan, and Bill and Kate move to a motel, where they briefly find a moment of closeness. Returning home, Bill surprises a teenage intruder going through Sam's belongings and cuts his hand in the struggle. On the family laptop the couple find a short video in which Sam apologises and asks them not to hate him.

Grief turns into blame. Bill suggests Kate's constant criticism fuelled their son's anger, Kate accuses Bill of putting work before his family, and in a bitter argument Bill says he wishes Sam had never been born. Kate returns to the house alone, where a young co-worker she invites in turns out to be researching Sam for an article, and she throws him out. Bill tries to go back to work, but after confronting staring colleagues he quits. At Sam's grave he finds the word "killer" scrawled on the headstone and breaks down trying to scrub it off.

Called by the motel manager, Kate finds Bill despondent and takes him home, where they face their loss together as Sam's voice is heard finishing a story about lives changed forever.

The lead performances were widely praised, though critics faulted the storytelling, and the film won the FIPRESCI prize for the Discovery programme at the 2010 Toronto International Film Festival.

overview: Former Special Forces officer, Frank Martin will deliver anything to anyone for the right price, and his no-questions-asked policy puts him in high demand. But when he realizes his latest cargo is alive, it sets in motion a dangerous chain of events. The bound and gagged Lai is being smuggled to France by a shady American businessman, and Frank works to save her as his own illegal activities are uncovered by a French detective.
tagline: Rules are made to be broken.
title: The Transporter
plot:
The Transporter is a 2002 action film directed by Louis Leterrier and starring Jason Statham as Frank Martin, a professional transporter who specializes in delivering high-value packages. The movie was produced by EuropaCorp.

The story begins with Frank Martin (Jason Statham), a skilled driver and transporter who works for the wealthy businessman, Mr. Tey (Shane West). Frank is hired to transport a package from Paris to Istanbul, but things take a turn when he discovers that the package contains a large sum of money meant for his friend, Lai (Suki Waterhouse).

However, upon arrival in Istanbul, Frank is ambushed by a group of thugs who steal the package and leave him for dead. When Frank recovers from his injuries, he sets out to track down the thieves and retrieve the stolen package.

As Frank navigates the streets of Istanbul, he encounters a beautiful woman named Anna (Amy Smart), who becomes entangled in his mission. Together, they embark on a thrilling adventure that takes them through the city's underworld, involving corrupt police officers, ruthless gangsters, and treacherous terrain.

Throughout the film, Frank's skills as a driver and transporter are put to the test as he faces off against various adversaries, including the leader of the thieves, Mr. Tey's henchman, and even Anna's brother, who is revealed to be working with the thieves.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Frank's mission is not just about retrieving the stolen package but also about protecting himself and those he cares about from the various threats that surround him. Along the way, Frank must confront his own troubled past and learn to trust others in order to succeed.

The film's climax features an intense car chase through the streets of Istanbul, with Frank facing off against the thieves in a high-stakes battle for control of the package. In the end, Frank emerges victorious, having successfully retrieved the stolen money and brought the perpetrators to justice.

Overall, The Transporter is an action-packed thrill ride that showcases Jason Statham's charisma and driving skills. With its breakneck pace, stunning stunts, and memorable characters, the film has become a cult classic among fans of the action genre.

original_title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
overview: Finding himself in a new era, approaching retirement, Indy wrestles with fitting into a world that seems to have outgrown him. But as the tentacles of an all-too-familiar evil return in the form of an old rival, Indy must don his hat and pick up his whip once more to make sure an ancient and powerful artifact doesn't fall into the wrong hands.
title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
plot:
Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny is a 2023 American action-adventure directed by James Mangold, who wrote it with David Koepp, Jez Butterworth and John-Henry Butterworth. The fifth and final film in the Indiana Jones series and a sequel to Kingdom of the Crystal Skull (2008), it stars Harrison Ford, with Phoebe Waller-Bridge as his goddaughter Helena Shaw, Mads Mikkelsen as the former Nazi scientist Jürgen Voller, and Antonio Banderas, Boyd Holbrook and Toby Jones, while Karen Allen and John Rhys-Davies return.

In the final days of the Second World War, Indiana Jones and the Oxford archaeologist Basil Shaw are captured by Nazis while trying to recover the Lance of Longinus. The astrophysicist Voller discovers that the relic is fake but that he has found half of Archimedes' Dial, a device said to locate fissures in time. Jones seizes the piece aboard a train loaded with plunder and escapes with Basil.

In 1969, Jones is retiring from teaching in New York and is separated from his wife Marion after the death of their son in Vietnam. Basil's daughter Helena turns up wanting the Dial, which her father had asked Jones to destroy. Voller, now working for NASA, attacks them with CIA help; Helena, a smuggler, flees with the artefact, and Jones, framed for murder, escapes the city with the help of his old friend Sallah.

In Tangier, Jones breaks up Helena's black-market auction, but Voller steals the Dial. With Helena's young accomplice Teddy, they follow Voller to Greece, where Jones's diver friend Renaldo helps them recover a tablet from the Antikythera wreck before Voller kills him. In Sicily they find Archimedes' tomb and the second half of the device, but Voller captures Jones, assembles the Dial and flies toward a fissure, hoping to reach 1939 and change the outcome of the war.

Because of continental drift, the plane instead arrives at the Siege of Syracuse in 214 BC and is shot down, killing Voller. Jones meets Archimedes and wants to remain in the past, but Helena knocks him out and brings him home, where he reconciles with Marion.

The film grossed $384 million worldwide against a budget of nearly $300 million, making it one of the most expensive films ever made, and it holds a 71% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: A college freshman joins her university's rowing team and undertakes an obsessive physical and psychological journey to make it to the top varsity boat, no matter the cost.
title: The Novice
plot:
The Novice is a 2021 American psychological sports drama film written and directed by Lauren Hadaway in her feature debut. Isabelle Fuhrman stars as an obsessive university freshman who joins the rowing team, with Amy Forsyth and Dilone.

Alex Dall, a fiercely driven college freshman, retakes the same physics exam again and again. Although she has no experience in the sport, she joins her university's novice rowing program and quickly becomes consumed by it, fixating on perfecting her stroke. Her rival is Jamie Brill, a naturally athletic fellow novice who needs a rowing scholarship to stay in school and is soon hailed as the best on the team, which only intensifies Alex's determination. Alex trains relentlessly, letting her studies slide, and both women are promoted to the varsity squad. Jamie fits in easily, but Alex struggles socially and athletically, and after she knocks herself out during a major race she is sent back to the novice boat.

Alex's isolation deepens. She loses her fragile friendship with Jamie, collapses during a joint practice, and trains alone after a varsity rower doubts her. The coach, Pete, is concerned about her self-destructive dedication but eventually helps her practice alone over the break. She begins a relationship with Dani, her former teaching assistant, even as her health declines and a wound on her palm repeatedly reopens and becomes infected.

In the spring, Alex and Jamie compete for a vacant seat in the elite first varsity boat. Alex loses, convinced that teammates deliberately held back while rowing with her, and in her despair she harms herself. Dani ends their relationship, and Alex accuses Jamie of cheating, prompting Jamie to dismiss her as just another privileged student. At a casual end-of-season competition, Alex announces that she will break the team record. She collides with other boats and refuses to turn back when a violent storm sets in, continuing to row alone through the downpour. She finishes, then returns to the boathouse, erases her name from the team board, leaves her jersey behind and walks away.

The Novice premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival in June 2021, where Fuhrman won the award for Best Actress, and was released in the United States on December 17, 2021. It received widespread acclaim, particularly for Fuhrman's performance and Hadaway's direction, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 95% approval, and earned five Independent Spirit Award nominations, including Best Film.

overview: When Erin Bell was a young cop, she was given an undercover assignment that ended badly and destroyed her life. Years later, she must face her demons in order to make peace with her past.
tagline: There's nothing to lose when you've already lost everything
title: Destroyer
plot:
Destroyer is a 2018 American neo-noir crime drama film directed by Karyn Kusama and written by Phil Hay and Matt Manfredi. Nicole Kidman stars as a haunted Los Angeles police detective confronting her past, with Toby Kebbell, Tatiana Maslany, Scoot McNairy, Bradley Whitford and Sebastian Stan. The film premiered at the Telluride Film Festival on August 31, 2018, and was released in the United States by Annapurna Pictures on December 25, 2018.

Erin Bell, a worn-out, hard-drinking LAPD detective, arrives at the scene of an unidentified man's murder and hints that she knows who is responsible. Soon after, she receives an anonymous envelope containing a dye-stained hundred-dollar bill, which she recognizes as coming from a bank robbery sixteen years earlier. At that time, she and her partner, the FBI agent Chris, had gone undercover in a desert gang led by the charismatic and violent Silas. Convinced that Silas has resurfaced, Erin sets out to find him, tracking down the surviving gang members one by one.

She begins with Toby, a dying former member released from prison, who points her to Arturo, now a lawyer.
