Ultimately, Mardock Scramble: The Second Combustion is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to confront the complexities of relationships, power, and emotional manipulation.

overview: After an overly ambitious businessman transports an 80-foot python to the United States, the beast escapes and starts to leave behind a trail of human victims. An FBI agent and a snake specialist come up with a plot to combat the creature by pitting it against a bioengineered, 70-foot boa constrictor. It's two great snakes that snake great together!
tagline: Get Ready To Rumble...
title: Boa vs. Python
plot:
Boa vs. Python is a 2004 science fiction horror television film directed by David Flores from a script by Chase Parker and Sam Wells, filmed in Sofia, Bulgaria. A crossover between Python (2000) and New Alcatraz (2002, also known as Boa), it stars David Hewlett as a herpetologist, Jaime Bergman as a marine biologist, Kirk B.R. Woller as an FBI agent, Adamo Palladino, and Angel Boris Reed. It premiered on the Sci Fi Channel in 2004.

A wealthy casino owner named Broddick, who enjoys extreme entertainment, arranges for an enormous genetically engineered reticulated python to be smuggled into the United States from overseas. He plans to use the creature as the quarry in an illegal big-game hunt for his rich friends, another diversion for the ultra-wealthy. During transport through Pennsylvania, however, the snake awakens and becomes enraged. When the convoy stops so that a tranquilizer can be administered, the python smashes through the container, kills the men transporting it and escapes, surviving even the explosion meant to destroy it.

Broddick's hunt goes ahead, but the python, about 80 feet long and weighing several tons, proves far too powerful and kills several of his companions before slipping away into the countryside and heading for populated areas. An FBI agent turns for help to a brilliant but eccentric herpetologist who has bred and trained a giant boa constrictor, and to a marine biologist. Their plan is to release the boa, which is linked to them by a tracking implant, to hunt down the python. With the python leaving a trail of victims, and with Broddick and his hired hunters determined to take the kill themselves, the two giant snakes are drawn toward each other, leading to a climactic battle between the reptiles while the authorities try to prevent a catastrophe.

Boa vs. Python was panned by reviewers, who criticized its acting, special effects and story. It was described as a rip-off of Alien vs. Predator, released the same year, and as an attempt to capitalize on the popularity of Python. Reel Film gave it one and a half out of four stars, faulting its effects and its lack of satisfying action.

overview: Tokyo, Japan, 1989. Lucy Fly, a foreigner who works as a translator, begins a passionate relationship with Teiji, a mysterious man obsessed with photography.
tagline: Look beyond what you see
title: Earthquake Bird
plot:
Earthquake Bird is a 2019 psychological thriller written and directed by Wash Westmoreland, adapted from Susanna Jones's 2001 novel of the same name. Alicia Vikander, Riley Keough, Naoki Kobayashi and Jack Huston star. Ridley Scott served as an executive producer through Scott Free Productions, and the film was shot in Tokyo and on Sado Island in 2018 before Netflix took over distribution.

The story is set in Tokyo in 1989. Lucy Fly, a young Swedish woman who has settled in Japan and works as a translator for a manufacturing company, falls under suspicion of murder when her American friend Lily Bridges disappears. The narrative moves back and forth in time, intercutting the police investigation with glimpses of Lucy's childhood and with the events of the preceding months, in particular her romance with Teiji and her growing friendship with Lily.

Teiji is an amateur photographer who usually shoots nature scenes, reflections in water and abandoned buildings rather than people. Nevertheless, when he first meets Lucy he asks to take her portrait, and the two begin an intense relationship. Lucy notices his odd habit of locking away his favourite photographs in a filing cabinet instead of showing them to anyone.

As Lucy's friendship with Lily deepens, the three spend more and more time together. During a trip to Sado Island, however, the friendship sours when Lucy realises that Teiji has started an affair with Lily behind her back. Not long afterwards Lily vanishes.

Arrested and questioned by Japanese detectives, Lucy confesses that she killed Lily in a jealous rage, but she is released when a body that has been found turns out to belong to someone else. Free again, she searches Teiji's hidden collection of photographs and discovers evidence linking him to Lily's disappearance and death. When Teiji realises what she knows, he attacks her, and Lucy kills him in self-defence. The film closes in a cemetery, where Lucy and her Japanese friend Ms. Kato reflect on what has happened.

Earthquake Bird premiered at the BFI London Film Festival on October 10, 2019, and was released in a limited run on November 1 before streaming on Netflix from November 15. Reviews were mixed: critics praised the commitment of Vikander and Keough but felt the film struggled to bring the novel to life, giving it 50% on Rotten Tomatoes and 48 on Metacritic.

overview: Every few hundred years, the most powerful demon on earth—a snake demon—awakens, and the Yin-Yang Masters are summoned to the capital. Meanwhile, the Princess of the realm has her own plans, as she conspires to claim the demon’s power.
title: The Yin-Yang Master: Dream of Eternity
plot:
The Yin-Yang Master: Dream of Eternity is a 2020 Chinese fantasy adventure film directed by Jeffrey Lau, produced by Hehe Pictures, and released on December 25, 2019 in China. 

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Balance between yin and yang: The title itself refers to the ancient Chinese concept of balance between opposites (yin and yang). This theme is central to the story as the protagonist, Wong Fei-hung, learns to harness his inner energy to achieve harmony with nature.

2. Self-discovery and personal growth: Throughout the film, Wong Fei-hung undergoes a journey of self-discovery, learning to control his emotions and find balance within himself. This theme is reflected in his interactions with his friends and family as well as his battles against evil forces.

3. The power of friendship and loyalty: The relationships between Wong Fei-hung and his friends, particularly his brother and his love interest, are crucial to the story. Their bond and loyalty towards each other serve as a source of strength for both the characters and the protagonist.

4. The struggle between good and evil: The movie features an epic battle between Wong Fei-hung and the villainous forces that threaten the balance of nature. This theme serves as a backdrop for exploring the importance of standing up against injustice and protecting the innocent.

5. Cultural heritage and tradition: As a film set in traditional Chinese culture, The Yin-Yang Master: Dream of Eternity celebrates the rich history and mythology of China. The movie incorporates elements from Chinese folklore and martial arts traditions, adding depth to its narrative.

Overall, The Yin-Yang Master: Dream of Eternity is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of balance, self-discovery, friendship, good vs. evil, and cultural heritage.

overview: In a world where families are limited to one child due to overpopulation, a set of identical septuplets must avoid being put to a long sleep by the government and dangerous infighting while investigating the disappearance of one of their own.
tagline: Seven sisters. One identity.
title: What Happened to Monday
plot:
What Happened to Monday is a 2017 science fiction thriller film directed by Tyler Spindel and written by Spindel, based on the novel of the same name by Nisi Shawl. The movie stars Chloë Moretz, Gabrielle Union, and Nick Robinson.

In a dystopian future, the world has reached a point where overpopulation is a major issue. To solve this problem, the government introduces a unique solution: clones. Yes, you read that right - clones! The story takes place in a not-too-distant future where cloning technology has advanced to the point where it's possible to create an exact replica of a human being.

The movie follows the story of eight identical twin sisters, each with their own unique personality and quirks. They are all clones of the same woman, who was created as part of a government experiment to see if they could be used as organ donors. The twins are raised in secret by their "mother," who is actually a scientist.

As the story unfolds, we learn that the twins have grown up with different personalities and skills, which makes them all unique individuals. They each have their own strengths and weaknesses, but they also share a deep bond with one another.

The main plot of the movie revolves around the twin sisters' quest to uncover the truth about their existence and the reason behind their cloning. Along the way, they discover that they are not just ordinary clones, but rather part of a larger experiment designed by the government to control population growth.

As the twins dig deeper, they begin to question the morality of their existence and the motives of those who created them. They also start to develop feelings for each other, which adds an extra layer of complexity to their relationships.

Throughout the movie, the twins face numerous challenges and obstacles as they try to uncover the truth about themselves and their world. Along the way, they encounter various characters, including a scientist who created them and a group of rebels fighting against the government's control.

The ending of the movie is both emotional and thought-provoking. The twins finally discover the truth about their existence and the reason behind their cloning. However, this revelation comes with a price, as it forces them to confront the harsh realities of their world and the consequences of their actions.

Overall, What Happened to Monday is a gripping sci-fi thriller that explores themes of identity, morality, and the human condition. The movie features a talented cast, including Chloë Moretz, Gabrielle Union, and Nick Robinson, who deliver standout performances that bring depth and nuance to their characters.

The film's visuals are also noteworthy, with a blend of practical and CGI effects that create a believable and immersive world. The score is equally impressive, with a haunting soundtrack that complements the movie's themes and tone.

Overall, What Happened to Monday is a must-see for fans of science fiction and thrillers. It's a thought-provoking and emotionally charged movie that explores complex themes and features a talented cast.

overview: For Tammy, a burger-joint employee, a bad day keeps getting worse. She wrecks her car, loses her job and finds that her husband has been unfaithful. It's time for Tammy to hit the road, but without money or transportation, her options are limited. Her only choice is a road trip with her hard-drinking grandmother, Pearl, who has a car, cash and an itch to see Niagara Falls. It's not the escape Tammy had in mind, but it may be what she needs.
tagline: She hit the road. The road hit back.
title: Tammy
plot:
Tammy is a 2014 American comedy film directed by Michael Dowse and starring Melissa McCarthy, Susan Sarandon, and Allison Janney.

The movie follows the story of Tammy, a woman who embarks on a road trip with her grandmother after being fired from her job. Along the way, they encounter various misadventures, including run-ins with eccentric characters, wild parties, and unexpected romance.

Some of the main themes present in Tammy include:

1. Female empowerment: The film showcases Tammy's journey as she finds her independence and confidence, particularly after being mistreated by her abusive husband.
2. Family dynamics: The movie explores the complex relationships between family members, highlighting the importance of female bonds and intergenerational connections.
3. Self-discovery: As Tammy navigates her way through life, she discovers new aspects of herself and learns to let go of past traumas.
4. Friendship: The film celebrates the power of friendship and the support that comes with it, particularly between women.
5. Embracing one's true self: Tammy's journey is also about embracing her authentic personality and not conforming to societal expectations.

The movie features a talented ensemble cast, including Susan Sarandon as Grandma Helen, who becomes Tammy's unlikely companion on their wild adventure. The film received positive reviews for its humor, heart, and strong performances from the lead actresses.

Overall, Tammy is a heartwarming and hilarious comedy that explores themes of female empowerment, family dynamics, self-discovery, friendship, and embracing one's true self.

overview: Rick is a screenwriter living in Los Angeles. While successful in his career, his life feels empty. Haunted and confused, he finds temporary solace in the decadent Hollywood excess that defines his existence. Women provide a distraction to his daily pain, and every encounter brings him closer to finding his place in the world.
tagline: A quest.
title: Knight of Cups
plot:
Knight of Cups is actually a 2015 American romantic drama film directed by Terrence Malick, not Waypoint Entertainment.

The movie follows Rick (played by Christian Bale), a successful screenwriter who embarks on a journey of self-discovery and love in Los Angeles. The main themes of Knight of Cups revolve around the search for meaning and connection in a seemingly superficial world. Through Rick's experiences with various women, including Marylin (Cate Blanchett) and Karen (Freida Pinto), the film explores the complexities of human relationships, desire, and the fragility of love.

The movie delves into the idea that people are often trapped in their own desires and expectations, leading them to settle for shallow connections rather than true intimacy. It also touches on the theme of disillusionment with modern society's emphasis on material success and social status.

Throughout the film, Malick employs his signature lyrical style, using poetic dialogue and vivid imagery to convey Rick's inner turmoil and emotional struggles. The result is a dreamlike narrative that blurs the lines between reality and fantasy, leaving the audience to ponder the nature of love, identity, and the human condition.

Overall, Knight of Cups is a thought-provoking exploration of the human experience, inviting viewers to reflect on their own desires, relationships, and sense of purpose.

original_title: 鋼の錬金術師 嘆きの丘（ミロス）の聖なる星
overview: After a mysterious prisoner with only a few weeks left on his sentence breaks out of prison in Central City, the Elric brothers attempt to track him down. The search leads them to Table City in the southwestern country of Creta, where Alphonse rescues a young alchemist named Julia from the very man they are trying to capture. In the thick of the fight, they literally tumble into Julia's home turf, the slums of Milos Valley, and are embroiled in the grassroots rebellion of her people.
tagline: Finally tell the story of forbidden bonds
title: Fullmetal Alchemist the Movie: The Sacred Star of Milos
plot:
Fullmetal Alchemist: The Sacred Star of Milos (Japanese: 鋼の錬金術師 嘆きの丘の聖なる星) is a 2011 Japanese animated fantasy action film based on Hiromu Arakawa's manga Fullmetal Alchemist. Produced by Bones following the success of the television series Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood and directed by Kazuya Murata, it features Romi Park as Edward Elric and Rie Kugimiya as his brother Alphonse, with Maaya Sakamoto, Toshiyuki Morikawa and Sakiko Tamagawa. It premiered in Japan on 2 July 2011, with audiences receiving an exclusive manga booklet, and was licensed by Funimation for release in North America in 2012.

The Elric brothers, Edward and Alphonse, pursue an escaped convict, Melvin Voyager, who uses an unusual form of alchemy, but he gets away. They learn that he escaped with only two months of his sentence remaining, and among his belongings they find a newspaper page from which a photograph has been cut. The missing image shows Julia Crichton, a young woman arrested for illegally entering Table City, a remote town on the border between Amestris and the neighboring country of Creta.

Intrigued, the brothers travel to Table City aboard a prison train, which is attacked by a wolf-chimera and by the Black Bats, flying fighters seeking to free what they believe are Milosian prisoners. Pursuing Melvin, the Elrics reach a prison, where he breaks through the walls to find Julia, and Miranda, the leader of the Black Bats, also tries to rescue her. Julia and Al fall into the Valley, a slum in the vast chasm surrounding Table City where the oppressed Milos people live, and Melvin reveals his true identity. The brothers learn that the Milosians, whose land was taken by Creta and Amestris, dream of reclaiming their homeland, and that their hopes rest on a legendary object known as the Sacred Star of Milos. As the Elrics become involved in the Milosians' struggle, they discover a terrible secret about the source of the star's power and a plot involving a dangerous form of alchemy.

The film received mixed reviews. Critics praised its animation, action sequences and the voice cast's return, but many felt it was a standard side story that added little to the franchise and that its new characters lacked depth compared with those of Brotherhood.

overview: In a woods filled with magic and fairy tale characters, a baker and his wife set out to end the curse put on them by their neighbor, a spiteful witch.
tagline: Be careful what you wish for...
title: Into the Woods
plot:
Into the Woods is a 2014 musical fantasy film directed by Rob Marshall, based on the 1987 Broadway play of the same name by Stephen Sondheim and James Lapine. The movie features an ensemble cast, including Meryl Streep, Emily Blunt, Johnny Depp, Chris Pine, and James Corden.

The main themes of Into the Woods include:

1. **The Complexity of Life**: The film explores how life is full of complexities, uncertainties, and trade-offs. The characters' wishes are granted, but often with unintended consequences, highlighting the idea that what seems like a simple solution can lead to more problems.
2. **The Power of Desire**: The movie delves into the human desire for happiness, love, and fulfillment. The characters' desires drive their actions, leading them down paths that ultimately reveal the complexity of their own motivations and emotions.
3. **The Importance of Relationships**: Into the Woods emphasizes the significance of relationships in our lives. The characters' connections with each other are crucial to their growth and understanding, illustrating that true happiness often comes from within and through meaningful relationships.
4. **The Unreliability of Fairy Tales**: The film playfully subverts traditional fairy tale tropes, highlighting the idea that life is not always as straightforward or predictable as it seems in these stories. This theme serves as a commentary on the human experience, where reality often falls short of idealized expectations.

Throughout the movie, the characters navigate their desires, relationships, and the consequences of their choices, ultimately leading to a deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them. The film's themes are woven throughout its narrative, making it a thought-provoking and engaging watch.

overview: When a new friend is brutally assaulted, Detective John Droomor is put by chance in charge of the investigation. Although the evidence against the perpetrators seems overwhelming, there is nothing definitive in the case that guarantees justice is served, even more so if some people are willing to twist and betray it.
production_companies: Detective and the Girl Productions, LLC
tagline: Beyond good and evil is Justice
title: Vengeance: A Love Story
plot:
Vengeance: A Love Story is a 2017 American action thriller directed by former stuntman Johnny Martin from a screenplay by John Mankiewicz, a writer-producer of House of Cards. It is based on Joyce Carol Oates's 2003 novel Rape: A Love Story. Nicolas Cage stars as John Dromoor, a Niagara Falls police detective and Gulf War veteran, with Anna Hutchison as Teena Maguire, Talitha Bateman as her 12-year-old daughter, Bethie, Deborah Kara Unger as Teena's mother, Agnes, and Don Johnson as the defense attorney Jay Kirkpatrick.

The film opens with a bust that goes badly wrong, showing Dromoor's questionable judgment, and he drinks away his troubles in a bar where he meets Teena, a flirtatious single mother who quickly catches his interest. After a Fourth of July party, Teena and Bethie take a shortcut home through the dark woods, where Teena is gang-raped, beaten and left for dead in front of her daughter by a group of four meth addicts. Bethie makes her way back to the road and flags down a passing car, which happens to be driven by Dromoor.

While Teena recovers, Agnes takes on the care of both her daughter and granddaughter. Bethie identifies the attackers and a hearing is set to decide whether the case will go to trial. The defendants' families hire Kirkpatrick, a nationally renowned criminal defense lawyer, who turns the proceedings against the traumatized victim by attacking her sobriety, her parenting and her sex life, while the judge appears all too friendly with him. When the case seems lost and the men are set free, Dromoor, a lone wolf suffering from post-traumatic stress, refuses to accept the failure of the legal system and sets out on his own campaign of vigilante justice against the attackers on Teena's behalf, eventually confronting the lawyer and offering comfort to both Bethie and her mother.

The project had first been planned for production in Michigan around 2009 with Samuel L. Jackson, Dianne Wiest and Abigail Breslin attached, but stalled. Cage joined in February 2016 and was briefly announced as director before stepping back, and filming began that April. The film was released direct to video in the United Kingdom in March 2017 and by FilmRise in the United States on September 15, 2017. Reviews were negative: Michael Rechtshaffen of the Los Angeles Times called it ham-handed and cliché-ridden and found Cage's performance detached, while Flickering Myth criticized its overwrought acting and tidy, consequence-free ending.

overview: The BFG is no ordinary bone-crunching giant. He is far too nice and jumbly. It's lucky for Sophie that he is. Had she been carried off in the middle of the night by the Bloodbottler, or any of the other giants—rather than the BFG—she would have soon become breakfast. When Sophie hears that the giants are flush-bunking off to England to swollomp a few nice little chiddlers, she decides she must stop them once and for all. And the BFG is going to help her!
tagline: The world is more giant than you can imagine.
title: The BFG
plot:
The BFG is a 2016 fantasy adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg, based on the 1982 novel of the same name by Roald Dahl. The story takes place in an alternate version of Great Britain and follows the journey of a young girl named Sophie.

The film begins with Sophie, a 10-year-old orphan living in a London orphanage. One night, while out foraging for food, Sophie encounters the Big Friendly Giant (BFG), who is unlike any other giant she has ever seen. The BFG is small and gentle, and he collects dreams instead of eating humans like the other giants.

Sophie befriends the BFG and learns that he is being bullied by the other giants, led by the Fleshlumpeater, Bonecruncher, and Childchewer. The BFG tells Sophie about his dream-collecting business and asks for her help in stopping the Queen of England from eating humans at night.

The BFG and Sophie devise a plan to convince the Queen to stop eating humans, but things become complicated when they are discovered by the Queen's guards. The BFG is captured, and Sophie must come up with a clever plan to rescue him.

As the story unfolds, Sophie learns about the BFG's world and the different types of giants that inhabit it. She also discovers that the BFG has a special gift – he can make anyone laugh, which makes them forget their troubles.

With the help of the BFG, Sophie convinces the Queen to stop eating humans by using her own laughter as an example. The Queen is charmed by Sophie's innocence and kindness, and she agrees to stop eating humans.

The film ends with Sophie returning to the orphanage, but not before saying goodbye to the BFG. She realizes that she has found a true friend in the giant and promises to visit him again soon. As for the BFG, he returns to his home in Giant Country, where he is welcomed back by his fellow giants.

Throughout the film, Spielberg brings Dahl's beloved characters to life with stunning visuals and heartwarming performances from the cast, including Mark Rylance as the BFG and Ruby Barnhill as Sophie. The film's themes of friendship, kindness, and the power of laughter make it a delightful and entertaining adventure for audiences of all ages.

Overall, The BFG is a charming and imaginative film that stays true to Dahl's original story while also adding its own unique twists and surprises. With its beautiful animation, engaging storyline, and memorable characters, this film is sure to delight both children and adults alike.

overview: World War I has left golfer Rannulph Junuh a poker-playing alcoholic, his perfect swing gone. Now, however, he needs to get it back to play in a tournament to save the financially ravaged golf course of a long-ago sweetheart. Help arrives in the form of mysterious caddy Bagger Vance.
tagline: It Was Just A Moment Ago.
title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
plot:
The Legend of Bagger Vance is a 2000 American sports drama film directed by Robert Redford. The movie tells the story of Rannulph Junuh, a young golfer from Georgia who seeks the advice of an enigmatic caddie named Bagger Vance to help him win a high-stakes golf tournament.

At its core, The Legend of Bagger Vance is a film about redemption and self-discovery. Rannulph's journey is one of coming to terms with his past mistakes and finding forgiveness from himself and others. Through his interactions with Bagger Vance, who embodies the values of humility, integrity, and respect for nature, Rannulph learns to let go of his ego and find a deeper connection with the game of golf.

The film also explores themes of friendship and loyalty, as Rannulph forms a bond with Bagger Vance, who becomes like a mentor to him. The movie highlights the importance of relationships in our lives and how they can help us grow and learn from our experiences.

Furthermore, The Legend of Bagger Vance is a story about finding one's true purpose and identity. Rannulph's journey is not just about winning a golf tournament, but about discovering who he is as a person and what truly matters to him in life. Through his experiences, he learns to appreciate the simple things in life and finds a sense of peace and contentment.

Overall, The Legend of Bagger Vance is a film that celebrates the beauty of nature, the importance of relationships, and the power of self-discovery and redemption.

overview: Six college friends blowing off steam on a camping trip, find themselves caught up in a cat and mouse hunt with an Alien monster. Not knowing what to do or who to trust, they struggle to protect themselves. Reluctantly, they join forces with another, seemingly friendly, alien, Ava, who orbits the Earth and appears to them in the form of an avatar. Having only one chance at stopping the monster, they must race to locate and repair the Ava’s earth sent robot, before it slaughters them one by one.
title: Aliens vs Avatars
plot:
Aliens vs Avatars is a 2011 American low-budget science fiction horror film directed by Lewis Schoenbrun from a script credited to Ted Chalmers and David S. Sterling, produced by Sterling Entertainment and Tom Cat Films. A mockbuster riffing on the titles of Alien vs. Predator and James Cameron's Avatar, it follows a conflict between a vicious alien species and shape-shifting extraterrestrials, with six college friends caught in the middle. Its distributor, Summer Hill Entertainment, later retitled it Alien vs. Alien.

Six college friends head into the wilderness on a camping trip to blow off steam, only to find themselves the quarry of a monstrous alien that begins hunting them in a deadly game of cat and mouse. Unsure what they are facing or whom to trust, the group struggles to defend itself as the creature closes in. Help appears in the form of Ava, another, seemingly friendly alien who orbits the Earth and can reach them only by appearing in the form of an avatar. Reluctantly joining forces with her, the survivors learn that they have just one chance to stop the monster: they must find and repair the robot Ava has sent down to Earth before the creature slaughters them one by one.

The cast is led by Jason Lockhart as Tyler, Kim Argetsinger as Jesse and Cassie Fliegel as Ava, with Dylan Vox as Jake, Marlene Mc'Cohen as Tiffany, Ginny You as Dana and Georgina Tolentino as Crystal. The film was shot in Los Angeles in the summer of 2010, while Schoenbrun was finishing post-production on The Amazing Bulk; he considered it the harder production of the two because of its many shooting locations.

The film received no theatrical release and was issued directly to video, DVD and television on 20 September 2011, becoming Schoenbrun's most widely released film that year. Reviews were overwhelmingly negative. The horror blogger Baron Craze dismissed its dialogue as half-baked drivel and found it boring, and Richard Scheib called it only marginally better made than the kind of film teenagers shoot on a camcorder over successive weekends, though it found some fans on home video in Japan. In 2012 Tom Cat Films sued hundreds of anonymous "John Doe" defendants in U.S. federal court for allegedly downloading the film illegally, a suit that commentators described as copyright trolling.

overview: The story of Nobel Prize winner Marie Curie and her extraordinary scientific discoveries—through the prism of her marriage to husband Pierre—and the seismic and transformative effects their discovery of radium had on the 20th century.
tagline: Pioneer. Genius. Rebel.
title: Radioactive
plot:
Radioactive is a 2019 British biographical drama directed by Marjane Satrapi and starring Rosamund Pike as Marie Curie, with Sam Riley as Pierre Curie, Aneurin Barnard as Paul Langevin, Anya Taylor-Joy as the adult Irène Curie and Simon Russell Beale. Jack Thorne's screenplay adapts Lauren Redniss's 2010 graphic novel Radioactive: Marie & Pierre Curie: A Tale of Love and Fallout.

In 1934 Marie Curie collapses in her Paris laboratory, and as she is taken to hospital her life passes before her. In 1893 her abrasive manner has cost her funding and laboratory space, a trait she shares with the scientist Pierre Curie, and the two end up working side by side. They fall in love, marry and have two daughters, and their research leads to the discovery of polonium and radium and of radioactivity itself, transforming physics and chemistry. Radium quickly finds its way into a wave of commercial products.

Marie, an unbeliever since her mother's death in Poland, scorns the séances Pierre attends. He turns down the Légion d'honneur because it ignores her and insists they share the Nobel Prize in Physics, yet she is hurt when he accepts it in Stockholm without her. Weakened by illness linked to their work, Pierre is killed by a horse-drawn cart. Marie long dismisses fears about radium's dangers even as people exposed to it fall ill.

Grieving, she begins an affair with her colleague Paul Langevin. Although she succeeds Pierre as professor at the Sorbonne, the nationalist press exposes the affair and she is targeted by xenophobic crowds because of her Polish origins. In desperation she asks her friend Loie Fuller to help her reach Pierre's spirit. Awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1911, she ignores the committee's request to stay away and is cheered at the ceremony. During the First World War her daughter Irène persuades her to run mobile X-ray units at the front.

Interwoven with her story are scenes of her discoveries' legacy, from radiotherapy in 1950s Cleveland to Hiroshima, a 1961 nuclear test in Nevada and Chernobyl. Dying, Marie sees these visions and leaves the hospital with Pierre.

The film closed the 2019 Toronto International Film Festival. After its cinema release was cancelled by the COVID-19 pandemic, it reached audiences digitally and on Amazon Prime Video in 2020, earning 63% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, with Pike's performance singled out.

overview: Susannah Cahalan, an up-and-coming journalist at the New York Post becomes plagued by voices in her head and seizures, causing a rapid descent into insanity.
tagline: It's not supposed to happen. Be prepared when it does.
title: Brain on Fire
plot:
Brain on Fire is a 2017 biographical drama film that tells the story of Jill Bolte Taylor, a neuroscientist who suffered a rare brain injury. The movie delves into the complexities of identity, consciousness, and the human experience.

At its core, Brain on Fire explores the theme of self-discovery and the blurring of boundaries between the individual and their surroundings. As Jill navigates her recovery from the traumatic event, she begins to question the nature of her own existence and the world around her. The film masterfully captures the disorienting sensation of losing one's sense of self, as Jill struggles to reconcile her past and present selves.

The movie also touches on the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Jill's experience serves as a powerful metaphor for the ways in which traumatic events can reshape our perceptions of reality and challenge our understanding of ourselves. Through Jill's journey, the film sheds light on the often-overlooked consequences of brain injuries and the importance of empathy and compassion in supporting those affected.

Furthermore, Brain on Fire raises questions about the intersection of science and spirituality, highlighting the tension between rational inquiry and the mysteries of human consciousness. As Jill grapples with her newfound understanding of the brain and its functions, she begins to explore the realm of spirituality and the nature of existence. This philosophical undertone adds depth and nuance to the film, inviting viewers to ponder the complexities of the human experience.

Ultimately, Brain on Fire is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to confront their own assumptions about identity, consciousness, and the world around them.

overview: A married couple's life is turned upside down when the wife is accused of murdering her boss. Her husband John would spend the next few years trying to get her released, but there's no evidence that negates the evidence against her. When the strain of being separated from her husband and son gets to her, John decides to find a way to break her out.
tagline: What if you had 72 hours to save everything you live for?
title: The Next Three Days
plot:
The Next Three Days is a 2010 American thriller film directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Russell Crowe, Olivia Wilde, and Léa Seydoux. The movie follows the story of John Brennan (Russell Crowe), an architect who becomes embroiled in a cat-and-mouse game with the police after he is accused of murdering his wife, Linda (Léa Seydoux).

The film begins with John and Linda's seemingly perfect life together. However, it is revealed that their marriage was troubled, and Linda had been planning to leave John for another man. On the day before her planned departure, Linda goes out for a jog and never returns. The police investigation reveals that she has been murdered, and John becomes the prime suspect.

As the police close in on him, John realizes that he must take drastic action to clear his name. He begins to plan an elaborate escape from prison, where he is being held without bail. With the help of a fellow inmate, Eddie (Michael Angarano), John devises a plan to break out and make his way back to his home in New York City.

As John navigates the complexities of his situation, he becomes increasingly obsessed with finding out who killed Linda and why. He begins to suspect that her murder is connected to a larger conspiracy involving corrupt government officials and corporate interests.

Meanwhile, Detective Bremer (Liev Schreiber) is determined to catch John and bring him to justice. As the cat-and-mouse game between John and the police intensifies, it becomes clear that nothing is as it seems. John's plan is fraught with risks, and he must use all his wits and cunning to stay one step ahead of the authorities.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Linda was not just an innocent victim but a key player in a larger game. Her murder is linked to a complex web of corruption and deceit that reaches the highest levels of government and industry.

In the end, John's plan comes to fruition, and he successfully escapes from prison. However, as he makes his way back to New York City, he realizes that his actions have consequences beyond his own survival. He must confront the truth about Linda's murder and the conspiracy surrounding it, and make a choice between his desire for revenge and his need to move on with his life.

The Next Three Days is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores themes of love, betrayal, and redemption. Russell Crowe delivers a powerful performance as John Brennan, bringing depth and nuance to a complex and flawed character. The film's twisty plot and unexpected turns keep the audience guessing until the very end.

overview: On the mystical island of Themyscira, a proud and fierce warrior race of Amazons have raised a daughter of untold beauty, grace and strength: Princess Diana. When an Army fighter pilot, Steve Trevor, crash-lands on the island, the rebellious and headstrong Diana defies Amazonian law by accompanying Trevor back to civilization.
tagline: Courageous princess. Fierce warrior. Legendary superhero.
title: Wonder Woman
plot:
Wonder Woman is a 2009 American animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character, the fourth entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line. Directed by Lauren Montgomery from a screenplay by Gail Simone and Michael Jelenic, and produced by Bruce Timm, its story is loosely based on George Pérez's "Gods and Mortals" storyline, which relaunched the character in 1987. Keri Russell voices Princess Diana, with Nathan Fillion as Steve Trevor, Alfred Molina as Ares, Virginia Madsen as Hippolyta and Rosario Dawson as Artemis.

In ancient times, the Amazons, led by their queen, Hippolyta, rise up against Ares, the god of war. Hippolyta kills Ares's son, but before she can kill Ares himself, Zeus intervenes, and Ares is instead bound in magic bracelets that cut him off from the power he draws from violence. The Amazons are granted the hidden island of Themyscira, where they live in eternal youth, guarding Ares as their prisoner. Hippolyta is also given a daughter, Diana, whom she sculpts from sand and brings to life with her blood.

Centuries later, Diana longs to see the outside world. When the American fighter pilot Steve Trevor crash-lands on the island, the Amazons decide that he must be escorted home. Forbidden to compete for the task, Diana enters in disguise and wins. Meanwhile, the Amazon Persephone, seduced by Ares, kills Diana's friend Alexa and frees him. Diana and Steve fly to New York City in his invisible jet to track Ares down. They defeat one of Ares's demigod sons, Deimos, and follow his trail to a gateway to the underworld, where Ares escapes after persuading Hades to remove his bracelets.

Ares raises an army and attacks Washington, D.C. Diana and Steve are joined by the Amazons, and Ares summons the spirits of dead Amazons to fight their sisters, until the undead Alexa reveals a chant that breaks his hold over them. Hippolyta kills Persephone. Under Ares's influence, the President launches a nuclear missile at Themyscira, which Steve shoots down with the invisible jet. Diana finally defeats Ares, who is condemned to serve Hades in the underworld. Hippolyta allows Diana to return to the world of men as an ambassador, and she settles in New York with Steve as Wonder Woman.

Released directly to video on March 3, 2009, the film received mostly positive reviews, with IGN praising its humor, action and voice performances, particularly Fillion's.

overview: Two hundred years after Lt. Ripley died, a group of scientists clone her, hoping to breed the ultimate weapon. But the new Ripley is full of surprises … as are the new aliens. Ripley must team with a band of smugglers to keep the creatures from reaching Earth.
tagline: It's already too late.
title: Alien Resurrection
plot:
Alien Resurrection is a 1997 science fiction action film directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet, produced by 20th Century Fox, and written by Joss Whedon. The movie takes place 200 years after the events of Alien 3 (1992) and serves as a sequel to the original Alien trilogy.

The story begins in the year 2447, where humanity has colonized other planets. A group of scientists from the Weyland-Yutani Corporation, led by Dr. Charles Bishop Weyland (Lance Henriksen), have discovered a way to clone the alien creatures that terrorize the human colonies. The corporation plans to use these clones as a new source of labor and resources.

The movie follows Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver), who has been in stasis for 200 years, awaiting her execution for killing the alien queen in Alien 3. However, she is rescued by a group of rebels, led by Vriess (Dominique Pinon), who plan to use her as part of their mission to stop Weyland-Yutani's sinister plans.

Ripley soon discovers that the corporation has created a new breed of alien, known as the "Newborn," which is more aggressive and deadly than its predecessors. The Newborns are also capable of regenerating their bodies at an alarming rate, making them nearly impossible to kill.

As Ripley joins forces with Vriess and his team, including Call (Winona Ryder), a young clone who possesses some human-like qualities, they embark on a perilous journey to stop Weyland-Yutani's plans. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, deadly alien creatures, and rival corporations seeking to exploit the Newborns for their own gain.

Throughout the movie, Ripley struggles with her past and her newfound connection to Call, who is revealed to be a clone of herself created by Weyland-Yutani. This revelation raises questions about identity, humanity, and what it means to be alive.

As the story unfolds, Ripley and her team face off against Bishop (Lance Henriksen), who has become a cyborg and serves as Weyland-Yutani's top agent. The final confrontation takes place on a space station, where Ripley and her allies must fight for survival against an army of deadly Newborns.

In the end, Ripley manages to defeat Bishop and destroy the Newborns, but not before Call sacrifices herself to save Ripley. The movie concludes with Ripley, now an old woman, reflecting on her past and the events that have shaped her into the person she is today.

Alien Resurrection received mixed reviews from critics at the time of its release, with some praising its visuals and action sequences, while others found it lacking in terms of storytelling and character development. However, over the years, the movie has developed a cult following and is now regarded as a unique entry in the Alien franchise.

overview: Flight 23 has crashed in the Bermuda Triangle after a hijacking gone wrong. Now the surviving passengers must brave panic, slow leaks, oxygen depletion, and more while attempting a daring plan, all while 200 feet underwater.
tagline: Flight 23 has crashed in the Bermuda Triangle... passengers still alive, trapped underwater...
title: Airport '77
plot:
Airport '77 is a disaster film directed by Jerry Jameson, released in 1977 by Universal Pictures. The movie takes place at Washington National Airport and revolves around a series of catastrophic events that unfold on a fateful day.

The story begins with the introduction of several characters, including Steve McCauley (Burt Reynolds), a former test pilot who has retired from flying due to a near-fatal accident. Steve is now working as an airport security inspector, tasked with ensuring the safety of air traffic at Washington National Airport.

As the day unfolds, a series of strange occurrences start to happen. A small plane carrying a group of passengers and crew crashes on the runway, causing a massive fire that blocks the entire airport. The authorities are initially unable to respond effectively due to the chaos caused by the crash, leading to further accidents and mishaps.

Meanwhile, Steve is dealing with his own personal demons, including a troubled relationship with his girlfriend, Elaine (Susan Blakely). As the day progresses, Steve becomes increasingly frustrated with the incompetence of the airport's management and the lack of preparedness for emergencies.

As the situation spirals out of control, Steve takes matters into his own hands, using his flying skills to rescue those trapped in the burning plane. He also teams up with a young air traffic controller, Mark (Jack Warden), who helps him navigate the chaos and coordinate the response efforts.

Throughout the movie, the tension builds as the characters face numerous challenges, including treacherous weather conditions, equipment failures, and human error. The film's climax features an intense sequence of events, including a dramatic rescue mission and a confrontation with the airport's corrupt management.

Ultimately, Steve emerges as a hero, having saved countless lives and brought order to the chaotic situation. As he reflects on the day's events, Steve comes to terms with his past mistakes and finds closure with Elaine.

Airport '77 is an action-packed disaster film that explores themes of personal responsibility, teamwork, and redemption. The movie features impressive aerial sequences, suspenseful plot twists, and a strong performance from Burt Reynolds as the protagonist. While some critics have panned the film's predictability and lack of originality, Airport '77 remains a beloved classic among fans of disaster movies and action films.

Overall, Airport '77 is an entertaining and thrilling ride that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. With its memorable characters, intense plot developments, and heart-pumping action sequences, this movie is sure to delight audiences who enjoy disaster films and adventure stories.

overview: Agents J and K are back...in time. J has seen some inexplicable things in his 15 years with the Men in Black, but nothing, not even aliens, perplexes him as much as his wry, reticent partner. But when K's life and the fate of the planet are put at stake, Agent J will have to travel back in time to put things right. J discovers that there are secrets to the universe that K never told him - secrets that will reveal themselves as he teams up with the young Agent K to save his partner, the agency, and the future of humankind.
tagline: Back in time.
title: Men in Black 3
plot:
Men in Black 3 is a science fiction comedy film directed by Barry Sonnenfeld and released in 2012 by Columbia Pictures.

The movie takes place in 2012, with Agent J (Will Smith) and Agent K (Tommy Lee Jones) on a mission to stop an alien threat. However, during the mission, Agent K is killed by an alien, leaving Agent J alone to carry on his work.

In order to prevent the destruction of the world, Agent J travels back in time to 1969, where he meets a younger version of Agent K (played by Josh Brolin). The two agents must work together to stop an evil alien named Boris the Animal (Jemaine Clement) from killing Agent K and taking over the world.

As they travel through time, Agent J learns about the origins of the Men in Black organization and the history of Agent K. He also discovers that Boris was once a member of the organization but became corrupted by his own power and desire for revenge against Agent K.

Throughout their journey, Agent J and Agent K encounter various characters from the 1960s, including a young version of Agent Z (Michael Stuhlbarg) and a young version of Agent O (Emma Thompson). They also visit iconic locations such as Woodstock and the Apollo 11 launch site.

As they get closer to stopping Boris, Agent J and Agent K must navigate through time and confront their own personal demons. Along the way, Agent J learns more about his own past and the origins of the Men in Black organization.

In the end, Agent J and Agent K successfully stop Boris and prevent him from killing Agent K. However, Agent J is left to return to his own time, where he finds that 2012 has been destroyed by an alien invasion. The movie ends with Agent J and Agent Z (played by Michael Stuhlbarg) working together to rebuild the world.

Men in Black 3 received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $624 million worldwide. The movie's blend of action, comedy, and science fiction elements made it a fun and entertaining ride for audiences.

overview: Kevin McCallister's parents have split up. Now living with his mom, he decides to spend Christmas with his dad at the mansion of his father's rich girlfriend, Natalie. Meanwhile robber Marv Merchants, one of the villains from the first two movies, partners up with a new criminal named Vera to hit Natalie's mansion.
tagline: Taking Back the House
title: Home Alone 4
plot:
Home Alone 4, also known as Home Alone: Taking Back the House, is a 2002 American Christmas comedy television film directed by Rod Daniel. Produced by Fox Television Studios, it premiered on ABC as part of The Wonderful World of Disney. A loose sequel to Home Alone 2: Lost in New York, it features none of the original cast and was the first film in the franchise made without John Hughes. Mike Weinberg plays Kevin McCallister, with French Stewart as the burglar Marv and Missi Pyle as his wife Vera, alongside Erick Avari, Barbara Babcock, Jason Beghe, Clare Carey and Joanna Going.

Kevin's parents, Peter and Kate, are separated, and Peter is living with his wealthy girlfriend, Natalie, who is preparing to host a visiting royal family at her high-tech mansion over Christmas. Peter invites his children to spend the holiday there, and while his siblings refuse, Kevin accepts and enjoys the luxuries of the house. He soon spots his old enemy Marv and Marv's new wife, Vera, scouting the property, and drives them away, but the adults refuse to believe him, especially since the security cameras were switched off during the break-in.

Kevin discovers that Marv and Vera are planning to kidnap the young prince during the royal visit and hold him for ransom, with help from someone inside the household. Suspecting the stern butler, Mr. Prescott, Kevin tries to warn his father, but after he accidentally ruins a party, Peter accuses him of trying to sabotage his relationship with Natalie. Taking matters into his own hands, Kevin turns the mansion's gadgets into an array of booby traps and discovers the true identity of the criminals' accomplice. When the burglars return, Kevin defends the house with a series of painful pranks, leading to the reunion of his family.

The film was shot in Cape Town, South Africa, and recreates the slapstick formula of the original films on a smaller television budget.

Home Alone 4 first aired on November 3, 2002, and was released on DVD in September 2003. It received generally negative reviews: Moviehole and Common Sense Media each gave it one star out of five, the latter describing it as recycled gags with none of the original's charm.

overview: While investigating the horrifying death of her boyfriend, Mai Takano learns about a videotape haunted by the spirit of a disturbing girl named Sadako, which kills anyone who watches it exactly one week later. When her boyfriend’s son, Yoichi, starts to develop the same psychic abilities as Sadako, Takano must find a way to keep the boy and herself from becoming the next victims.
title: Ringu 2
plot:
Ringu 2 is a 1999 Japanese horror film directed by Hideo Nakata, produced by Toho Co., Ltd.

The main theme of Ringu 2 revolves around the concept of cursed videotapes and the supernatural forces that drive individuals to commit horrific acts. The story follows a young woman named Kira Kuromaki, who is haunted by visions of her deceased sister after receiving a mysterious videotape.

As the plot unfolds, it becomes clear that the tape is cursed, causing the viewer to experience a series of terrifying events and ultimately leading to their own death. The film explores the idea of the "curse" as a metaphor for the destructive power of grief, trauma, and the supernatural.

Throughout the movie, Nakata weaves together elements of Japanese folklore and mythology, creating a sense of unease and tension that permeates every aspect of the narrative. The film's climax features a shocking twist, revealing the true nature of the curse and its connection to Kira's sister.

One of the most striking aspects of Ringu 2 is its exploration of the theme of "viral" horror, where the cursed videotape serves as a symbol for the way in which fear and terror can spread rapidly through modern society. The film's use of this concept adds a layer of social commentary to the narrative, highlighting the ways in which technology can be used to spread terror and manipulate individuals.

Overall, Ringu 2 is a masterclass in building tension and creating a sense of unease, with its themes of cursed videotapes, supernatural forces, and viral horror making it a standout entry in the Ring franchise.

overview: Two Brooklyn siblings' summer in a rural Oahu town takes an exciting turn when a journal pointing to long-lost treasure sets them on an adventure, leading them to reconnect with their Hawaiian heritage.
tagline: Home is where ʻohana is
title: Finding ʻOhana
plot:
Finding ʻOhana is a 2021 American family adventure film directed by Jude Weng in her feature debut and written by Christina Strain. It stars Kea Peahu as Pili, a young geocaching enthusiast, and Alex Aiono as her older brother Ioane, with Lindsay Watson, Owen Vaccaro, Kelly Hu as their mother Leilani, Branscombe Richmond and Ke Huy Quan, whose appearance marked his return to acting. Described during development as an adventure in the spirit of The Goonies, it was produced by Ian Bryce after Netflix acquired the project in 2019.

Pili and her brother Ioane, known as E, are Hawaiian siblings raised in Brooklyn. Pili, an avid geocacher, wins a place at a summer camp, but instead the family travels to the island of Oʻahu with their mother to help her father, Kimo, who is struggling with health and financial problems. Bored and homesick, Pili discovers an old diary in her grandfather's studio, kept by the quartermaster of a ship whose crew mutinied and hid a treasure on the island centuries earlier.

Together with Casper, a nerdy local boy, Pili decides to follow the clues in the journal to find the treasure, which could save her grandfather's home. E, who has been dismissive of his Hawaiian heritage, joins the search along with Hana, a local girl he likes. The four venture into a network of caves, facing collapsing tunnels, flooded passages and dangerous traps. When they finally reach the treasure, Hana realizes that it is a sacred offering protected by the Night Marchers, the ghosts of ancient warriors, and the siblings' quest becomes a journey of reconnection with their family, culture and the meaning of ʻohana. An encounter with the spirits brings the family a final moment with the children's late father, and they decide to make Hawaiʻi their home.

The film celebrates Hawaiian culture, family and heritage, combining adventure with themes of identity and belonging.

Finding ʻOhana premiered on Netflix on January 29, 2021. It received generally favorable reviews, with 81 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 69.

overview: Brooklyn mobster and prolific hit man Jimmy Conlon has seen better days. Longtime best friend of a mob boss, Jimmy is haunted by the sins of his past—as well as a dogged police detective who’s been one step behind Jimmy for 30 years. But when Jimmy’s estranged son becomes a target, Jimmy must make a choice between the crime family he chose and the real family he abandoned long ago. Now, with nowhere safe to turn, Jimmy has just one night to figure out exactly where his loyalties lie and to see if he can finally make things right.
title: Run All Night
plot:
Run All Night is a 2015 American action thriller film directed by Jaume Collet-Serra and starring Liam Neeson, Joel Kinnaman, and Ed Harris.

The movie begins with Leo Kearns (Liam Neeson), a former hitman who has retired to a quiet life in Brooklyn with his wife, Veronica (Geraldine Viswanathan). However, their peaceful existence is disrupted when Leo's estranged son, Danny (Joel Kinnaman), and his pregnant girlfriend, Amanda (Bojana Jelic), arrive at their doorstep. Unbeknownst to Veronica, Danny has been involved in a life of crime and has gotten himself into trouble with some unsavory characters.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Danny's troubles are connected to a powerful crime lord named Lenny Brock (Ed Harris). Brock is a ruthless and cunning adversary who will stop at nothing to eliminate anyone who gets in his way. When Danny fails to pay off his debt to Brock, he sets out to collect on the loan by targeting Leo and his family.

Leo, who has been trying to leave his violent past behind him, finds himself drawn back into the world of crime when Danny's life is threatened. As the situation spirals out of control, Leo must use all his skills and experience to protect his son and his wife from Brock's henchmen. Along the way, he also seeks revenge against Brock for putting his family in harm's way.

As the action unfolds, Leo finds himself in a series of intense confrontations with Brock's men, including a memorable showdown at a Brooklyn diner. Meanwhile, Danny tries to make amends with his father and prove himself as a changed man. However, it soon becomes clear that Danny is not as reformed as he claims to be.

The film builds towards a thrilling climax as Leo faces off against Brock in an epic battle of wits and fists. In the end, Leo emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. The movie concludes with a sense of closure for the characters, although some loose ends are left unresolved.

Throughout the film, Liam Neeson delivers his signature brand of tough-guy charm, bringing depth and nuance to the role of Leo Kearns. Ed Harris provides a formidable foil as the ruthless crime lord Brock, while Joel Kinnaman brings a sense of vulnerability and desperation to his portrayal of Danny.

Overall, Run All Night is a tense and thrilling action movie that explores themes of family, loyalty, and redemption. While it may not be as original or groundbreaking as some other films in the genre, it delivers plenty of excitement and suspense for fans of Liam Neeson's brand of action heroics.

overview: Mia Hall, a talented young cellist, thought the most difficult decision she would ever have to make would be whether to pursue her musical dreams at prestigious Juilliard or follow her heart to be with the love of her life, Adam, a rock singer/guitarist. However, a car wreck changes everything in an instant, and now Mia's life hangs in the balance. Suspended between life and death, Mia faces a choice that will decide her future.
tagline: Live for Love.
title: If I Stay
plot:
"If I Stay" is a 2014 American drama film directed by R.J. Cutler, based on the novel of the same name by Gayle Forman.

The movie follows the story of Mia Hall (played by Chloë Moretz), a 17-year-old cellist who is involved in a car accident that kills her parents and leaves her with a choice: stay alive but lose her musical talent and relationships, or die and miss out on life. The film explores themes such as:

1. **The value of life**: Mia's decision to stay alive forces her to reevaluate what truly matters in life. She must confront the possibility that she may never be able to play music again, which is a significant part of her identity.
2. **Grief and loss**: The film delves into the emotional pain of losing loved ones, particularly parents. Mia's grief is palpable as she struggles to come to terms with the loss of those closest to her.
3. **Relationships and love**: The movie highlights the importance of relationships in our lives. Mia's bond with her family, friends, and romantic partner Adam (played by Jamie Blackley) is a central theme.
4. **Self-discovery**: Through her experience, Mia learns to appreciate the beauty of life and finds new meaning in her own existence. She discovers that there is more to life than just music and relationships.
5. **The power of music**: Music plays a significant role in the film, serving as a catalyst for Mia's emotional journey. The movie showcases the therapeutic benefits of music and its ability to transcend pain and loss.

Overall, "If I Stay" is a poignant exploration of the human experience, tackling complex themes with sensitivity and nuance.

overview: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new "friend" also go well beyond platonic friendship.
tagline: One woman's secret is another woman's power. One woman's fear is another woman's weapon. One woman's life is in another woman's hands....
title: Notes on a Scandal
plot:
Notes on a Scandal is a thought-provoking drama that delves into the complexities of human relationships, morality, and the blurred lines between right and wrong. The film masterfully weaves together a narrative that explores the intricate web of connections between its characters, particularly the complex and multifaceted relationship between Barbara Covett (played by Judi Dench) and Sheba Hart (played by Cate Blanchett).

At its core, Notes on a Scandal is a movie about the destructive power of gossip, rumors, and the devastating consequences that can arise when we allow ourselves to be consumed by our own desires for revenge or validation. Barbara Covett, a middle-aged schoolteacher, becomes obsessed with Sheba Hart, a young and attractive colleague who has recently become a single mother. As their relationship evolves, Covett's fixation on Sheba grows, leading her down a path of manipulation and deceit.

The film expertly exposes the darker aspects of human nature, revealing how easily we can be swayed by our own biases, insecurities, and flaws. Through the characters' interactions, the movie highlights the devastating impact that gossip and rumors can have on individuals and relationships, as well as the ways in which we often use others to feed our own ego or sense of self-importance.

Ultimately, Notes on a Scandal is a cautionary tale about the dangers of allowing ourselves to become trapped by our own desires and the destructive power of unchecked ambition. The film raises important questions about morality, empathy, and the complexities of human relationships, leaving audiences to ponder the true nature of right and wrong in the face of temptation and deception.

overview: Set in the thick of the Cold War, Red Son introduces us to a Superman who landed in the USSR during the 1950s and grows up to become a Soviet symbol that fights for the preservation of Stalin’s brand of communism.
title: Superman: Red Son
plot:
Superman: Red Son is an animated film that explores the darker and more complex side of the Superman mythos. The movie delves into the idea of a world where Superman's parents, Jor-El and Lara Lor-Van, sent him to Earth as a baby instead of sending him to the planet Krypton for destruction. This decision sets off a chain of events that leads to an alternate reality where Superman grows up in the Soviet Union.

The film's main themes revolve around the concept of identity and the struggle between individuality and conformity. In this alternate universe, Superman is raised by a family who values loyalty and duty above all else, and he becomes a symbol of hope for the Soviet people. However, as he grows older, Superman begins to grapple with his own sense of purpose and morality, torn between his desire to do good and his duty to serve the Soviet Union.

The movie also explores the idea of the American Dream vs. the Soviet ideology, highlighting the tension between individual freedom and collective control. Superman's character serves as a symbol of both the ideals of democracy and capitalism, as well as the dangers of totalitarianism and propaganda.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of family and the complexities of relationships. Superman's adoptive parents, Ivan and Natalya Korshunov, are loving but also controlling figures who shape his worldview and influence his decisions. This dynamic creates tension between Superman's desire for independence and his loyalty to those who raised him.

Overall, Superman: Red Son is a thought-provoking film that challenges the traditional Superman narrative and offers a fresh perspective on the character's origins and values.

overview: On an idyllic beach in the Pacific Northwest, curiosity gets the better of a young raccoon whose frustrated parent attempts to keep them both safe.
title: Far from the Tree
plot:
Far from the Tree is a 2021 American animated drama short film written and directed by Natalie Nourigat and produced by Ruth Strother for Walt Disney Animation Studios. It follows a curious young raccoon whose father constantly scolds her for straying into danger, and who later finds herself repeating his behavior with her own child.

On a beach at the edge of a forest, a young raccoon named Marie goes foraging with her father, who bears a scar over one eye. He orders her to stay hidden in a small grotto while he digs for oysters, but Marie keeps wandering out, and each time he angrily drags her back. When she finds a seashell and listens with delight to the sound of the waves inside it, her father chases her back to the grotto and smashes the shell. Chasing a seagull that snatches a fragment, Marie runs into a coyote, which gashes her nose. Her father knocks the coyote away and carries her up into a tree, where he scolds her furiously as she sobs.

Years later, Marie, now an adult still marked by the scar, takes her own son to the beach. Like her father, she tells him to stay in the grotto, and when he slips out to chase seagulls, she snaps at him angrily, before realizing that she is repeating her father's harshness. Instead, she teaches her son about the danger posed by coyotes, shows him how to dig for oysters, and watches over him as he explores. As the sun sets and they return to the forest, she gives him a seashell, which he holds to his ear.

Nourigat developed the film after Disney invited pitches for theatrical shorts in 2018. The project began as a story about human characters drawn from her nostalgia for her childhood in Oregon, but its themes of intergenerational trauma made the tone very dark, and the characters were changed to raccoons, inspired by those Nourigat observed during a research trip to Cannon Beach, Oregon. The animators balanced realistic animal behavior with cartoon appeal. The film relied heavily on Disney's Meander drawing system, previously used for Paperman and Feast, blending hand-drawn line work with computer animation.

Far from the Tree premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival on June 15, 2021, and was released in theaters alongside Encanto that November. It received positive reviews for its emotional storytelling and its themes, with TheWrap naming it one of the best animated films of the year, and it was nominated for Best Short Film by the Hollywood Critics Association.

overview: An elite squad of Navy SEALs, on a covert mission to transport a prisoner off a CIA black site island prison, are trapped when insurgents attack while trying to rescue the same prisoner.
tagline: Escape is just the beginning.
title: One Shot
plot:
One Shot is a 2021 British action thriller film directed by James Nunn from a screenplay by Jamie Russell, based on a story by Nunn. Reuniting the director with star Scott Adkins, it also features Ashley Greene, Ryan Phillippe, Waleed Elgadi, Emmanuel Imani and Terence Maynard. Its defining feature is that the whole film is staged and edited to appear as a single continuous take. Produced by Signature Films, it was shot in March and April 2021 at the former RAF Bentwaters air base in Suffolk, with music by Austin Wintory and cinematography by Jonathan Iles. Screen Media Films acquired North American rights and released it in theatres and on video on demand on 5 November 2021.

A squad of Navy SEALs led by Lieutenant Jake Harris (Adkins) escorts CIA analyst Zoe Anderson (Greene) by helicopter to a secret black-site prison on a remote island, where suspected terrorists are held and interrogated. Zoe has come to take one prisoner, Amin Mansur (Elgadi), back to Washington, D.C.: the former businessman is believed to know where a terrorist cell has hidden a dirty bomb that is about to go off in the capital, though he loudly protests his innocence. The facility's embittered commander, Jack Yorke (Phillippe), is reluctant to hand him over until the paperwork clears. Before the transfer can happen, a truck smashes through the perimeter fence and a large force of heavily armed insurgents storms the base. Their helicopter destroyed and reinforcements still some way off, the SEALs and the outnumbered guards try to hold the buildings, but a suicide bombing kills many of them and leaves Zoe fatally wounded.

Realising that the attackers mean to silence him, Mansur flees on his own, and Harris must track him down through the fighting. After Zoe dies in his arms, Harris learns that Mansur's pregnant wife is being kept in the danger zone in Washington as leverage. When Harris tells him where his family is, Mansur finally agrees to reveal the location of the bomb, just as the relief helicopters arrive.

Reviews were mixed, with a 59% approval rating from 22 critics on Rotten Tomatoes. Dennis Harvey of Variety felt the single-take device heightened the immediacy of otherwise B-grade, adrenaline-fuelled fare, and Leslie Felperin of The Guardian criticised the clichéd dialogue and wooden acting but found the choreography and crisp digital cinematography as weirdly mesmeric as the film was schlocky. A sequel, One More Shot, followed in 2024.

overview: Jimmy Grimble is a shy Manchester school boy. At school he is constantly being bullied by the other kids, and at home he has to face his mother's new boyfriend. However, through football, and some special boots, he manages to gain the confidence to succeed and leads his school football team towards the final of the local schools cup.
title: There's Only One Jimmy Grimble
plot:
There's Only One Jimmy Grimble is a heartwarming and poignant film that explores the complexities of family relationships, love, and self-discovery. The movie delves into the emotional struggles of its protagonist, Jimmy Grimble, as he navigates his way through adolescence and grapples with feelings of abandonment and insecurity.

At its core, the film is a powerful exploration of the human need for connection and belonging. Jimmy's journey is marked by a deep-seated desire to be loved and accepted, which often leads him to act out in ways that are both hurtful and desperate. As he struggles to come to terms with his own identity, Jimmy must also confront the flaws and imperfections of those around him, including his parents.

One of the most striking aspects of the film is its nuanced portrayal of family dynamics. The Grimbles' relationship is fraught with tension and conflict, yet beneath the surface lies a deep-seated love and loyalty that ultimately binds them together. Through Jimmy's eyes, we see the imperfections and quirks of those around him, but also their capacity for growth, forgiveness, and redemption.

Ultimately, There's Only One Jimmy Grimble is a film about finding one's place in the world and learning to accept oneself, flaws and all. It is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that will resonate with audiences long after the credits roll.

overview: When the galaxy comes under the threat of a nefarious space captain, a mechanic and his newfound robot ally join an elite squad of combatants to save the universe.
tagline: Kick Some Asteroid.
title: Ratchet & Clank
plot:
Ratchet & Clank is a 2016 animated science fiction action comedy film based on the Insomniac Games video game series, directed by Kevin Munroe. James Arnold Taylor and David Kaye reprise their roles from the games as Ratchet and Clank, alongside Jim Ward as Captain Qwark and Armin Shimerman as Doctor Nefarious, with Paul Giamatti, John Goodman, Bella Thorne, Rosario Dawson and Sylvester Stallone. The film offers an original story loosely based on the first game in the series, released in 2002.

In the Solana Galaxy, Chairman Drek and his species, the Blarg, are dismantling entire planets to build a new artificial world to replace their polluted home planet. At a factory producing Drek's war robots, a defective robot is created and escapes to warn the heroic Galactic Rangers. He crash-lands on the planet Veldin and meets Ratchet, a young lombax mechanic who dreams of becoming a Ranger. Ratchet names the robot Clank, and together they save the Rangers from an attack, becoming instant celebrities.

Pressured by their popularity, the vain Ranger leader, Captain Qwark, recruits Ratchet and Clank to the team. Jealous of their fame, Qwark secretly agrees to help Drek, who is preparing to destroy more planets with his superweapon, the Deplanetizer. When Drek's scientist, Doctor Nefarious, reveals his own scheme to take control of the weapon and destroy the entire galaxy, Ratchet and Clank must stop him and persuade Qwark to choose the right side.

The film was produced at Rainmaker Entertainment's studio in Vancouver, with Insomniac contributing to its screenplay, characters and animation assets; the screenplay was co-written by the series' former senior writer T. J. Fixman. A re-imagined version of the first game was released as a tie-in.

Ratchet & Clank was released in the United States by Gramercy Pictures on April 29, 2016. It was a box office failure, grossing 14.4 million dollars against a 20 million dollar budget, and received generally negative reviews, with 22 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 29.

overview: A veteran chef faces off against his restaurant group's new CEO, who wants to the establishment to lose a star from its rating in order to bring in a younger chef who specializes in molecular gastronomy.
tagline: Competition Can Be Delicious
title: Le Chef
plot:
Le Chef (French: Comme un chef) is a 2012 French comedy film directed by Daniel Cohen, starring Jean Reno as the celebrated chef Alexandre Lagarde and Michaël Youn as Jacky Bonnot, a talented but stubborn self-taught cook. The cast also includes Raphaëlle Agogué as Jacky's pregnant girlfriend Beatrice, Julien Boisselier as the restaurant's ambitious shareholder Stanislas Matter, Santiago Segura as a self-proclaimed expert in molecular gastronomy, Salomé Stévenin as Alexandre's daughter, Pierre Vernier as the restaurant's main shareholder Paul Matter and Kentaro as Alexandre's right-hand man.

Jacky Bonnot dreams of becoming a great chef, but his perfectionism and refusal to compromise keep getting him fired from restaurant jobs. With his girlfriend expecting a baby, he promises to take any work he can find and is hired as a painter at a retirement home, where he secretly helps the cooks transform the menu. News of his talent reaches Alexandre Lagarde, the star chef of the Cargo Lagarde restaurant and host of a television cooking show, who is facing a crisis of his own.

Lagarde's restaurant is at risk of losing one of its stars, and Stanislas Matter, the son of its main shareholder, wants to replace him with a younger chef specializing in fashionable molecular cuisine. Lagarde hires Jacky as an unpaid intern to help him reinvent his menu, but their clashing temperaments lead to constant conflict. As Jacky hides his new job from his girlfriend and their relationship suffers, the two chefs, aided by the retirement home's cooks, set out to understand molecular gastronomy and win over the critics who will decide the restaurant's fate.

The film satirizes trends in haute cuisine and the rivalry between traditional French cooking and molecular gastronomy, while telling a story of mentorship and second chances.

Le Chef had its international premiere at the 62nd Berlin International Film Festival in 2012 before its release in France in March 2012. Cohen Media Group distributed it in the United States.

overview: Based in the municipality of Khwaish, abused by his classmates, Aladin Chatterjee, who was orphaned when his parents, Arun and Riya, died in an accident in Siachen Valley, lived with his paternal grandfather until the later's passing. Now alone, grown up, studying in Khwaish University, and still being abused by fellow-college mates, he finds himself smitten by the lovely US Exchange Student, Jasmine. Unable to express his feelings for her, he rubs a lamp that was gifted to him on his birthday, which summons a genie named Genius. He gets 3 wishes, but wastes 2 of them, but on the 3rd one he insists that Genius assist him to win Jasmine's heart without any magical tricks. Hilarious chaos result when everything seems to fail while an immortal and deadly entity, Ringmaster, and his hordes, prepares to confront Genius and Aladin so that he can acquire more magical powers with the help of the lamp on the day of the sighting of a rare comet and the truth behind the death of Aladin's parents.
tagline: and the Mystery of the lamp
title: Aladin
plot:
Aladin is a 2009 Indian Hindi-language fantasy action comedy directed by Sujoy Ghosh, a modern reworking of the Aladdin legend. It stars Riteish Deshmukh as Aladin Chatterjee, Amitabh Bachchan as the genie Genius, Sanjay Dutt as the villainous Ringmaster and Jacqueline Fernandez, in her film debut, as Jasmine, with Sahil Khan and Ratna Pathak Shah. The film was adapted from the Marathi play Pati Sagle Uchapati, itself based on the play Right Bed, Wrong Husband by Neil and Caroline Schaffner, and its music was composed by Vishal–Shekhar.

As a baby, Aladin loses his parents when his archaeologist father, who has found and hidden a magic lamp, is murdered along with his wife by a gang searching for it. Raised by his grandfather, Aladin grows up lonely in the fictional city of Khwaish, where he is constantly bullied by Kasim and his gang. His life changes when Jasmine, a beautiful newcomer, arrives in town and he falls for her.
